```ts
import { randomBytes, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { sql, type SQL } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { closeDb, createDb, type Db, type DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { loadConfig } from "../../src/config";
import { boundLockWaits, isBoundReached } from "../../src/lib/lock-bounds";
import { createMediaRepo } from "../../src/media/repo";
import { recordIntake } from "../../src/moderation/intake";
import { boundWaits } from "../../src/moderation/standing-repo";
import { createProfileStore } from "../../src/profiles/store";
import { createSocialRepo } from "../../src/social/repo";
import { aPost, ground, moderationDeps, removeFixtures, rowCounts, suspendRowForTest, uuids } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { newProfile } from "./social-fixtures";

// Each wave waits for its holders to pass a start fixed a second and a half ahead, and the bound's test lets sixteen
// accounts like for some seconds: slow on a loaded machine.
vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 180_000 });

/**
 * The closing judgment and the bound of a starved lock (3e design, section 7.2 as the review of the built code amended
 * it; review rulings database1 and database2).
 *
 * A write of an account is judged by the clock when it gets its rows, and once more by the last statement of its
 * transaction, after every lock, insert and counter update: a write that waited anywhere (for its own profile row held
 * by a decision that only locks it, for the other party's row that another transaction changes, for the post it engages
 * with held FOR UPDATE by a decision) and got through after the account's suspension started is refused and writes
 * nothing. Each scene fixes the start of a fresh account a second and a half ahead (as the migrator writes it, as
 * standing_apply would once a notice's outcome fixed it), starts a holder that keeps the row the write will wait for
 * until 300 ms after the start, and sends the write while the start is still ahead: every write of 7.3 that a suspension
 * refuses, behind each holder that can make it wait.
 *
 * A bound that lock_timeout alone sets can be outlived: a FOR UPDATE on a profile waits behind every key-share lock that
 * others' likes of the account's posts take, and a new one joins the holders without queueing behind it, while
 * lock_timeout is armed again at each wait. With a statement_timeout of the same length the statement ends at the bound.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the closing judgment of a write, and the bound of a starved lock", () => {
  let apiDb: Db;
  let writersDb: Db;
  let holdersDb: Db;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  const made: string[] = [];

  beforeAll(async () => {
    const config = loadConfig();
    apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 4 });
    writersDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 24 });
    holdersDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 10 });
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });
    before = await rowCounts(apiDb);
  });
  afterAll(async () => {
    await Promise.all([closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(writersDb), closeDb(holdersDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
  });

  /** How far ahead of the database's clock each scene's start is fixed. */
  const LEAD_MS = 1500;
  /** How long after the start each holder keeps its row. */
  const PAST_MS = 300;

  const profile = async () => {
    const created = await newProfile(apiDb);
    made.push(created.id);
    return created;
  };
  /** The database's clock, in epoch milliseconds. */
  const dbNow = async () => Number((await apiDb.execute<{ ms: number }>(sql`select extract(epoch from clock_timestamp()) * 1000 as ms`))[0]!.ms);

  /** Fixes the account's start LEAD_MS ahead of the database's clock, for a day: answers the start in epoch milliseconds. */
  async function startSoon(accountId: string): Promise<number> {
    await suspendRowForTest(migrateDb, accountId, { from: `${LEAD_MS} milliseconds`, until: "1 day" });
    return Number((await migrateDb.execute<{ ms: number }>(sql`select extract(epoch from suspended_from) * 1000 as ms from profiles where id = ${accountId}::uuid`))[0]!.ms);
  }

  /** A holder of one row: `lock` (and `change`, a new version of the row, when given) until the database's clock reads `untilMs`. */
  function hold(lock: SQL, change: SQL | null, untilMs: number): { locked: Promise<void>; released: Promise<void> } {
    let signal: () => void = () => undefined;
    const locked = new Promise<void>((resolve) => (signal = resolve));
    const released = holdersDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.execute(sql`set local lock_timeout = '10s'`);
      await tx.execute(lock);
      if (change !== null) await tx.execute(change);
      signal();
      await tx.execute(sql`select pg_sleep(greatest(0, ${untilMs / 1000}::float8 - extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())))`);
    });
    return { locked, released };
  }

  /** What a write answered: its refusal's code, "refused" for a write that answers false, or "committed". */
  async function outcome(write: () => Promise<unknown>): Promise<string> {
    try {
      const answer = await write();
      if (answer === false) return "refused";
      const refused = answer as { ok?: boolean; reason?: string } | null;
      if (typeof refused === "object" && refused !== null && refused.ok === false) return refused.reason ?? "refused";
      return "committed";
    } catch (err) {
      return String((err as { code?: unknown }).code ?? err);
    }
  }

  type Holder = "own row, locked only" | "the other party's row, changed" | "the post, FOR UPDATE";
  type Route = "post" | "reply" | "quote" | "like" | "repost" | "bookmark" | "follow" | "profile" | "handle" | "upload" | "badge" | "rule report";
  /** The other parties of a scene: an account with a post, and an account to follow. */
  interface Parties {
    actor: { id: string; handle: string };
    other: { id: string; handle: string };
    post: string;
    followee: { id: string; handle: string };
  }

  /** One write of the route by the scene's account, through the code its route runs. */
  function writeOf(route: Route, p: Parties): () => Promise<unknown> {
    const social = createSocialRepo(writersDb);
    const now = new Date();
    switch (route) {
      case "post":
        return () => social.createPost({ authorId: p.actor.id, body: "a post", replyToId: null, quoteOfId: null, now });
      case "reply":
        return () => social.createPost({ authorId: p.actor.id, body: "a reply", replyToId: p.post, quoteOfId: null, now, lockWith: p.other.id });
      case "quote":
        return () => social.createPost({ authorId: p.actor.id, body: "a quote", replyToId: null, quoteOfId: p.post, now, lockWith: p.other.id });
      case "like":
        return () => social.like(p.actor.id, p.post, now, p.other.id);
      case "repost":
        return () => social.repost(p.actor.id, p.post, now, p.other.id);
      case "bookmark":
        return () => social.bookmark(p.actor.id, p.post, now);
      case "follow":
        return () => social.follow(p.actor.id, p.followee.id, now, true);
      case "profile":
        return () => social.updateProfile(p.actor.id, { bio: "a new bio" });
      case "handle":
        return () => social.changeHandle(p.actor.id, `h_${randomBytes(5).toString("hex")}`, now);
      case "upload":
        return () => createMediaRepo(writersDb).insertProcessing({ id: randomUUID(), ownerId: p.actor.id, now });
      case "badge":
        return () => createProfileStore(writersDb).setVerified(p.actor.id, now);
      case "rule report":
        return () => recordIntake(moderationDeps(writersDb), { ground: ground.rule(p.actor.id, "R1"), live: [aPost(p.post)] });
    }
  }

  /** The row the holder takes, and the change it makes. */
  function holderOf(holder: Holder, p: Parties, route: Route): { lock: SQL; change: SQL | null } {
    if (holder === "own row, locked only") return { lock: sql`select 1 from profiles where id = ${p.actor.id}::uuid for update`, change: null };
    if (holder === "the post, FOR UPDATE") return { lock: sql`select 1 from posts where id = ${p.post}::uuid for update`, change: null };
    const other = route === "follow" ? p.followee.id : p.other.id;
    return { lock: sql`select 1 from profiles where id = ${other}::uuid for update`, change: sql`update profiles set bio = bio where id = ${other}::uuid` };
  }

  /**
   * One scene: a fresh account and its other parties, the account's start fixed LEAD_MS ahead, the holder, and the write
   * sent while the holder has its row. Answers what the write answered, and whether it was sent before the start.
   */
  async function scene(holder: Holder, route: Route): Promise<{ scene: string; result: string; sentBeforeStart: boolean; actor: string }> {
    const [actor, other, followee] = [await profile(), await profile(), await profile()];
    const post = await createSocialRepo(apiDb).createPost({ authorId: other.id, body: "a post of the other account", replyToId: null, quoteOfId: null, now: new Date() });
    const parties: Parties = { actor, other, post, followee };
    const write = writeOf(route, parties);
    const { lock, change } = holderOf(holder, parties, route);
    const start = await startSoon(actor.id);
    const held = hold(lock, change, start + PAST_MS);
    await held.locked;
    const sent = await dbNow();
    const result = await outcome(write);
    await held.released;
    return { scene: `${route}, behind ${holder}`, result, sentBeforeStart: sent < start, actor: actor.id };
  }

  /** The scenes, BATCH at a time, each on accounts of its own. */
  async function scenes(list: readonly [Holder, Route][]) {
    const BATCH = 8;
    const results: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof scene>>[] = [];
    for (let from = 0; from < list.length; from += BATCH) results.push(...(await Promise.all(list.slice(from, from + BATCH).map(([holder, route]) => scene(holder, route)))));
    return results;
  }

  /** What a scene's account wrote: none of it may be there. */
  async function written(accountIds: readonly string[]) {
    const ids = uuids(accountIds);
    const [row] = await migrateDb.execute<Record<string, number>>(
      sql`select (select count(*)::int from posts where author_id = any(${ids})) as posts,
                 (select count(*)::int from likes where user_id = any(${ids})) as likes,
                 (select count(*)::int from reposts where user_id = any(${ids})) as reposts,
                 (select count(*)::int from bookmarks where user_id = any(${ids})) as bookmarks,
                 (select count(*)::int from follows where follower_id = any(${ids})) as follows,
                 (select count(*)::int from post_media where owner_id = any(${ids})) as uploads,
                 (select count(*)::int from intakes where reporter_id = any(${ids})) as reports,
                 (select count(*)::int from profiles where id = any(${ids}) and (bio <> '' or verified_at is not null or left(handle, 2) <> 's_')) as profiles`,
    );
    return { ...row! };
  }

  const NOTHING = { posts: 0, likes: 0, reposts: 0, bookmarks: 0, follows: 0, uploads: 0, reports: 0, profiles: 0 };
  const EVERY_ROUTE: Route[] = ["post", "reply", "quote", "like", "repost", "bookmark", "follow", "profile", "handle", "upload", "badge", "rule report"];

  test("behind a holder that only locks the account's own row (a decision about it, a refused handle change), every refused write of 7.3 that gets through after the start is refused and writes nothing", async () => {
    const results = await scenes(EVERY_ROUTE.map((route) => ["own row, locked only", route] as [Holder, Route]));
    // Each write was sent while the start was ahead, and judged then by its first statement.
    expect(results.filter((r) => !r.sentBeforeStart).map((r) => r.scene)).toEqual([]);
    // A write that answers false (the profile's edit, the badge) is refused as its route refuses it: account_suspended.
    expect(results.filter((r) => r.result !== "account_suspended" && r.result !== "refused").map((r) => `${r.scene}: ${r.result}`)).toEqual([]);
    expect(results.filter((r) => r.result === "refused").map((r) => r.scene)).toEqual(["profile, behind own row, locked only", "badge, behind own row, locked only"]);
    expect(await written(results.map((r) => r.actor))).toEqual(NOTHING);
  });

  test("behind a holder that changes the other party's row (another account's follow of it, the purge), a follow, a like, a repost, a bookmark, a reply and a quote are refused and write nothing", async () => {
    const routes: Route[] = ["follow", "like", "repost", "bookmark", "reply", "quote"];
    const results = await scenes(routes.map((route) => ["the other party's row, changed", route] as [Holder, Route]));
    expect(results.filter((r) => !r.sentBeforeStart).map((r) => r.scene)).toEqual([]);
    expect(results.filter((r) => r.result !== "account_suspended").map((r) => `${r.scene}: ${r.result}`)).toEqual([]);
    expect(await written(results.map((r) => r.actor))).toEqual(NOTHING);
  });

  test("behind a decision that holds the post FOR UPDATE, a reply, a quote, a like, a repost, a bookmark and a report under a rule are refused and write nothing", async () => {
    const routes: Route[] = ["reply", "quote", "like", "repost", "bookmark", "rule report"];
    const results = await scenes(routes.map((route) => ["the post, FOR UPDATE", route] as [Holder, Route]));
    expect(results.filter((r) => !r.sentBeforeStart).map((r) => r.scene)).toEqual([]);
    expect(results.filter((r) => r.result !== "account_suspended").map((r) => `${r.scene}: ${r.result}`)).toEqual([]);
    expect(await written(results.map((r) => r.actor))).toEqual(NOTHING);
  });

  test("a write whose start is not reached by its end commits: the closing judgment refuses nothing before a start", async () => {
    const actor = await profile();
    const other = await profile();
    const social = createSocialRepo(writersDb);
    await suspendRowForTest(migrateDb, actor.id, { from: "1 hour", until: "1 day" });
    const post = await social.createPost({ authorId: actor.id, body: "before the start", replyToId: null, quoteOfId: null, now: new Date() });
    expect(await social.follow(actor.id, other.id, new Date(), true)).toBe(true);
    expect(await social.like(actor.id, post, new Date())).toBe(true);
    expect(await social.updateProfile(actor.id, { bio: "still mine" })).toBe(true);
    expect(await createProfileStore(writersDb).setVerified(actor.id, new Date())).toBe(true);
    await createMediaRepo(writersDb).insertProcessing({ id: randomUUID(), ownerId: actor.id, now: new Date() });
    expect((await recordIntake(moderationDeps(writersDb), { ground: ground.rule(actor.id, "R1"), live: [aPost(await social.createPost({ authorId: other.id, body: "reported", replyToId: null, quoteOfId: null, now: new Date() }))] })).items).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the bound

  /**
   * Sixteen accounts like and unlike a post of the subject back to back, each holding the subject's profile FOR KEY SHARE
   * while it waits for the post's counter, until `stop` is set or the cap passes. Answers the loops.
   */
  async function likers(subject: string, post: string, stop: { now: boolean }, capMs: number) {
    const pool = createDb(loadConfig().DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 17 });
    const social = createSocialRepo(pool);
    const people = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) people.push((await profile()).id);
    const until = Date.now() + capMs;
    const loops = people.map(async (liker) => {
      while (!stop.now && Date.now() < until) {
        // A like that fails (a deadlock with a sibling's unlike) is simply tried again: only the stream of locks matters.
        await social.like(liker, post, new Date(), subject).catch(() => false);
        await social.unlike(liker, post).catch(() => false);
      }
    });
    return { done: () => Promise.all(loops).finally(() => closeDb(pool)) };
  }

  /** A FOR UPDATE of the subject's profile under the bound `bounded` sets: how long it took, and how it ended. */
  async function boundedLock(subject: string, bounded: (tx: DbTx) => Promise<void>) {
    const started = performance.now();
    let boundMs = 0;
    let ended: unknown = null;
    try {
      await apiDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
        await bounded(tx);
        // pg_settings gives statement_timeout in milliseconds, whatever unit it was set in.
        boundMs = Number((await tx.execute<{ ms: string }>(sql`select setting as ms from pg_settings where name = 'statement_timeout'`))[0]!.ms);
        await createSocialRepo(apiDb).lockAccounts(tx, [subject], "update");
      });
    } catch (err) {
      ended = err;
    }
    return { ms: performance.now() - started, boundMs, ended };
  }

  test("a FOR UPDATE that sixteen accounts' likes of the subject's post keep starving ends at the bound a confirmed action sets (boundLockWaits), and at the reply's and the take-down's (boundWaits)", async () => {
    const subject = await profile();
    const post = await createSocialRepo(apiDb).createPost({ authorId: subject.id, body: "a post many like", replyToId: null, quoteOfId: null, now: new Date() });
    const stop = { now: false };
    // The likers stop when both locks have ended, or after a minute: the bound must end each lock long before that.
    const loops = await likers(subject.id, post, stop, 60_000);
    try {
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1000));
      // A challenge with 60 seconds left and 15 waits: a bound of 4 seconds.
      const confirmed = await boundedLock(subject.id, async (tx) => {
        expect(await boundLockWaits(tx, new Date(Date.now() + 60_000), 15)).toBe(true);
      });
      const reply = await boundedLock(subject.id, (tx) => boundWaits(tx, 3000));
      for (const [name, run] of [["boundLockWaits", confirmed], ["boundWaits", reply]] as const) {
        // The bound is set on both limits, and the lock either came within it or the statement ended at it.
        expect(run.boundMs, name).toBeGreaterThan(0);
        expect(run.ms, name).toBeLessThan(run.boundMs + 1500);
        if (run.ended !== null) expect(isBoundReached(run.ended), `${name}: ${String(run.ended)}`).toBe(true);
      }
    } finally {
      stop.now = true;
      await loops.done();
    }
  });

  test("this file left no row behind: the tables it writes hold what they held before it", async () => {
    await removeFixtures(migrateDb, made.splice(0));
    // What the scenes followed, liked, reposted and bookmarked goes with the accounts; their reports' rows went with removeFixtures.
    expect(await rowCounts(apiDb)).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```

```tsx
const NOW = new Date("2026-10-12T09:30:00.000Z");
const ADMIN: StaffMe["role"] = "admin";
const MODERATOR: StaffMe["role"] = "moderator";
const DIGESTS = { snapshot: "cd".repeat(32), facts: "aa".repeat(32), reason: "bb".repeat(32), legalReference: null };

const final = (view: CaseView, role: StaffMe["role"], change: Partial<CaseDraft> = {}): CaseDraft => ({ ...newDraft(caseId(view.id), view, role), kind: "final", ruleId: "R3", ...change });
const withStandingOf = (view: CaseView, change: Partial<NonNullable<CaseView["standing"]>>): CaseView => ({ ...view, standing: { ...view.standing!, ...change } });

function composer(view: CaseView, role: StaffMe["role"], draft: CaseDraft) {
  const props: ComposerViewProps = { view, role, draft, now: NOW, busy: false, error: null, textErrors: {}, declining: null, onChange: noop, onTextBlur: noop, onSeal: noop, onConfirm: noop, onDeclineOpen: noop, onDeclineChange: noop, onDeclineSave: noop, onDeclineClose: noop, onCancelCorrection: noop };
  return html(<ComposerView {...props} />);
}

/** The case page as a person of this role sees it, with the controls beside each decision. */
function casePage(view: CaseView, role: StaffMe["role"]) {
  const base: CaseScreenViewProps = {
    caseId: caseId(view.id),
    view,
    shownImage: null,
    busy: null,
    notice: null,
    error: null,
    note: "",
    reveal: null,
    onOpenCase: noop,
    onShowImage: noop,
    onShowClearly: noop,
    onHideImage: noop,
    onImageError: noop,
    onSnapshot: noop,
    onNoteChange: noop,
    onNoteSave: noop,
    onRevealOpen: noop,
    onRevealChange: noop,
    onRevealConfirm: noop,
    onRevealClose: noop,
    compose: {
      role,
      draft: newDraft(caseId(view.id), view, role),
      now: NOW,
      busy: false,
      error: null,
      textErrors: {},
      declining: null,
      onChange: noop,
      onTextBlur: noop,
      onSeal: noop,
      onConfirm: noop,
      onDeclineOpen: noop,
      onDeclineChange: noop,
      onDeclineSave: noop,
      onDeclineClose: noop,
      onCancelCorrection: noop,
      onCorrect: noop,
      onReview: noop,
      onAnswer: noop,
      onWithdraw: noop,
      onWithdrawMarks: noop,
    },
  };
  return html(<CaseScreenView {...base} />);
}

/** The decision of a fixture case that holds the measure. */
const decisionOf = (view: CaseView, id: string): CaseDecision => view.decisions.find((decided) => decided.id === id)!;

/** The replied decision with its measure's reply or period changed. */
function repliedWith(change: { reply?: Partial<NonNullable<CaseDecision["actions"][number]["reply"]>>; period?: NonNullable<CaseDecision["actions"][number]["period"]>; needsAdmin?: boolean }): CaseDecision {
  const decided = decisionOf(repliedCase(), DECISION_REPLIED);
  const measure = decided.actions[0]!;
  return {
    ...decided,
    needsAdmin: change.needsAdmin ?? decided.needsAdmin,
    actions: [{ ...measure, reply: { ...measure.reply!, ...change.reply }, period: change.period ?? measure.period }],
  };
}

describe("3e Task 4: the announced measures in the composer of an account case (design, section 8.3)", () => {
  test("the words are the design's, each number printed from STANDING_RULES or REPLY_AIM_HOURS", () => {
    expect(STANDING_WORDS.suspend.label).toBe("Announce a suspension");
    expect(STANDING_WORDS.suspend.short(2)).toBe(`Not open: an announced suspension needs ${STANDING_RULES.ladderStrikes} active strikes. This account has 2.`);
    expect(STANDING_WORDS.terminate.notYet).toContain(`needs ${STANDING_RULES.ladderDays.length} suspensions under the ladder decided in the last ${STANDING_RULES.ladderMemoryDays} days`);
    expect(STANDING_WORDS.terminate.noRepeat).toContain(`a final R5 decision at most ${STANDING_RULES.basisAgeDays} days old`);
    expect(STANDING_WORDS.reply.overAim).toBe(`waiting more than ${REPLY_AIM_HOURS} hours`);
    expect(STANDING_WORDS.lists.reportingRow("someone", 5, 8)).toBe(`@someone: 5 of the 8 rule reports sent in the last ${STANDING_RULES.reportFrameDays} days hold a mark manifestly unfounded.`);
    expect(STANDING_WORDS.home.strikes(2)).toBe(`Accounts at ${STANDING_RULES.ladderStrikes} strikes: 2.`);
    expect(STANDING_WORDS.appealsOrder).toBe("Appeals of a running suspension or of a termination come first.");
  });

  test("each control is open when the case answer says the database would accept it, and greyed with its reason otherwise", () => {
    const view = ladderCase();
    expect(standingControlState(view, MODERATOR, final(view, MODERATOR), "announce")).toEqual({ open: true });
    expect(standingControlState(ladderCase(true), MODERATOR, final(view, MODERATOR), "announce")).toEqual({ open: false, why: "reportsFirst" });
    expect(standingControlState(withStandingOf(view, { live: true }), MODERATOR, final(view, MODERATOR), "announce")).toEqual({ open: false, why: "conflict" });
    expect(standingControlState(withStandingOf(view, { activeStrikes: 2 }), MODERATOR, final(view, MODERATOR), "announce")).toEqual({ open: false, why: "short" });
    expect(standingControlState(withStandingOf(view, { maxDays: null }), MODERATOR, final(view, MODERATOR), "announce")).toEqual({ open: false, why: "stale" });
    // A termination is an admin's: announced at the ladder's end, at once on a second direct threat.
    expect(standingControlState(view, MODERATOR, final(view, MODERATOR), "announceTerminate")).toEqual({ open: false, why: "admin" });
    expect(standingControlState(view, ADMIN, final(view, ADMIN), "announceTerminate")).toEqual({ open: false, why: "notYet" });
    expect(standingControlState(withStandingOf(view, { mayTerminate: true }), ADMIN, final(view, ADMIN), "announceTerminate")).toEqual({ open: true });
    expect(standingControlState(withStandingOf(view, { mayTerminate: true, openReports: true }), ADMIN, final(view, ADMIN), "announceTerminate")).toEqual({ open: false, why: "reportsFirst" });
    expect(standingControlState(view, ADMIN, final(view, ADMIN, { ruleId: "R5" }), "terminateAtOnce")).toEqual({ open: false, why: "noRepeat" });
    expect(standingControlState(withStandingOf(view, { atOnce: ["threat_repeat"] }), ADMIN, final(view, ADMIN, { ruleId: "R5" }), "terminateAtOnce")).toEqual({ open: true });
    expect(standingControlState(withStandingOf(view, { atOnce: ["threat_repeat"] }), ADMIN, final(view, ADMIN, { ruleId: "R2" }), "terminateAtOnce")).toEqual({ open: false, why: "r2" });
    // Not shown at all while deciding, or for an outcome that restricts nothing.
    expect(standingControlState(view, MODERATOR, final(view, MODERATOR, { kind: "interim" }), "announce")).toBeNull();
    expect(standingControlState(view, MODERATOR, final(view, MODERATOR, { outcome: "no_violation" }), "announce")).toBeNull();
  });

  test("the composer shows the announce control with the rung's days and the newest strike's rule, and greys it with [reports.first] while a report waits", () => {
    const view = ladderCase();
    const open = composer(view, MODERATOR, final(view, MODERATOR));
    expect(open).toContain('<input type="checkbox"/> <span>Announce a suspension</span>');
    expect(open).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.suspend.days(3, 1)));
    expect(open).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.suspend.rule("R1")));
    // A moderator is offered no termination: both are greyed with [terminate.admin].
    expect(open).toContain('<input type="checkbox" disabled=""/> <span>Announce a termination</span>');
    expect(open).toContain('<input type="checkbox" disabled=""/> <span>Terminate at once</span>');
    expect(open).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.terminate.admin));
    const waiting = ladderCase(true);
    const greyed = composer(waiting, MODERATOR, final(waiting, MODERATOR));
    expect(greyed).toContain('<input type="checkbox" disabled=""/> <span>Announce a suspension</span>');
    expect(greyed).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.reportsFirst));
    expect(greyed).not.toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.suspend.days(3, 1)));
  });

  test("choosing it adds the announced suspension under the newest strike's rule with the drafted facts; the params sign its days and announced true; the preview says nothing is restricted yet", () => {
    const view = ladderCase();
    const draft = withStanding(view, final(view, MODERATOR), "announce", 2);
    expect(draft.actions).toEqual([{ kind: "suspend", mediaId: null, days: 2, announced: true }]);
    expect(draft.ruleId).toBe("R1");
    expect(draft.category).toBe(RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY.R1);
    expect(draft.written.facts).toBe(
      "When this was written the account had 3 active strikes. Each was given by a decision that found a breach of a korbat rule in a post, and each of those decisions was sent to the account with its reasons.",
    );
    expect(draft.written.reason).toBe("");
    expect(offeredDraft(view, MODERATOR, draft).actions).toEqual(draft.actions);
    // More days than the rung, another rule than the newest strike's, or a report that waits, lose the measure.
    expect(offeredDraft(view, MODERATOR, { ...draft, actions: [{ kind: "suspend", mediaId: null, days: 4, announced: true }] }).actions).toEqual([]);
    expect(offeredDraft(view, MODERATOR, { ...draft, ruleId: "R3" }).actions).toEqual([]);
    expect(offeredDraft(ladderCase(true), MODERATOR, draft).actions).toEqual([]);
    // At most one measure of the four: a termination chosen after it puts the suspension away.
    expect(withStanding(view, draft, "announceTerminate", null).actions).toEqual([{ kind: "terminate", mediaId: null, days: null, announced: true }]);
    const params = CaseDecidedParams.parse(decisionParamsOf(view, { ...draft, written: { ...draft.written, reason: "Three strikes in two weeks." } }, DIGESTS));
    expect(params).toMatchObject({ kind: "final", outcome: "restricted", ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R1", actions: [{ kind: "suspend", mediaId: null, days: 2, announced: true }], replaced: false });
    const told = statementParagraphs(previewOf(view, draft, NOW)).join(" | ");
    expect(told).toContain(`${STATEMENT_WORDS.suspendAnnounced(2)} It rests on the active strikes of your account:`);
    expect(told).not.toContain("It breaks korbat rule");
  });
});

describe("3e Task 4: replies, their answer and the withdrawal (design, sections 8.5 and 8.7)", () => {
  test("where a reply stands, and who may answer it", () => {
    const decided = decisionOf(repliedCase(), DECISION_REPLIED);
    const found = replyOf(decided)!;
    expect(found.reply.text).toBe(REPLY_TEXT);
    expect(replyState(found.measure, found.reply)).toBe("onTime");
    expect(answerable(decided, MODERATOR)).toBe(true);
    const late = repliedWith({ reply: { onTime: false }, period: { startsAt: "2026-10-06T09:00:00.000Z", endsAt: "2026-10-09T09:00:00.000Z", state: "ended" } });
    expect(replyState(late.actions[0]!, late.actions[0]!.reply!)).toBe("lateEnded");
    const running = repliedWith({ reply: { onTime: false }, period: { startsAt: "2026-10-11T09:00:00.000Z", endsAt: "2026-10-14T09:00:00.000Z", state: "running" } });
    expect(replyState(running.actions[0]!, running.actions[0]!.reply!)).toBe("late");
    const answered = repliedWith({ reply: { answeredAt: "2026-10-07T09:00:00.000Z", answeredBy: DECISION_WITHDRAW } });
    expect(replyState(answered.actions[0]!, answered.actions[0]!.reply!)).toBe("answered");
    expect(answerable(answered, ADMIN)).toBe(false);
    const gone = repliedWith({ period: { startsAt: null, endsAt: null, state: "basis_ended" } });
    expect(replyState(gone.actions[0]!, gone.actions[0]!.reply!)).toBe("basisGone");
    expect(answerable(gone, ADMIN)).toBe(false);
    // [reply.admin]: a reply to a measure that needed an admin is answered by an admin.
    const admins = repliedWith({ needsAdmin: true });
    expect(answerable(admins, MODERATOR)).toBe(false);
    expect(answerable(admins, ADMIN)).toBe(true);
    expect(replyOf(decisionOf(withdrawCase(), DECISION_WITHDRAW))).toBeNull();
  });

  test("the queue's Replies to answer: how long each waited, before or after the start, what it is against, over the aim; never its words", () => {
    const replies: QueueReply[] = [
      { caseId: CASE_REPLIED, decisionId: DECISION_REPLIED, kind: "suspend", days: 3, filedAt: "2026-10-12T08:00:00.000Z", onTime: true, endsAt: null },
      { caseId: CASE_REPLIED, decisionId: DECISION_WITHDRAW, kind: "suspend", days: 5, filedAt: "2026-10-10T09:00:00.000Z", onTime: false, endsAt: "2026-10-11T09:00:00.000Z" },
      { caseId: CASE_LADDER, decisionId: DECISION_WITHDRAW, kind: "terminate", days: null, filedAt: "2026-10-12T09:00:00.000Z", onTime: false, endsAt: null },
    ];
    expect(replyWords(replies[0]!, NOW.getTime())).toEqual([STANDING_WORDS.reply.before, STANDING_WORDS.reply.suspension(3)]);
    expect(replyWords(replies[1]!, NOW.getTime())).toEqual([STANDING_WORDS.reply.afterEnded(dateTime("2026-10-11T09:00:00.000Z")), STANDING_WORDS.reply.suspension(5), STANDING_WORDS.reply.overAim]);
    expect(replyWords(replies[2]!, NOW.getTime())[1]).toBe(STANDING_WORDS.reply.termination);
    // 3e's review (people9): a termination has no end, and its row names none.
    expect(replyWords(replies[2]!, NOW.getTime())).toEqual([STANDING_WORDS.reply.afterTermination, STANDING_WORDS.reply.termination]);
    expect(STANDING_WORDS.reply.afterTermination).toBe("after the start: the termination runs");
    const props: QueueViewProps = {
      rows: { state: "ready", value: [] },
      replies,
      more: false,
      loadingMore: false,
      now: NOW.getTime(),
      finding: { link: "", ruleId: "R1", category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC", busy: false, error: null },
      onLoadMore: noop,
      onOpenCase: noop,
      onFindingChange: noop,
      onFindingSubmit: noop,
    };
    const out = html(<QueueView {...props} />);
    expect(out).toContain(`>${STANDING_WORDS.reply.title}</h3>`);
    expect(hrefs(out)).toEqual([`/cases/${CASE_REPLIED}`, `/cases/${CASE_REPLIED}`, `/cases/${CASE_LADDER}`]);
    expect(out).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.reply.overAim));
    expect(out).not.toContain("film");
    expect(html(<QueueView {...props} replies={[]} />)).toContain(STANDING_WORDS.reply.none);
  });

  test("the case page shows the reply's text as text with [reply.onTime], and Answer this reply; once answered, the day it was answered and no control", () => {
    const out = casePage(repliedCase(), MODERATOR);
    expect(out).toContain(`aria-label="${STANDING_WORDS.reply.blockTitle}"`);
    expect(out).toContain(esc(REPLY_TEXT));
    expect(out).not.toContain(HOSTILE.script);
    expect(out).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.reply.onTime));
    expect(out).toContain(`>${STANDING_WORDS.reply.answerLabel}</button>`);
    const view = repliedCase();
    view.decisions = [repliedWith({ reply: { answeredAt: "2026-10-07T09:00:00.000Z", answeredBy: DECISION_WITHDRAW } })];
    const answered = casePage(view, MODERATOR);
    expect(answered).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.reply.answered(dateTime("2026-10-07T09:00:00.000Z"))));
    expect(answered).not.toContain(`>${STANDING_WORDS.reply.answerLabel}</button>`);
    // A reply with no text asks for a second look.
    const empty = repliedCase();
    empty.decisions = [repliedWith({ reply: { text: null } })];
    expect(casePage(empty, MODERATOR)).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.reply.empty));
  });

  test("the answer: Keep lifts nothing and Reverse lifts the measure, each said by when the reply came; the params are a correction; the preview answers the reply", () => {
    const view = repliedCase();
    const decided = decisionOf(view, DECISION_REPLIED);
    const draft = answerDraft(caseId(view.id), view, decided, MODERATOR);
    expect(draft).toMatchObject({ kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: DECISION_REPLIED, answer: "kept", actions: [] });
    const out = composer(view, MODERATOR, draft);
    expect(out).toContain(STANDING_WORDS.reply.keepLabel);
    expect(out).toContain(STANDING_WORDS.reply.reverseLabel);
    expect(out).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.keep.onTime(dateTime("2026-10-12T09:00:00.000Z"), 3)));
    expect(out).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.reply.same));
    expect(out).toContain(esc(REPLY_TEXT));
    const kept = { ...draft, written: { ...draft.written, review_reason: "Your reply did not change the strikes." } };
    expect(CaseDecidedParams.parse(decisionParamsOf(view, kept, DIGESTS))).toMatchObject({ kind: "correction", outcome: "kept", reviewsDecisionId: DECISION_REPLIED, actions: [], replaced: false });
    const keptTold = statementParagraphs(previewOf(view, kept, NOW)).join(" | ");
    expect(keptTold).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.replyKept("2026-10-05 09:00 UTC"));
    expect(keptTold).toContain("The suspension of 3 days starts at");
    const reversed = withAnswer(kept, decided, "reversed");
    expect(reversed.actions).toEqual([{ kind: "lift_suspension", mediaId: null }]);
    expect(composer(view, MODERATOR, reversed)).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.reverse.onTime));
    expect(CaseDecidedParams.parse(decisionParamsOf(view, reversed, DIGESTS))).toMatchObject({ kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed", actions: [{ kind: "lift_suspension", mediaId: null }], replaced: false });
    expect(withAnswer(reversed, decided, "kept").actions).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("Withdraw it for another measure: an admin's, while the account's measure is live, for an announced measure that has not started; signed replaced", () => {
    const view = withdrawCase();
    const decided = decisionOf(view, DECISION_WITHDRAW);
    expect(withdrawable(view, decided, ADMIN)?.kind).toBe("suspend");
    expect(withdrawable(view, decided, MODERATOR)).toBeNull();
    expect(withdrawable(withStandingOf(view, { live: false }), decided, ADMIN)).toBeNull();
    const started = { ...decided, actions: [{ ...decided.actions[0]!, period: { startsAt: "2026-10-12T09:05:00.000Z", endsAt: "2026-10-15T09:05:00.000Z", state: "running" as const } }] };
    expect(withdrawable(view, started, ADMIN)).toBeNull();
    expect(casePage(view, ADMIN)).toContain(`>${STANDING_WORDS.replace.label}</button>`);
    expect(casePage(view, MODERATOR)).not.toContain(`>${STANDING_WORDS.replace.label}</button>`);
    const draft = withdrawDraft(caseId(CASE_WITHDRAW), view, decided, ADMIN);
    expect(draft).toMatchObject({ kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: DECISION_WITHDRAW, replaced: true, actions: [{ kind: "lift_suspension", mediaId: null }] });
    const out = composer(view, ADMIN, draft);
    expect(out).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.replace.what));
    expect(out).not.toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.replace.reply));
    const written = { ...draft, written: { ...draft.written, review_reason: "A threat since needs a suspension at once." } };
    expect(CaseDecidedParams.parse(decisionParamsOf(view, written, DIGESTS))).toMatchObject({ kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed", actions: [{ kind: "lift_suspension", mediaId: null }], replaced: true });
    const told = statementParagraphs(previewOf(view, written, NOW)).join(" | ");
    expect(told).toContain("because it is taking another measure on your account.");
    expect(told).not.toContain("korbat corrected its decision");
  });
});

describe("3e Task 4: the Standing screen, the home screen's lines and the appeals' order (design, sections 8.5, 8.6 and 8.8)", () => {
```

```ts
import { readdirSync, readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { join, posix, relative, sep } from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";

/**
 * Module boundaries (1a spec section 2.2, 2a spec section 2.2, 3a design section 5, 3c design section 5). Paths are relative to apps/api/src
 * with forward slashes. The rules are plain functions so the tests below can prove each one catches
 * a deliberate violation.
 */
interface SourceFile {
  path: string;
  source: string;
}

const SRC_ROOT = fileURLToPath(new URL("../src", import.meta.url));
const SCHEMA_ROOT = fileURLToPath(new URL("../../../packages/db/src/schema", import.meta.url));

/** Schema files that define auth-schema objects or shared helpers; every other schema file is public. */
const NON_PUBLIC_SCHEMA_FILES = new Set(["auth.ts", "helpers.ts", "index.ts"]);
const AUTH_SCHEMA_FILE = "auth.ts";
// The command lines open both pools: grant-role changes a role on the auth pool, and staff.js reads there the staff keys
// that audit-verify checks the record against.
const AUTH_POOL_ALLOWED = new Set(["config.ts", "index.ts", "cli/grant-role.ts", "cli/staff.ts"]);
const AUTH_KEYS_ALLOWED = new Set(["config.ts"]);

/** Modules that may only be entered through their index file. */
const MODULES = ["auth", "social", "media", "account", "staff", "moderation"] as const;

function walk(dir: string): string[] {
  return readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true }).flatMap((entry) => {
    const full = join(dir, entry.name);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) return walk(full);
    return entry.name.endsWith(".ts") ? [full] : [];
  });
}

function loadSources(): SourceFile[] {
  return walk(SRC_ROOT).map((full) => ({ path: relative(SRC_ROOT, full).split(sep).join("/"), source: readFileSync(full, "utf8") }));
}

function exportedNames(file: string): string[] {
  const source = readFileSync(join(SCHEMA_ROOT, file), "utf8");
  return [...source.matchAll(/^export (?:const|function|type|interface|enum) ([A-Za-z0-9_]+)/gm)].map((m) => m[1]!);
}

/** Names exported by the public-schema files of @korbat/db (tables and enums the auth module must not touch). */
function publicSchemaNames(): Set<string> {
  const names = new Set<string>();
  for (const file of readdirSync(SCHEMA_ROOT)) {
    if (!file.endsWith(".ts") || NON_PUBLIC_SCHEMA_FILES.has(file)) continue;
    for (const name of exportedNames(file)) names.add(name);
  }
  return names;
}

/** Names exported by the auth-schema file of @korbat/db (tables and enums the social module must not touch). */
function authSchemaNames(): Set<string> {
  return new Set(exportedNames(AUTH_SCHEMA_FILE));
}

/** Every module specifier in static imports, re-exports, side-effect imports and dynamic imports. */
function specifiers(source: string): string[] {
  return [...source.matchAll(/(?:\bfrom\s+|\bimport\s*\(\s*|\bimport\s+)["']([^"']+)["']/g)].map((m) => m[1]!);
}

/** Named bindings of every `import { ... } from "@korbat/db"`; a namespace import yields the marker "*". */
function dbImports(source: string): string[] {
  const names: string[] = [];
  for (const match of source.matchAll(/\bimport\s+(type\s+)?(\*\s+as\s+\w+|\{[^}]*\})\s+from\s+["'](@korbat\/db(?:\/[^"']*)?)["']/g)) {
    const bindings = match[2]!;
    if (bindings.startsWith("*")) {
      names.push("*");
      continue;
    }
    for (const part of bindings.slice(1, -1).split(",")) {
      const name = part.trim().replace(/^type\s+/, "").split(/\s+as\s+/)[0]!.trim();
      if (name) names.push(name);
    }
  }
  return names;
}

const insideAuth = (path: string) => path.startsWith("auth/");
const insideSocial = (path: string) => path.startsWith("social/");
const insideMedia = (path: string) => path.startsWith("media/");
const insideAccount = (path: string) => path.startsWith("account/");
const insideStaff = (path: string) => path.startsWith("staff/");
const insideModeration = (path: string) => path.startsWith("moderation/");

function findViolations(files: SourceFile[], publicNames: Set<string>, authNames: Set<string>): string[] {
  const violations: string[] = [];
  for (const { path, source } of files) {
    for (const spec of specifiers(source)) {
      if (!spec.startsWith(".")) continue;
      const target = posix.normalize(posix.join(posix.dirname(path), spec)).replace(/\.ts$/, "");
      for (const module of MODULES) {
        if (path.startsWith(`${module}/`)) continue;
        if (target.startsWith(`${module}/`) && target !== `${module}/index`) {
          violations.push(`${path}: imports ${spec}, which is inside the ${module} module (use ./${module})`);
        }
      }
    }
    if (!insideAuth(path) && !AUTH_POOL_ALLOWED.has(path) && /\b(DATABASE_URL_AUTH|authDb)\b/.test(source)) {
      violations.push(`${path}: references the auth database pool`);
    }
    // Each encryption key with the list of the keys it replaced: after a rotation those still open what was stored before it.
    if (!insideAuth(path) && !AUTH_KEYS_ALLOWED.has(path) && /\b(TOTP_ENC_KEY|TOTP_ENC_KEYS_PREVIOUS|NOTIFIER_ENC_KEY|NOTIFIER_ENC_KEYS_PREVIOUS|AUTH_HMAC_KEY|IP_HASH_KEY)\b/.test(source)) {
      violations.push(`${path}: references an auth key`);
    }
    if (insideAuth(path)) {
      for (const name of dbImports(source)) {
        if (name === "*") violations.push(`${path}: namespace import of @korbat/db (import auth-schema names explicitly)`);
        else if (publicNames.has(name)) violations.push(`${path}: imports public-schema ${name} from @korbat/db`);
      }
    }
    if (!insideMedia(path) && /\b(postMedia|post_media)\b/.test(source)) {
      violations.push(`${path}: references post_media, which only the media module may touch`);
    }
    // The staff module (role korbat_api) reads and writes the public audit log; staff keys, staff sessions and enrolments
    // are credentials, the auth module's alone (3a design, section 5). The moderation module owns the moderation tables on
    // the same role: a notifier's contact and the staff links live in the auth schema, out of its reach (3c design, section 5).
    if (insideSocial(path) || insideMedia(path) || insideStaff(path) || insideModeration(path)) {
      for (const name of dbImports(source)) {
        if (name === "*") violations.push(`${path}: namespace import of @korbat/db (import public-schema names explicitly)`);
        else if (authNames.has(name)) violations.push(`${path}: imports auth-schema ${name} from @korbat/db`);
      }
    }
    // The account module sequences the other three through their index files and holds no table access of its own
    // (1b spec, section 5): no table or enum of either schema may be named in it. Db and DbTx, which are not schema
    // names, stay allowed, since a transaction is passed through it.
    if (insideAccount(path)) {
      for (const name of dbImports(source)) {
        if (name === "*") violations.push(`${path}: namespace import of @korbat/db (the account module holds no table access)`);
        else if (publicNames.has(name)) violations.push(`${path}: imports public-schema ${name} from @korbat/db (the account module holds no table access)`);
        else if (authNames.has(name)) violations.push(`${path}: imports auth-schema ${name} from @korbat/db (the account module holds no table access)`);
      }
    }
    // The staff module uses the auth module's interface as the other modules do, never its repository or its session
    // store, which would hand it the auth tables; the moderation module likewise. Any mention counts, so a renamed,
    // namespace or dynamic import is caught as surely as a named one.
    if (insideStaff(path) || insideModeration(path)) {
      const module = insideStaff(path) ? "staff" : "moderation";
      for (const name of new Set([...source.matchAll(/\b(createAuthRepo|createSessions)\b/g)].map((m) => m[1]!))) {
        violations.push(`${path}: uses the auth module's ${name} (the ${module} module goes through the auth module's interface)`);
      }
    }
  }
  return violations;
}

/**
 * The source pins of the freeze (3c design, sections 6.1 and 6.5). The freeze of the path for suspected child sexual abuse
 * material holds only while every path of a kind passes one gate, so who may name what is pinned here, beside the
 * database's own pins of who names the predicate there:
 *   - `post_frozen` is named only in the media repository and the moderation repository, and `frozen_for` nowhere in the
 *     API: no other file decides by itself what is frozen;
 *   - a delete of `post_media` is written only in the media repository, whose every delete the keep trigger judges and
 *     whose every answer names only rows that are gone;
 *   - `requestDeletion` (asking the worker to delete an image's files) and `openImage` (opening an image file of the
 *     store) are named in a pinned list of files, each a pinned number of times, comments included: a new caller of
 *     either fails the test until whoever adds it has checked it against the gates and listed it.
 */
const POST_FROZEN_ALLOWED = new Set(["media/repo.ts", "moderation/repo.ts"]);
const POST_MEDIA_DELETE_ALLOWED = new Set(["media/repo.ts"]);
const POST_MEDIA_DELETE = /\bdelete\s+from\s+(?:only\s+)?(?:"?public"?\s*\.\s*)?"?post_media\b|\btruncate\b[^;`]*\bpost_media\b|\.delete\(\s*postMedia\b/i;

function findFreezeViolations(files: SourceFile[]): string[] {
  const violations: string[] = [];
  for (const { path, source } of files) {
    if (/\bfrozen_for\b/.test(source)) violations.push(`${path}: names frozen_for, which only the database's own functions name`);
    if (/\bpost_frozen\b/.test(source) && !POST_FROZEN_ALLOWED.has(path)) violations.push(`${path}: names post_frozen, which only the media and moderation repositories may`);
    if (POST_MEDIA_DELETE.test(source) && !POST_MEDIA_DELETE_ALLOWED.has(path)) violations.push(`${path}: deletes from post_media, which only the media repository may`);
  }
  return violations;
}

/** Every file that names `name` as a whole word, with how often, comments included. */
function mentions(files: SourceFile[], name: string): Record<string, number> {
  const found: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const { path, source } of files) {
    // Cut at every word boundary: a whole word is then a piece of its own.
    const count = source.split(/\b/).filter((piece) => piece === name).length;
    if (count > 0) found[path] = count;
  }
  return found;
}

/**
 * Where `requestDeletion` is named. A deletion request names an id that a delete of post_media answered, an upload that
 * failed before it could be put on a post, or a file that has no row: the files module writes the request; the upload's
 * removal, the sweeper, the author's deletion (after its commit), the account's purge (after its commit) and the
 * disposal's caller (after its commit) ask for it through the module's interfaces; and the one retry of what the purge
 * and the disposal owe asks for it only for a row that is gone.
 */
const REQUEST_DELETION = {
  "account/flows/deletion.ts": 1,
  "media/cases.ts": 4,
  "media/context.ts": 2,
  "media/files.ts": 1,
  "media/flows/remove.ts": 1,
  "media/index.ts": 5,
  // The retry of owed deletions, which asks only for ids whose row it found gone.
  "media/owed.ts": 1,
  "media/sweeper.ts": 2,
  // The retention job, which asks for a batch's files after the commit of the transaction that deleted their rows.
  "moderation/retention.ts": 1,
  "social/context.ts": 1,
  "social/flows/posts.ts": 1,
};

/**
 * Where `openImage` is named: the files module, which opens a file of the store under its checks, and its three callers,
 * each behind its own reader's rule: serve (gate S), the export's open (which reads the row again) and the staff's image
 * (gate V).
 */
const OPEN_IMAGE = {
  "media/cases.ts": 1,
  "media/files.ts": 1,
  "media/flows/serve.ts": 1,
  "media/index.ts": 1,
};

describe("the freeze's source pins", () => {
  test("apps/api/src names post_frozen only in the two repositories, frozen_for nowhere, and deletes from post_media only in the media repository", () => {
    expect(findFreezeViolations(loadSources())).toEqual([]);
    // The media repository does name the predicate and does delete: the pins are about a file that exists.
    const repo = loadSources().find((file) => file.path === "media/repo.ts")!;
    expect(repo.source).toMatch(/\bpost_frozen\b/);
    expect(POST_MEDIA_DELETE.test(repo.source)).toBe(true);
  });

  test("catches the predicate named outside the two repositories, and its core named anywhere", () => {
    const files: SourceFile[] = [
      { path: "media/repo.ts", source: "sql`select public.post_frozen(m.post_id) as frozen from post_media m`" },
      { path: "moderation/repo.ts", source: "sql`select not public.post_frozen(${postId}::uuid) as images_allowed`" },
      { path: "moderation/cases.ts", source: "const [row] = await tx.execute(sql`select public.post_frozen(${postId}::uuid) as frozen`);" },
      { path: "media/flows/serve.ts", source: "const frozen = await db.execute(sql`select post_frozen(${postId})`);" },
      { path: "staff/cases.ts", source: "await db.execute(sql`select public.frozen_for(${postId}::uuid, ${authorId}::uuid)`);" },
      { path: "media/repo.ts", source: "sql`select public.frozen_for(m.post_id, m.owner_id) from post_media m`" },
      // Another word that only contains the name is not the name.
      { path: "social/views.ts", source: "const post_frozen_label = 1; const unfrozen_for_now = 2;" },
    ];
    expect(findFreezeViolations(files)).toEqual([
      "moderation/cases.ts: names post_frozen, which only the media and moderation repositories may",
      "media/flows/serve.ts: names post_frozen, which only the media and moderation repositories may",
      "staff/cases.ts: names frozen_for, which only the database's own functions name",
      "media/repo.ts: names frozen_for, which only the database's own functions name",
    ]);
  });

  test("catches a delete of post_media outside the media repository, in SQL and through the query builder", () => {
    const files: SourceFile[] = [
      { path: "media/repo.ts", source: "await tx.execute(sql`delete from post_media where id in (select id from post_media where post_id = ${postId}::uuid order by id for update) returning id`);\nawait db.delete(postMedia).where(eq(postMedia.id, id));" },
      { path: "media/sweeper.ts", source: "await db.execute(sql`delete from post_media where post_id is null and created_at < ${before}`);" },
      { path: "media/flows/remove.ts", source: "await deps.db.delete(postMedia).where(eq(postMedia.id, id));" },
      { path: "media/cases.ts", source: 'await tx.execute(sql`DELETE FROM "public"."post_media" WHERE "id" = ${id}`);' },
      { path: "media/index.ts", source: "await tx.execute(sql`truncate table post_media cascade`);" },
      // Reading and updating image rows, and deleting something else, is not a delete of image rows.
      { path: "media/flows/status.ts", source: "await db.update(postMedia).set({ status }).where(eq(postMedia.id, id));\nawait db.delete(posts).where(eq(posts.id, id));\nconst rows = await db.execute(sql`select id from post_media`);" },
    ];
    expect(findFreezeViolations(files)).toEqual([
      "media/sweeper.ts: deletes from post_media, which only the media repository may",
      "media/flows/remove.ts: deletes from post_media, which only the media repository may",
      "media/cases.ts: deletes from post_media, which only the media repository may",
      "media/index.ts: deletes from post_media, which only the media repository may",
    ]);
  });

  test("requestDeletion and openImage are named in exactly the pinned files, each the pinned number of times", () => {
    expect(mentions(loadSources(), "requestDeletion")).toEqual(REQUEST_DELETION);
    expect(mentions(loadSources(), "openImage")).toEqual(OPEN_IMAGE);
  });

  test("catches a new caller of either, in a file of the list and in one outside it", () => {
    const real = loadSources();
    // A second request in the purge's flow, and a first one in a file that had none.
    const withCallers = real
      .map((file) => (file.path === "account/flows/deletion.ts" ? { ...file, source: `${file.source}\nawait deps.media.requestDeletion(kept);` } : file))
      .concat([{ path: "moderation/decide.ts", source: "await deps.media.requestDeletion(ids);" }]);
    expect(mentions(withCallers, "requestDeletion")).not.toEqual(REQUEST_DELETION);
    expect(mentions(withCallers, "requestDeletion")).toMatchObject({ "account/flows/deletion.ts": 2, "moderation/decide.ts": 1 });
    // A fourth opener of the store's files.
    const withOpener = real.concat([{ path: "staff/cases.ts", source: 'const file = await files.openImage(id, "large");' }]);
    expect(mentions(withOpener, "openImage")).not.toEqual(OPEN_IMAGE);
    // A name that only contains the word is not counted.
    expect(mentions([{ path: "x.ts", source: "requestDeletions(); reopenImage(); openImages();" }], "requestDeletion")).toEqual({});
    expect(mentions([{ path: "x.ts", source: "requestDeletions(); reopenImage(); openImages();" }], "openImage")).toEqual({});
  });
});

/**
 * The source pins of account sanctions (3e design, sections 11 and 12.2; invariant 23): no write of an account is added
 * without the one predicate.
 *   - The predicate's three fragments, exported by lib/standing.ts (`liveNotSuspended`, and the two halves that a locking
 *     statement answers separately, `suspendedAt` and `reportsRestrictedAt`), are named in a pinned list of files, each a
 *     pinned number of times, comments included, as REQUEST_DELETION is: whoever adds a write on behalf of an account adds
 *     its site to the list, and the auth module never names one. So is the closing judgment (`closingJudgment`, 3e's
 *     review), the last statement of a write's transaction, which reads both halves.
 *   - The profile's three derived columns are named in apps/api/src only in lib/standing.ts, social/repo.ts's
 *     lockAccounts and the moderation module's standing-repo.ts, in SQL or by drizzle's names: no other file decides by
 *     itself whether an account is suspended. Their one writer is the database's standing_apply (the function pin of 6.6).
 */
const STANDING_PREDICATE = {
  // social/repo.ts, 3e Task 6: Explore's round applies the predicate to the candidates' authors and to the engagers at the
  // round's time, and the page and the chip to the authors at the read's (explorePage, listedInExplore).
  liveNotSuspended: { "lib/standing.ts": 1, "media/repo.ts": 2, "profiles/store.ts": 3, "social/repo.ts": 6 },
  // social/repo.ts, 3e Task 6: the author's Explore status reads whether the author is suspended (exploreFacts). lib/standing.ts,
  // 3e's review: the closing judgment reads both halves.
  suspendedAt: { "lib/standing.ts": 3, "social/repo.ts": 7 },
  reportsRestrictedAt: { "lib/standing.ts": 2, "social/repo.ts": 2 },
  // 3e's review (database1): the writes that end with the closing judgment: the social repository's (judgeActing), the
  // upload's row, and the intake of a report under a rule. The profile store's badge and the profile's edit end with
  // their UPDATE, made once the row is held.
  closingJudgment: { "lib/standing.ts": 1, "media/repo.ts": 2, "moderation/intake.ts": 2, "social/repo.ts": 2 },
};
const STANDING_COLUMNS_ALLOWED = new Set(["lib/standing.ts", "social/repo.ts", "moderation/standing-repo.ts"]);
const STANDING_COLUMNS = ["suspended_from", "suspended_until", "reports_restricted_until", "suspendedFrom", "suspendedUntil", "reportsRestrictedUntil"];
/** Whether a file names one of the derived columns as a whole word, by the same cut as `mentions`. */
const namesStandingColumn = (file: SourceFile): boolean => STANDING_COLUMNS.some((name) => mentions([file], name)[file.path] !== undefined);

function findStandingViolations(files: SourceFile[]): string[] {
  return files.filter((file) => namesStandingColumn(file) && !STANDING_COLUMNS_ALLOWED.has(file.path)).map(({ path }) => `${path}: names a derived column of an account's standing, which only lib/standing.ts, social/repo.ts and moderation/standing-repo.ts may`);
}

describe("the source pins of account sanctions (3e)", () => {
  test("the predicate's fragments are named in exactly the pinned files, each the pinned number of times; the auth module names none", () => {
    for (const [name, pinned] of Object.entries(STANDING_PREDICATE)) expect(mentions(loadSources(), name), name).toEqual(pinned);
    // The auth module names none: no file of it is in any of the pinned lists.
    for (const pinned of Object.values(STANDING_PREDICATE)) expect(Object.keys(pinned).filter((path) => path.startsWith("auth/"))).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("catches a new write that names the predicate, in a pinned file and in one outside the list", () => {
    const real = loadSources();
    const withWrites = real
      .map((file) => (file.path === "media/repo.ts" ? { ...file, source: file.source + String.fromCharCode(10) + 'sql`update post_media set alt = null where ${liveNotSuspended("p", WRITE_CLOCK)}`;' } : file))
      .concat([{ path: "moderation/texts.ts", source: 'await tx.execute(sql`select 1 from profiles p where ${suspendedAt("p", WRITE_CLOCK)}`);' }]);
    expect(mentions(withWrites, "liveNotSuspended")).not.toEqual(STANDING_PREDICATE.liveNotSuspended);
    expect(mentions(withWrites, "liveNotSuspended")).toMatchObject({ "media/repo.ts": 3 });
    expect(mentions(withWrites, "suspendedAt")).toMatchObject({ "moderation/texts.ts": 1 });
    expect(mentions(withWrites, "suspendedAt")).not.toEqual(STANDING_PREDICATE.suspendedAt);
  });

  test("the three derived columns are named only in lib/standing.ts, social/repo.ts and moderation/standing-repo.ts, and lib/standing.ts does name them", () => {
    expect(findStandingViolations(loadSources())).toEqual([]);
    expect(namesStandingColumn(loadSources().find((file) => file.path === "lib/standing.ts")!)).toBe(true);
  });

  test("catches a derived column named elsewhere, in SQL and by drizzle's name", () => {
    const files: SourceFile[] = [
      { path: "lib/standing.ts", source: "sql`(${p}.suspended_from is not null and ${p}.suspended_from <= ${at} and ${at} < ${p}.suspended_until)`" },
      { path: "moderation/standing-repo.ts", source: "sql`select reports_restricted_until from profiles`" },
      { path: "social/flows/posts.ts", source: "const [row] = await db.execute(sql`select suspended_until from profiles where id = ${viewer}::uuid`);" },
      { path: "media/repo.ts", source: "await db.select({ until: profiles.suspendedUntil }).from(profiles);" },
      { path: "auth/flows/badge.ts", source: "if (profile.reportsRestrictedUntil) return;" },
      // A word that only contains the name is not the name.
      { path: "social/views.ts", source: "const unsuspended_from_now = 1;" },
    ];
    expect(findStandingViolations(files)).toEqual([
      "social/flows/posts.ts: names a derived column of an account's standing, which only lib/standing.ts, social/repo.ts and moderation/standing-repo.ts may",
      "media/repo.ts: names a derived column of an account's standing, which only lib/standing.ts, social/repo.ts and moderation/standing-repo.ts may",
      "auth/flows/badge.ts: names a derived column of an account's standing, which only lib/standing.ts, social/repo.ts and moderation/standing-repo.ts may",
    ]);
  });
});

describe("module boundaries", () => {
  test("walks the real source tree", () => {
    const paths = loadSources().map((f) => f.path);
    expect(paths).toContain("auth/index.ts");
    expect(paths).toContain("social/index.ts");
    expect(paths).toContain("media/index.ts");
    expect(paths).toContain("account/index.ts");
    expect(paths).toContain("staff/index.ts");
    expect(paths).toContain("moderation/index.ts");
    expect(paths).toContain("cli/staff.ts");
    expect(paths).toContain("app.ts");
    expect(publicSchemaNames()).toContain("profiles");
    expect(publicSchemaNames()).not.toContain("users");
    expect(authSchemaNames()).toContain("users");
    expect(authSchemaNames()).not.toContain("posts");
  });

  test("apps/api/src has no boundary violations", () => {
    expect(findViolations(loadSources(), publicSchemaNames(), authSchemaNames())).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("allows the module indexes, the permitted pool owners and each module's own schema", () => {
    const files: SourceFile[] = [
      { path: "app.ts", source: `import { createAuth } from "./auth";\nimport type { Auth } from "./auth/index";\nimport { createSocial } from "./social";` },
      { path: "profiles/store.ts", source: `import { isUniqueViolation } from "../auth";` },
      { path: "cli/grant-role.ts", source: `const authDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_AUTH);` },
      { path: "index.ts", source: `const authDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_AUTH);` },
      { path: "config.ts", source: `AUTH_HMAC_KEY: base64Key, IP_HASH_KEY: base64Key, TOTP_ENC_KEY: versionedKey, DATABASE_URL_AUTH: url` },
      { path: "auth/repo.ts", source: `import { users, sessions, type Db } from "@korbat/db";\nconst k = config.TOTP_ENC_KEY;` },
      { path: "social/repo.ts", source: `import { posts, profiles, type Db } from "@korbat/db";\nimport { SocialError } from "./context";` },
      { path: "social/routes.ts", source: `import type { Auth } from "../auth";` },
      { path: "index.ts", source: `import { createAccount } from "./account";\nimport { createMedia } from "./media";` },
      { path: "account/routes.ts", source: `import type { AuthForAccount } from "../auth";\nimport type { SocialForAccount } from "../social";\nimport { buildExport } from "./flows/export";` },
      { path: "account/flows/deletion.ts", source: `import type { DbTx } from "@korbat/db";\nimport type { MediaForAccount } from "../../media";` },
      { path: "cli/staff.ts", source: `import { createStaff } from "../staff";\nconst authDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_AUTH);` },
      { path: "staff/audit.ts", source: `import { auditHead, auditLog, profiles, type Db, type DbTx } from "@korbat/db";` },
      { path: "staff/routes.ts", source: `import { AuthError, type Auth } from "../auth";\nimport { staffGate } from "./gate";` },
```

### Replace `apps/api/test/integration/http-badge.test.ts` (whole file)

```ts
import { randomBytes, randomInt, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import pino from "pino";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { BadgeVerifyResponse, ErrorEnvelope, FlowResponse, MeResponse, ProfileView } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { closeDb, createDb, type Db } from "@korbat/db";
import { createApp } from "../../src/app";
import { createAuth, type Auth } from "../../src/auth";
import { randomToken, sha256Hex } from "../../src/auth/crypto";
import { phoneHash } from "../../src/auth/identifiers";
import { MemoryKv } from "../../src/auth/kv";
import { DEV_CODE, devProvider } from "../../src/auth/verify/dev";
import { loadConfig, type Config } from "../../src/config";
import { MemoryMailer } from "../../src/mail/memory";
import { MemoryStore } from "../../src/middleware/rate-limit";
import { createProfileStore } from "../../src/profiles/store";
import { createSocial } from "../../src/social";
import { Browser } from "./http-client";
import { liftRowForTest, moderationCounts, suspendRowForTest } from "./moderation-fixtures";

type App = ReturnType<typeof createApp>;

const newHandle = () => `b${randomBytes(4).toString("hex")}`;
/** A distinct number per use, so the per-number limit of one test never reaches another. */
const newPhone = () => `+4477${String(randomInt(10_000_000, 100_000_000))}`;

/**
 * The badge routes through the real app: 1a sign-up for the accounts, cookie sessions with CSRF, the
 * auth module's freshness check, the development provider, the real profile store (so /me and the
 * public profile read verified_at) and the unique index on the phone hash.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the verified badge over HTTP", () => {
  let config: Config;
  let authDb: Db;
  let apiDb: Db;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let auth: Auth;
  let app: App;
  /** The same server with the provider off, as a korbat without an SMS account runs. */
  let appOff: App;
  const mailer = new MemoryMailer();

  let before: Record<string, number>;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    config = loadConfig();
    const logger = pino({ level: "silent" });
    authDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_AUTH, { max: 4 });
    apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 4 });
    // 3e: only the migrator writes a suspension into a profile row, as the ledger's standing_apply does.
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 1 });
    const shared = { config, logger, authDb, mailer, turnstile: { verify: async () => true }, breachChecker: { isBreached: async () => false } };
    auth = createAuth({ ...shared, kv: new MemoryKv(), profiles: createProfileStore(apiDb), verify: devProvider() });
    const rateLimitStore = new MemoryStore();
    const social = createSocial({ apiDb, rateLimitStore, logger, requireSession: auth.requireSession, requireFreshAuth: auth.requireFreshAuth(), events: { append: auth.appendEvent } });
    app = createApp({ config, logger, rateLimitStore, healthChecks: {}, auth, social });
    const authOff = createAuth({ ...shared, kv: new MemoryKv(), profiles: createProfileStore(apiDb) });
    appOff = createApp({ config, logger, rateLimitStore: new MemoryStore(), healthChecks: {}, auth: authOff });
    before = await moderationCounts(apiDb);
  });
  afterAll(async () => {
    await Promise.all([closeDb(authDb), closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
  });

  /** A signed-in web account on the given app, onboarded unless told otherwise. */
  async function signUp(on: App = app, onboard = true) {
    const b = new Browser(on, config.APP_ORIGIN);
    const email = `badge-${randomUUID()}@korbat.local`;
    const handle = newHandle();
    const start = await b.fetch("/api/auth/email/start", { json: { email, turnstileToken: "ok", deviceId: randomToken(), platform: "web" } });
    expect(start.status).toBe(200);
    const { flowId } = FlowResponse.parse(await start.json());
    expect((await b.fetch("/api/auth/email/verify", { json: { flowId, code: mailer.lastCodeFor(email) } })).status).toBe(200);
    expect((await b.fetch("/api/auth/signup/complete", { json: { flowId, dateOfBirth: "1990-05-17", termsVersion: config.TERMS_VERSION } })).status).toBe(200);
    if (onboard) expect((await b.fetch("/api/auth/onboarding/handle", { json: { handle, displayName: `User ${handle}` } })).status).toBe(200);
    const me = MeResponse.parse(await (await b.fetch("/api/me")).json());
    return { b, email, handle, userId: me.user.id };
  }

  const errorCode = async (res: Response) => ErrorEnvelope.parse(await res.json()).error.code;
  /** The session's only factor is the sign-up's email code; moved ten minutes back, nothing within the window is left, so the freshness check fails. */
  async function makeStale(b: Browser) {
    const sessionId = sha256Hex(b.cookie("__Host-korbat_session")!);
    await auth.deps.repo.writeFactor(sessionId, "email", new Date(Date.now() - 10 * 60_000));
    await auth.deps.kv.del(`sess:2:${sessionId}`);
  }
  const eventTypes = async (userId: string) => (await auth.deps.repo.recentEvents(userId)).map((e) => e.type);
  const verifiedOnMe = async (b: Browser) => MeResponse.parse(await (await b.fetch("/api/me")).json()).profile!.verified;
  const verifiedInPublic = async (handle: string) => ProfileView.parse(await (await app.request(`/api/profiles/${handle}`)).json()).verified;
  const storedHash = async (userId: string) => (await auth.deps.repo.findUserById(userId))!.phoneHash;
  const mailsTo = (email: string) => mailer.sent.filter((m) => m.to === email).map((m) => m.template);

  /** Starts a verification for the number and returns the flow id. */
  async function start(b: Browser, phone: string) {
    const res = await b.fetch("/api/auth/badge/start", { json: { phone } });
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    return FlowResponse.parse(await res.json()).flowId;
  }
  const verify = (b: Browser, flowId: string, code: string) => b.fetch("/api/auth/badge/verify", { json: { flowId, code } });

  test("all three routes need an onboarded, fresh session", async () => {
    const routes = [
      ["POST", "/api/auth/badge/start", { phone: newPhone() }],
      ["POST", "/api/auth/badge/verify", { flowId: randomToken(), code: DEV_CODE }],
      ["DELETE", "/api/auth/badge", undefined],
    ] as const;
    for (const [method, path, body] of routes) {
      const anonymous = await app.request(path, { method, headers: { "content-type": "application/json" }, body: body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body) });
      expect(anonymous.status, path).toBe(401);
      expect(await errorCode(anonymous), path).toBe("unauthenticated");
    }
    const notOnboarded = await signUp(app, false);
    for (const [method, path, body] of routes) {
      const early = await notOnboarded.b.fetch(path, { method, json: body });
      expect(early.status, path).toBe(403);
      expect(await errorCode(early), path).toBe("onboarding_required");
    }
    const stale = await signUp();
    await makeStale(stale.b);
    for (const [method, path, body] of routes) {
      const refused = await stale.b.fetch(path, { method, json: body });
      expect(refused.status, path).toBe(403);
      expect(await errorCode(refused), path).toBe("reauth_required");
    }
  });

  test("the development provider end to end: a wrong code, the right one, the badge on /me and the public profile, the notices and events, then removal", async () => {
    const ada = await signUp();
    const phone = newPhone();
    const malformed = await ada.b.fetch("/api/auth/badge/start", { json: { phone: "0044 7911" } });
    expect(malformed.status).toBe(400);
    expect(await errorCode(malformed)).toBe("invalid_request");
    const flowId = await start(ada.b, phone);
    const wrong = await verify(ada.b, flowId, "123456");
    expect(wrong.status).toBe(400);
    expect(await errorCode(wrong)).toBe("invalid_code");
    expect(await verifiedOnMe(ada.b)).toBe(false);

    const right = await verify(ada.b, flowId, DEV_CODE);
    expect(right.status).toBe(200);
    expect(BadgeVerifyResponse.parse(await right.json())).toEqual({ verified: true });
    expect(await verifiedOnMe(ada.b)).toBe(true);
    expect(await verifiedInPublic(ada.handle)).toBe(true);
    expect(await storedHash(ada.userId)).toBe(phoneHash(auth.deps.config.authHmacKey, phone));
    expect(mailsTo(ada.email).at(-1)).toBe("badge_verified");
    expect(await eventTypes(ada.userId)).toContain("badge_verified");
    const replay = await verify(ada.b, flowId, DEV_CODE);
    expect(replay.status).toBe(400);
    expect(await errorCode(replay)).toBe("invalid_code");

    expect((await ada.b.fetch("/api/auth/badge", { method: "DELETE" })).status).toBe(204);
    expect(await verifiedOnMe(ada.b)).toBe(false);
    expect(await verifiedInPublic(ada.handle)).toBe(false);
    expect(await storedHash(ada.userId)).toBeNull();
    expect(mailsTo(ada.email).at(-1)).toBe("badge_removed");
    expect(await eventTypes(ada.userId)).toContain("badge_removed");
    // Removing a badge the account does not hold answers the same and tells nobody.
    const before = mailer.sent.length;
    expect((await ada.b.fetch("/api/auth/badge", { method: "DELETE" })).status).toBe(204);
    expect(mailer.sent).toHaveLength(before);
    // Nothing that left the server carries the number.

    expect(await verifiedOnMe(ada.b)).toBe(true);

    expect(verified.status).toBe(404);
```

```ts
/**
 * Rows for the database tests of the moderation tables (3c design, sections 6.1 and 6.2), written as SQL the way the
 * intake transaction writes them: an insert names only what the API supplies, and the triggers of migrations 0015 and
 * 0016 force the rest. The helpers take a pool or a transaction, so a test chooses the role and whether anything commits.
 * The suites share one database, so a test leaves nothing behind: it runs inside a transaction that is rolled back, or,
 * where a second session must see its rows, it commits them and removes them again with removeFixtures.
 */
export type Runner = Db | DbTx;
export type TargetType = "post" | "account";

export const TC = "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC";
export const MINORS = "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS";
export const SPEECH = "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ILLEGAL_OR_HARMFUL_SPEECH";

/** 32 random bytes as lower-case hex: a salt, a digest's stand-in or a token's hash. */
export const hex64 = () => randomBytes(32).toString("hex");

/** A public reference as the API makes it: N- and ten base32 characters. */
export function newRef(): string {
  const alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ234567";
  return `N-${Array.from(randomBytes(10), (byte) => alphabet[byte % 32]).join("")}`;
}

/** Null as SQL, any other value as a parameter. */
const orNull = (value: string | null | undefined, cast: string): SQL => (value === null || value === undefined ? sql`null` : sql`${value}::${sql.raw(cast)}`);

/** Ids as one uuid[] parameter. */
export const uuids = (ids: readonly string[]): SQL => sql`${`{${ids.join(",")}}`}::uuid[]`;

/**
 * A post row straight in the table: these tests need the row, not the flow and its counters. It is dated a month back.
 * The suites share one database, and others read the public Latest timeline from its newest post down and Explore's
 * 48-hour window: a visible post dated now would stand among theirs, and dozens of them push theirs off the first page.
 */
export async function newPostRow(db: Runner, authorId: string, options: { quoteOfId?: string; replyToId?: string; body?: string; createdAt?: SQL } = {}): Promise<string> {
  const [row] = await db.execute<{ id: string }>(
    sql`insert into posts (author_id, body, quote_of_id, reply_to_id, created_at)
        values (${authorId}::uuid, ${options.body ?? "a post"}, ${orNull(options.quoteOfId, "uuid")}, ${orNull(options.replyToId, "uuid")}, ${options.createdAt ?? sql`now() - interval '30 days'`})
        returning id`,
  );
  return row!.id;
}

/**
 * A ready image of the account, on the post when one is given. The row is inserted on no post, which is the only way the
 * database takes one, and then attached with one update of post_id, position and alt text, as the media repository's
 * attach does.
 */
export async function newImageRow(db: Runner, ownerId: string, postId: string | null, position = 0): Promise<string> {
  const [row] = await db.execute<{ id: string }>(
    sql`insert into post_media (owner_id, status, width, height, blurhash) values (${ownerId}::uuid, 'ready', 1200, 800, 'L2Eo_P_3jb_3~qoL') returning id`,
  );
  if (postId) await db.execute(sql`update post_media set post_id = ${postId}::uuid, position = ${position}, alt_text = ${`image ${position + 1}`} where id = ${row!.id}::uuid`);
  return row!.id;
}

/** Inserts an intake with the ground's columns, as step 4.2 of the intake transaction does, and answers its id. */
export async function insertIntake(db: Runner, input: IntakeInput): Promise<string> {

    insert into intakes (kind, ref, lookup_hash, channel, reporter_id, finding_by, contact_id, rule_id, alleges_illegal, csam, category, category_keyword, cited_law, explanation, bona_fide)
    values (${input.kind ?? "user"}::intake_kind, ${input.ref ?? newRef()}, ${orNull(input.lookupHash, "text")}, ${input.channel ?? "signed_in"}::intake_channel,
            ${orNull(input.reporterId, "uuid")}, ${orNull(input.findingBy, "uuid")}, ${orNull(input.contactId, "uuid")}, ${orNull(input.ruleId, "text")},
            ${input.allegesIllegal ?? false}, ${input.csam ?? false}, ${input.category ?? TC}, ${orNull(input.categoryKeyword, "text")},
            ${orNull(input.citedLaw, "text")}, ${orNull(input.explanation, "text")}, ${input.bonaFide ?? false})
    returning id`);
  return row!.id;
}

/**

export async function openCase(db: Runner, targetType: TargetType, targetId: string): Promise<string> {

  if (!row) throw new Error("the target has no open case");
  return row.id;

/** Inserts one item and answers the row as the attach trigger left it. */
export async function insertItem(db: Runner, input: ItemInput): Promise<ItemRow> {
  const extra = Object.entries(input.extra ?? {});
  const names = extra.map(([name]) => sql.raw(`, ${name}`));
  const values = extra.map(([, value]) => sql`, ${value}`);
  const [row] = await db.execute<ItemRow & Record<string, unknown>>(sql`
    insert ${sql.raw(input.marker ? `/* ${input.marker} */` : "")} into intake_items (intake_id, case_id, target_type, target_id, position, lane, named_handle, outcome, reexamines_item_id${sql.join(names, sql``)})
    values (${input.intakeId}::uuid, ${orNull(input.caseId, "uuid")}, ${input.targetType ?? "post"}::moderation_target, ${input.targetId}::uuid, ${input.position ?? 1}, ${input.lane ?? 2},
            ${orNull(input.namedHandle, "text")}, ${orNull(input.outcome, "item_outcome")}, ${orNull(input.reexaminesItemId, "uuid")}${sql.join(values, sql``)})
    returning *`);
  return row!;
}

}

  return row!;
}

/** The items of a case, in the order they attached. */
```
