  describe("a report of child sexual abuse material that commits while a seal's decision waits for its first lock", () => {
    const SEAL: DecisionInput = { kind: "interim", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] };
    const settled = <T>(promise: Promise<T>) => promise.then((value) => value as unknown, (err: unknown) => err);

    test("the seal would not be in force for the only report it rests on: the confirmation is refused as case_changed with nothing stored and nothing mailed, and confirmed again it seals, leaves no served image and mails its author once", async () => {
      // A world with the real auth module and a mailer, so that what follows a commit can be seen: the statement's mail.
      const w = noticesWorld();
      const mailing = deciderWorld(w.apiDb, { auth: w.authForModeration });
      try {
        const member = await mailing.staff("moderator");
        const [author, reporter] = [await w.account(), await w.account()];
        const postId = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id);
        const mediaIds = [await newImageRow(w.apiDb, author.id, postId, 0)];
        const caseId = (await recordIntake(w.deps, { ground: ground.rule(reporter.id), live: [aPost(postId)] })).items[0]!.caseId!;
        // The seal is confirmed on the case as it stands, holding a rule report; the report it would rest on arrives while it waits.
        const confirmed = await mailing.confirm(member, caseId, await decisionParams(w.apiDb, member, caseId, SEAL));
        const [refused, reported] = await whileHeld(sql`select 1 from profiles where id = ${author.id}::uuid for no key update`, async (letGo) => {
          // The decision's transaction has begun, which fixes its time, and waits for its first lock: the author's row.
          const deciding = settled(mailing.moderation.forStaff.decide(member.session, confirmed, { requestId: `req-${randomUUID()}` }));
          await untilBlocked(apiDb, "from profiles where id = any");
          const arrived = await recordIntake(w.deps, { ground: ground.csam(), live: [aPost(postId)] });
          await letGo();
          return [await deciding, arrived] as const;
        });
        await mailing.moderation.settle();
        expect(reported.items[0]!.caseId).toBe(caseId);
        // The item arrived after the decision's time, so the seal would not be in force: the decision is not recorded at all.
        expect(refused).toBeInstanceOf(ModerationError);
        expect(refused).toMatchObject({ code: "case_changed" });
        const [stored] = await w.migrateDb.execute<{ decisions: number; actions: number; lists: number; audit: number }>(sql`
          select (select count(*)::int from decisions where case_id = ${caseId}::uuid) as decisions,
                 (select count(*)::int from decision_actions a join decisions d on d.id = a.decision_id where d.case_id = ${caseId}::uuid) as actions,
                 (select count(*)::int from seal_posts s where s.post_id = ${postId}::uuid) as lists,
                 (select count(*)::int from audit_log where action = 'case_decided' and target_id = ${caseId}) as audit`);
        expect({ ...stored! }).toEqual({ decisions: 0, actions: 0, lists: 0, audit: 0 });
        expect(await imageStates(w.apiDb, mediaIds)).toEqual(["visible"]);
        // The post is frozen all the same, through the new item, and nobody was told of a seal that never was.
        expect(await postFrozen(w.apiDb, postId)).toBe(true);
        expect(w.mailer.to(author.email, "moderation_decision")).toEqual([]);
        // Once the item is 15 minutes old the dispatch job repeats the urgent lane's alert for it,
        const later = () => new Date(Date.now() + 16 * 60_000);
        expect(await casesCalling(w.deps, later())).toContain(caseId);

        // until the person reads the case again and confirms again, in a transaction that begins after the item.
        expect(await mailing.decideAs(member, caseId, SEAL)).toEqual({ decisionId: expect.any(String) });
        expect(await inForce(w.apiDb, { caseId })).toEqual(["seal_media"]);
        expect(await imageStates(w.apiDb, mediaIds)).toEqual(["sealed"]);
        expect(await casesCalling(w.deps, later())).not.toContain(caseId);
        expect(w.mailer.to(author.email, "moderation_decision").map((mail) => mail.data.subject)).toEqual(["seal_deciding"]);
      } finally {
        await w.cleanUp();
        await mailing.close();
        await w.close();
      }
    });

    test("on a case that already holds an unanswered report of this kind, the seal is accepted and in force: it rests on the earlier report, and covers the images whatever arrives meanwhile", async () => {
      await withReported(
        async ({ authorId, postId, mediaIds, caseId }) => {
          const decide = await prepared(sealer, caseId, SEAL);
          const [sealed, reported] = await whileHeld(sql`select 1 from profiles where id = ${authorId}::uuid for no key update`, async (letGo) => {
            const deciding = settled(decide());
            await untilBlocked(apiDb, "from profiles where id = any");
            const arrived = await recordIntake(world.moderation.deps, { ground: ground.csam(), live: [aPost(postId)] });
            await letGo();
            return [await deciding, arrived] as const;
          });
          expect(reported.items[0]!.caseId).toBe(caseId);
          expect(sealed).toEqual({ decisionId: expect.any(String) });
          const seal = (sealed as { decisionId: string }).decisionId;
          // The second report arrived after the decision's time; the first one, which the seal was taken for, did not.
          const [order] = await apiDb.execute<{ after: boolean; before: boolean }>(sql`
            select (select max(created_at) from intake_items where case_id = ${caseId}::uuid) > (select decided_at from decisions where id = ${seal}::uuid) as after,
                   (select min(created_at) from intake_items where case_id = ${caseId}::uuid) <= (select decided_at from decisions where id = ${seal}::uuid) as before`);
          expect({ ...order! }).toEqual({ after: true, before: true });
          expect((await decisionRow(apiDb, seal)).suspect).toBe(true);
          expect(await inForce(apiDb, { caseId })).toEqual(["seal_media"]);
          expect(await imageStates(apiDb, mediaIds)).toEqual(["sealed"]);
          expect(await postFrozen(apiDb, postId)).toBe(true);
        },
        { images: 1, by: "csam" },
      );
    });
  });

  describe("the check at COMMIT covers every row of the ledger", () => {
    /**
     * A decision's statements as the API issues them, in one transaction of korbat_api that commits: the subject's lock,
     * the decision's row, its ledger rows and, last, the audit row, confirmed by a real key. `after` runs once the audit row
     * is written. Answers what the transaction was refused with, or null when it committed.
     */
    async function committing(made: { authorId: string; caseId: string }, input: DecisionInput, after: (tx: DbTx, decisionId: string) => Promise<void>) {
      const params = await decisionParams(apiDb, admin, made.caseId, input);
      const confirmed = await world.confirm(admin, made.caseId, params);
      const decisionId = randomUUID();
      const refused = await withLockTimeout(apiDb, async (tx) => {
        await tx.execute(sql`select id from profiles where id = ${made.authorId}::uuid for no key update`);
        await insertDecision(tx, { id: decisionId, caseId: made.caseId, decidedBy: admin.id, params });
        for (const action of params.actions) await insertAction(tx, decisionId, action);
        await appendConfirmedAudit(tx, {
          actorId: admin.id,
          keyId: confirmed.keyId,
          action: "case_decided",
          targetType: "case",
          targetId: made.caseId,
          metadata: { params: confirmed.params, decisionId },
          staffSession: admin.session.handle,
          actionHash: confirmed.actionHash,
          stepUp: confirmed.assertion,
          requestId: `req-${randomUUID()}`,
          expiresAt: confirmed.expiresAt,
        });
        await after(tx, decisionId);
      }).then(
        () => null,
        (err: unknown) => raised(err),
      );
      return { decisionId, refused };
    }
    const unlisted = { code: "P0001", message: "invalid_decision", detail: "actions: the decision's measures and reversals are not those the audit row's params list." };

    test("a measure added after the check was made to run early is refused: at once while the checks are immediate, and at COMMIT once they are deferred again", async () => {
      await withReported(
        async (made) => {
          const input: DecisionInput = { kind: "interim", actions: [act("withhold")] };
          const further = act("withhold_media", made.mediaIds[0]!);
          let inserted = false;
          // The checks run early and pass. While they stay immediate, the further row's own check runs with its insert.
          const atOnce = await committing(made, input, async (tx, decisionId) => {
            await tx.execute(sql`set constraints all immediate`);
            await insertAction(tx, decisionId, further);
            inserted = true;
          });
          expect(inserted).toBe(false);
          expect(atOnce.refused).toEqual(unlisted);
          // Deferred again, the insert itself passes, and the check it queued refuses the COMMIT.
          const atCommit = await committing(made, input, async (tx, decisionId) => {
            await tx.execute(sql`set constraints all immediate`);
            await tx.execute(sql`set constraints all deferred`);
            await insertAction(tx, decisionId, further);
            inserted = true;
          });
          expect(inserted).toBe(true);
          expect(atCommit.refused).toEqual(unlisted);
          expect(await decisionsOf(made.caseId)).toBe(0);
          expect(await postRow(apiDb, made.postId)).toMatchObject({ state: "visible", level: "visible" });
          expect(await imageStates(apiDb, made.mediaIds)).toEqual(["visible"]);
        },
        { images: 1 },
      );
    });

    test("the same further measure, inserted before the audit row and listed in its params, commits", async () => {
      await withReported(
        async (made) => {
          const { decisionId, refused } = await committing(made, { kind: "interim", actions: [act("withhold"), act("withhold_media", made.mediaIds[0]!)] }, async (tx) => {
            // Made to run early here too: every row is in the params, so the check passes now as it would at COMMIT.
            await tx.execute(sql`set constraints all immediate`);
          });
          expect(refused).toBeNull();
          const actions = await apiDb.execute<{ kind: string }>(sql`select kind from decision_actions where decision_id = ${decisionId}::uuid order by kind::text`);
          expect(actions.map((row) => row.kind)).toEqual(["withhold", "withhold_media"]);
          expect(await postRow(apiDb, made.postId)).toMatchObject({ state: "withheld", level: "withheld" });
          expect(await imageStates(apiDb, made.mediaIds)).toEqual(["withheld"]);
        },
        { images: 1 },
      );
    });
  });

  describe("append_confirmed_audit: the account, the key and the clock", () => {
    const ended = { code: "P0001", message: "staff_confirmation_ended" };

    test("an account demoted to user, and one taken down, is refused while its key is live; a take-down waits for a call that holds the account's row", async () => {
      await withReported(async ({ postId, caseId }) => {
        const decide = await prepared(takenDown, caseId, { kind: "interim", actions: [act("withhold")] });
        expect(await auditCallRefusal(takenDown)).toBeNull();
        // Demoted to user: the function's account statement refuses, whatever the key.
        await authDb.execute(sql`update auth.users set role = 'user' where id = ${takenDown.id}::uuid`);
        expect(await auditCallRefusal(takenDown)).toEqual(ended);
        await authDb.execute(sql`update auth.users set role = 'moderator' where id = ${takenDown.id}::uuid`);
        expect(await auditCallRefusal(takenDown)).toBeNull();

        // The function takes the account's row itself (no decision's trigger ran here): a take-down that comes while the
        // call's transaction is open waits for it.
        const [held, release] = [gate(), gate()];
        const calling = rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
          await auditCall(tx, takenDown);
          held.open();
          await release.opened;
        });
        await held.opened;
        const takingDown = withLockTimeout(authDb, (tx) => tx.execute(sql`update auth.users set deleted_at = now() where id = ${takenDown.id}::uuid`));
        try {
          await untilBlocked(authDb, "update auth.users");
        } finally {
          release.open();
          await calling;
        }
        await takingDown;

        // Taken down first: a direct call is ended, and so is a decision the key confirmed before, which stores nothing.
        expect(await auditCallRefusal(takenDown)).toEqual(ended);
        expect(await decide()).toBe("ended");
        expect(await decisionsOf(caseId)).toBe(0);
        expect(await postRow(apiDb, postId)).toMatchObject({ state: "visible", level: "visible" });
      });
    });

    test("the call takes the account's row before the key's, as the real revocation does, so the two cannot deadlock in either order", async () => {
      const probe = (statement: ReturnType<typeof sql>) => pgError(withLockTimeout(authDb, (tx) => tx.execute(statement)));
      /** Runs a direct call while a transaction of the auth role holds what `lock` takes; `during` runs once the call waits. */
      async function callBehind(lock: ReturnType<typeof sql>, during: () => Promise<void>) {
        const [held, release] = [gate(), gate()];
        const holder = withLockTimeout(authDb, async (tx) => {
          await tx.execute(lock);
          held.open();
          await release.opened;
        });
        await held.opened;
        const calling = auditCallRefusal(ordered);
        try {
          await untilBlocked(apiDb, "append_confirmed_audit");
          await during();
        } finally {
          release.open();
          await holder;
        }
        expect(await calling).toBeNull();
      }
      // The key's row held: the call waits for it, and already holds the account's row.
      await callBehind(sql`select 1 from auth.staff_keys where id = ${ordered.keyId}::uuid for update`, async () => {
        expect((await probe(sql`select 1 from auth.users where id = ${ordered.id}::uuid for update nowait`))?.code).toBe("55P03");
      });
      // The account's row held: the call waits for it, and has not touched the key's row.
      await callBehind(sql`select 1 from auth.users where id = ${ordered.id}::uuid for update`, async () => {
        expect(await probe(sql`select 1 from auth.staff_keys where id = ${ordered.keyId}::uuid for update nowait`)).toBeNull();
      });

      // The real revocation, started while a call holds both rows, waits at its first lock, the account's row: it has not
      // touched the key, which still carries only the call's shared lock.
      const [held, release] = [gate(), gate()];
      const calling = rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
        await auditCall(tx, ordered);
        held.open();
        await release.opened;
      });
      await held.opened;
      const revoking = createAuthRepo(authDb).revokeStaffKeys({ account: { id: ordered.id }, key: "all", suspect: false, via: "cli", actorId: ordered.id, now: new Date() });
      try {
        await untilBlocked(authDb, "for no key update");
        expect(await probe(sql`select 1 from auth.staff_keys where id = ${ordered.keyId}::uuid for share nowait`)).toBeNull();
      } finally {
        release.open();
        await calling;
      }
      expect(await revoking).toMatchObject({ ok: true });
      // Revoked first: the call is ended at the key.
      expect(await auditCallRefusal(ordered)).toEqual(ended);
    });

    test("a call whose row joins the chain after the challenge's expiry, because it waited for the head, is refused as late and stores nothing", async () => {
      const requestId = `req-late-${randomUUID()}`;
      const expires = Date.now() + 1500;
      const refused = await whileHeadHeld(async (letGo) => {
        const calling = auditCallRefusal(admin, { expires, requestId });
        await untilBlocked(apiDb, "append_confirmed_audit");
        // Held past the expiry: the row is stamped only once its transaction has the head.
        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, Math.max(0, expires - Date.now()) + 500));
        await letGo();
        return calling;
      });
      expect(refused).toEqual({ code: "P0001", message: "staff_confirmation_late" });
      const [stored] = await apiDb.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from audit_log where request_id = ${requestId}`);
      expect(stored!.n).toBe(0);
    });
  });

  test("3e: the decide route takes the subject's profile FOR UPDATE first exactly when the decision holds a suspension: a write's shared lock on the account makes it wait, and a lift or a removal does not wait", async () => {
    const account = await newProfile(apiDb);
    const social = world.moderation.deps.social;
    const lockAccounts = social.lockAccounts;
    const modes: string[] = [];
    social.lockAccounts = (tx, ids, mode, live) => {
      modes.push(mode);
      return lockAccounts(tx, ids, mode, live);
    };
    try {
      // The basis of a suspension at once: a final R5 removal of a post of the account.
      const postCase = (await recordIntake(world.moderation.deps, { ground: ground.finding(admin.id, "R5"), live: [aPost(await newPostRow(apiDb, account.id))] })).items[0]!.caseId!;
      const removal = await prepared(admin, postCase, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R5", actions: [act("remove")] });
      const removed = await whileHeld(sql`select 1 from profiles where id = ${account.id}::uuid for key share`, () => removal());
      if (typeof removed === "string") throw new Error(`the removal was not recorded: ${removed}`);
      const accountCase = (await recordIntake(world.moderation.deps, { ground: ground.finding(admin.id, "R5"), live: [{ type: "account", id: account.id, position: 1, namedHandle: account.handle }] })).items[0]!.caseId!;
      const suspension = await prepared(admin, accountCase, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R5", actions: [{ kind: "suspend", mediaId: null, days: 3, announced: false }] });
      const suspended = await whileHeld(sql`select 1 from profiles where id = ${account.id}::uuid for key share`, async (letGo) => {
        const deciding = suspension();
        // FOR UPDATE waits for the shared lock every write about the account holds.
        await untilBlocked(apiDb, "from profiles where id = any");
        await letGo();
        return deciding;
      });
      if (typeof suspended === "string") throw new Error(`the suspension was not recorded: ${suspended}`);
      const lift = await prepared(admin, accountCase, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: suspended.decisionId, actions: [act("lift_suspension")] });
      const lifted = await whileHeld(sql`select 1 from profiles where id = ${account.id}::uuid for key share`, () => lift());
      expect(typeof lifted).not.toBe("string");
      expect(modes).toEqual(["no key update", "update", "no key update"]);
    } finally {
      social.lockAccounts = lockAccounts;
      await removeFixtures(migrateDb, [account.id]);
    }
  });

  test("3e Task 4: a kept correction and a kept review of an announced suspension with a reply on time take the subject's profile FOR UPDATE first, as the start they fix is derived again under it", async () => {
    // 3e's review (proofs6): the branch of subjectLockMode for an answer to an announced measure (invariant 21).
    const account = await newProfile(apiDb);

    social.lockAccounts = (tx, ids, mode, live) => {

    };
    const decided = async (run: () => Promise<unknown>) => {
      const outcome = await run();
      if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(`the decision was not recorded: ${outcome}`);
      return (outcome as { decisionId: string }).decisionId;
    };

      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {

        const postCase = (await recordIntake(world.moderation.deps, { ground: ground.finding(admin.id, "R1"), live: [aPost(postId)] })).items[0]!.caseId!;
        await decided(await prepared(admin, postCase, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R1", actions: [act("remove")] }));

      modes.length = 0;
      await decided(() => world.reviewAs(second, announced, { outcome: "kept" }));

    } finally {

      await removeFixtures(migrateDb, [account.id]);
    }
  });

  test("this file left no row behind: the tables it writes, the moderation tables and the four auth tables of moderation cases hold what they held before it", async () => {

    // Another transaction holds the account's profile, as a decision about the account does.
    let release!: () => void;
    const gate = new Promise<void>((resolve) => (release = resolve));
    let held!: () => void;
    const holding = new Promise<void>((resolve) => (held = resolve));
    const holder = w.migrateDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.execute(sql`set local lock_timeout = '30s'`);
      await tx.execute(sql`select 1 from profiles where id = ${author.id}::uuid for update`);
      held();
      await gate;
    });
    try {
      await holding;
      const sending = sendStatement(w.deps, decisionId);
      await untilBlocked(w.apiDb, "order by id for no key update");
      // 3e's review (database3): the mail went before the profile was asked for, so a relay that stalls never holds the
      // account's row; the record waits at the profile, holding the decision's row it took before the send.
      expect(w.mailer.to(author.email, "suspension_announced")).toHaveLength(1);
      const second = await w.apiDb

          await tx.execute(sql`select id from decisions where id = ${decisionId}::uuid for no key update`);
        })
        .then(
          () => "taken",
          () => "held",
        );
      expect(second).toBe("held");
      release();
      await holder;
      expect(await sending).toBe("sent");
    } finally {
      release();
      await holder.catch(() => undefined);
    }
    expect(await mailState(decisionId)).toEqual({ author_mail: "sent", mailed: true });
    const [mail] = w.mailer.to(author.email, "suspension_announced");
    expect(mail?.data).toMatchObject({ measure: "suspend", days: "3", statement: statementParagraphs(statement).join(String.fromCharCode(10)) });
    expect(w.mailer.to(author.email, "moderation_decision").map((sent) => sent.data.statement)).not.toContain(mail!.data.statement);
    await closeDecisions();
  });

  test("this file left no row behind: the moderation tables and the four auth tables of moderation cases hold what they held before it", async () => {
    await closeDecisions();
    await w.cleanUp();
    await d.close();
    expect(await counts()).toEqual(before);
  });
});

import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";

 * 20 for the announced measures): the start under each outcome of the notice mail (none while it is pending; the relay's
 * acceptance plus the reply window when sent; the decision plus the undelivered window when refused; the moment a give-up
 * was recorded when that is later), recorded under the subject's profile lock, and the API role unable to move either
 * column again; the ladder from three strikes to an announced termination, one rung after another with its most days;
 * and a basis that breaks under an announced measure that a reply holds. Each decision is confirmed with a real staff
 * key and mailed through the notices world's auth module and its scripted mailer.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: announced suspensions and terminations", () => {
  let n: NoticesWorld;
  let world: DeciderWorld;
  let admin: RealStaff;
  let second: RealStaff;
  let moderator: RealStaff;
  let before: Record<string, number>;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    n = noticesWorld();
    world = deciderWorld(n.apiDb, { auth: n.authForModeration });
    admin = await world.staff("admin");
    second = await world.staff("admin");
    moderator = await world.staff("moderator");
    before = await n.counts();
  }, 400_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    try {
      await n.cleanUp();
      await world.close();
    } finally {
      await n.close();
    }

  /** A confirmed decision through the route's code: its id, or a failure that says why none was recorded. */
  async function decided(member: RealStaff, caseId: string, input: DecisionInput): Promise<string> {
    const outcome = await world.decideAs(member, caseId, input);
    if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(`the decision was not recorded: ${outcome}`);
    return outcome.decisionId;
  }
  /** What a decision through the route was refused with: its code and the trigger's detail. */
  async function refused(member: RealStaff, caseId: string, input: DecisionInput): Promise<{ code: string; detail: string | null } | null> {
    try {
      await world.decideAs(member, caseId, input);
      return null;
    } catch (err) {
      if (!(err instanceof ModerationError)) throw err;
      return { code: err.code, detail: (err as ModerationError & { detail?: string | null }).detail ?? null };
    }
  }
  /** Strikes the way they come about: a post made now, an admin's own finding on it under the rule, a final removal. */
  async function strikes(accountId: string, count: number, rule: RuleId = "R1"): Promise<string[]> {
    const made: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const postId = await newPostRow(n.apiDb, accountId, { createdAt: sql`clock_timestamp()`, body: `a post that breaks ${rule}` });
      const caseId = (await intake(n.apiDb, ground.finding(admin.id, rule), aPost(postId))).items[0]!.caseId!;
      made.push(await decided(admin, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: rule, actions: [act("remove")] }));

  /** The measure's period as suspension_periods gives it, with the decision's mail, each time in epoch milliseconds. */
  async function periodOf(decisionId: string) {

      sql`select d.author_mail, extract(epoch from d.author_mail_at) * 1000 as mail_ms, extract(epoch from a.created_at) * 1000 as created_ms,

                 case when isfinite(p.ends_at) then extract(epoch from p.ends_at) * 1000 end as end_ms
            from decision_actions a join decisions d on d.id = a.decision_id left join suspension_periods p on p.action_id = a.id
           where a.decision_id = ${decisionId}::uuid and a.kind::text in ('suspend', 'terminate')`,
    );
    return { ...row!, mail_ms: row!.mail_ms === null ? null : Number(row!.mail_ms), created_ms: Number(row!.created_ms), earliest_ms: Number(row!.earliest_ms), start_ms: row!.start_ms === null ? null : Number(row!.start_ms), end_ms: row!.end_ms === null ? null : Number(row!.end_ms) };
  }

    expect(ended.some((paragraph) => paragraph.startsWith("This rests on korbat's terms, section Suspension and termination: after three suspensions"))).toBe(true);
    const mails = n.mailer.to(account.email, "suspension_announced");
    expect(mails.map((mail) => mail.data.measure)).toEqual(["suspend", "suspend", "suspend", "terminate"]);

  test("a basis that breaks under an announced suspension held by a reply: the overruling ends it before its start, answers the reply, says so in its statement and mail, and a kept answer is then refused", async () => {

    const [answered] = await n.apiDb.execute<{ answered_by: string | null }>(sql`select r.answered_by from suspension_replies r join decision_actions a on a.id = r.action_id where a.decision_id = ${decisionId}::uuid`);

  const attemptsOf = (address: string, template: string) => n.mailer.attempts.filter((mail) => mail.to === address && mail.template === template).length;
  /** Resolves once the scripted mailer has been handed one more mail of this template for this address than `before`. */
  async function handedOver(address: string, template: string, before: number): Promise<void> {
    for (let round = 0; round < 400; round++) {

    expect(await sendStatement(n.deps, pending.decisionId)).toBe("none");

    const replying = n.apiDb.transaction(async (tx) => {

    expect((await n.moderation.standingFor(pending.account.id))?.measure?.state).toBe("held");

    expect(judged!.suspended).toBe(false);

  test("no profile is held while a notice is mailed: a follow of the account goes through while the relay hangs, a decision about it commits meanwhile, and the outcome is then recorded under the profile's lock without a deadlock", async () => {
    // 3e's review (database3): the subject's profile is taken right before the mail's result is recorded, never before the send.
    const pending = await announced("fail");

      const corrected = await within(60_000, world.decideAs(admin, pending.caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: pending.decisionId, actions: [act("lift_suspension")] }));
      expect(corrected).not.toBe("still waiting");

    // transaction holds them, while the mail is sent; the mail's transaction records once it has gone.
    const second = await announced("fail");

      await release.opened;
    });

    try {
      await held.opened;
      recording = sendStatement(n.deps, second.decisionId);
      await untilBlocked(n.apiDb, "order by id for no key update", 60_000);
      // The mail went before the profile was asked for.
      expect(n.mailer.to(second.account.email, "suspension_announced")).toHaveLength(1);
    } finally {
      release.open();
      await holder;
    }
    expect(await recording).toBe("sent");
  });

  test("this file left no row behind: what it committed is removed, and the tables hold what they held before it", async () => {
    await world.moderation.settle();
    await n.cleanUp();
    expect(await n.counts()).toEqual(before);
  });
});

    const seal = await decided(admin, sealCase, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] });
    const caseId = await findingR2();
    expect(await refused(admin, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R2", actions: atOnce(STANDING_RULES.protectiveDays + 1) })).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_decision", detail: expect.stringMatching(/^days: at most 14/) });
    const decisionId = await decided(admin, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R2", actions: atOnce(STANDING_RULES.protectiveDays) });
    expect(await suspendRow(decisionId)).toEqual({ basis: "protective", rests_on: [seal], days: STANDING_RULES.protectiveDays, announced: false });
    const text = statementParagraphs((await decisionStatement(n.apiDb, decisionId))!.statement).join(" | ");
    expect(text).not.toContain("It breaks");
    expect(text).not.toContain("conduct breaks");
    expect(text).toContain("This is not a finding that you broke the law or a korbat rule");
    // Lifting the seal ends the suspension in that transaction; the correction's statement says so, and its mail is suspension_lifted.
    const unseal = await decided(admin, sealCase, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: seal, actions: [act("unseal_media")] });
    expect((await standingOf(account.id))?.measure).toBeNull();
    const ended = (await decisionStatement(n.apiDb, unseal))!.statement;
    expect(ended.endedStanding).toEqual([{ kind: "suspend", decidedAt: expect.any(String), periodThen: { state: "running", startedAt: expect.any(String), endedAt: null }, seal: true, replyFiledAt: null }]);
    expect(statementParagraphs(ended).some((paragraph) => paragraph.endsWith(`rested on that seal. ${STATEMENT_WORDS.basisEndedThen.running}`))).toBe(true);
    expect(n.mailer.to(account.email, "suspension_lifted").map((m) => [m.data.why, m.data.period])).toEqual([["basis", "running"]]);
    // One protective suspension for one seal, also after its lift: a second needs a newer seal.
    expect(await refused(admin, await findingR2(), { kind: "final", ruleId: "R2", actions: atOnce(3) })).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_decision" });
  });

  test("its lift: a correction lifts the suspension at once, /api/me shows no measure, the statement says it ended with this decision, and the mail is suspension_lifted", async () => {
    const account = await n.account();
    await threatOn(account.id);
    const caseId = await accountCase(account, "R5");
    const decisionId = await decided(admin, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R5", actions: atOnce(7) });
    expect((await standingOf(account.id))?.measure?.state).toBe("running");
    // A suspension taken at once needed an admin, so its correction is an admin's too.
    expect(await refused(moderator, caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: decisionId, actions: [act("lift_suspension")] })).toMatchObject({ code: "admin_required" });
    const lift = await decided(second, caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: decisionId, actions: [act("lift_suspension")] });
    expect((await standingOf(account.id))?.measure).toBeNull();
    expect((await actionsOf(n.apiDb, lift)).map((a) => a.kind)).toEqual(["lift_suspension"]);
    const statement = (await decisionStatement(n.apiDb, lift))!.statement;
    expect(statement.reversals[0]).toMatchObject({ kind: "lift_suspension", liftedKind: "suspend", periodThen: { state: "running", startedAt: expect.any(String), endedAt: null }, replaced: false });
    expect(statementParagraphs(statement)).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.liftedRunning("suspension"));
    expect(n.mailer.to(account.email, "suspension_lifted").map((m) => [m.data.why, m.data.period])).toEqual([["lifted", "running"]]);
    // 3e's review (people5): the decision's screen reads the period cut to the lift, its end the lift's moment, which the
    // app words as a lift while it ran ([now.lifted]).
    const standing = (await authorDecisionView(n.deps, account.id, decisionId)).standing!;
    expect(standing).toMatchObject({ state: "lifted", endedBy: lift, startsAt: expect.any(String) });
    expect(standing.endsAt).toBe(standing.endedAt);
    // 3e's review (people7): the person's list names the suspension with its days and kind, and its lift as a lift.
    const rows = (await authorCases(n.deps, account.id)).decisions;
    expect(rows.find((row) => row.id === decisionId)).toMatchObject({ actions: ["suspend"], standingMeasure: { kind: "suspend", days: 7, announced: false } });
    expect(rows.find((row) => row.id === lift)).toMatchObject({ actions: ["lift_suspension"], liftedStanding: { kind: "suspend", replaced: false } });
    expect(rows.find((row) => row.id === lift)).not.toHaveProperty("standingMeasure");
    // Lifted, it stands no more: a new suspension at once is open again.
    expect(await refused(admin, await accountCase(account, "R5"), { kind: "final", ruleId: "R5", actions: atOnce(3) })).toBeNull();
  });

  test("the basis that breaks: reversing the R5 decision a suspension at once rests on ends it in that transaction, and the reversal's statement and mail say so", async () => {
    const account = await n.account();

    const reversal = await decided(second, threat.caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: threat.decisionId, actions: [act("restore")] });
    expect((await standingOf(account.id))?.measure).toBeNull();

    expect(statement.endedStanding).toEqual([{ kind: "suspend", decidedAt: expect.any(String), periodThen: { state: "running", startedAt: expect.any(String), endedAt: null }, seal: false, replyFiledAt: null }]);

  test("/api/me carries the standing read fresh at every request: the suspension shows at once on a session opened before it, and goes with its lift", async () => {
    const b = new Browser(n.app, n.config.APP_ORIGIN);
    const email = `standing-${randomUUID()}@korbat.local`;
    const handle = `sa_${randomBytes(4).toString("hex")}`;
    const start = await b.fetch("/api/auth/email/start", { json: { email, turnstileToken: HUMAN, deviceId: randomToken(), platform: "web" } });

    expect((await b.fetch("/api/auth/onboarding/handle", { json: { handle, displayName: "Standing" } })).status).toBe(200);

    // The session's cache never carries the standing: the next read shows it.

    await decided(second, caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: decisionId, actions: [act("lift_suspension")] });

  });

  test("grant-role refuses to make a suspended account staff, changing nothing; in the other order a promotion that holds the account's row first makes the deciding transaction wait, and it then meets staff_target", async () => {
    const account = await n.account();
    await threatOn(account.id);
    await decided(admin, await accountCase(account, "R5"), { kind: "final", ruleId: "R5", actions: atOnce(3) });
    const deps = { authDb: n.authDb, kv: new MemoryKv(), mailer: new MemoryMailer() };
    expect(await runGrantRole(deps, account.email, "moderator")).toBe("standing");
    expect((await n.repo.findUserById(account.id))!.role).toBe("user");
    expect(GRANT_ROLE_WORDS.standing).toBe(
      "This account holds a suspension, a termination or a restriction of reporting that stands and has not ended, so it cannot be made staff. Nothing was changed. If the measure was wrong, an admin lifts it with a correction first.",
    );
    // A demotion is never refused.
    expect(await runGrantRole(deps, account.email, "user")).not.toBe("standing");

    // The other order: a promotion holds the account's row, as grant-role's transaction does, while a suspension is decided.
    const other = await n.account();
    await threatOn(other.id);
    const caseId = await accountCase(other, "R5");
    let release!: () => void;
    const gate = new Promise<void>((resolve) => (release = resolve));
    let taken!: () => void;
    const locked = new Promise<void>((resolve) => (taken = resolve));
    const promotion = n.authDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.execute(sql`set local lock_timeout = '20s'`);
      await tx.execute(sql`select 1 from auth.users where id = ${other.id}::uuid for no key update`);
      await tx.execute(sql`update auth.users set role = 'moderator' where id = ${other.id}::uuid`);
      taken();
      await gate;
    });
    let failed: unknown = null;
    promotion.catch((err: unknown) => {
      failed = err;
      taken();
    });
    try {
      await locked;
      expect(failed).toBeNull();
      const deciding = refused(admin, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R5", actions: atOnce(3) });
      await untilBlocked(n.apiDb, "insert into decisions");
      release();
      await promotion;
      expect(await deciding).toMatchObject({ code: "staff_target" });
    } finally {
      release();
      await promotion.catch(() => undefined);
      await n.authDb.execute(sql`update auth.users set role = 'user' where id = ${other.id}::uuid`);
    }
  });

  test("a reporter whose report a suspension at once answered reads 3c's restricted outcome with ACCOUNT_MEASURE_SCOPE.measure, which names no suspension, its time or its length; in the mail and on the page alike", async () => {
    const account = await n.account();
    await threatOn(account.id);
    const reporter = await n.account();
    const notice = await intake(n.apiDb, ground.rule(reporter.id, "R5"), anAccount(account.id, account.handle));
    const caseId = notice.items[0]!.caseId!;
    await decided(admin, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R5", actions: atOnce(3) });
    await n.apiDb.execute(sql`select public.release_outcomes(now())`);
    const [item] = await noticeItems(n.apiDb, notice.intakeId);
    const status = await itemStatus(world.moderation.deps, item!);
    expect(status.scope).toBe("account_measure");
    const words = itemOutcomeWords(status)!;
    expect(words.startsWith("access restricted: it breaks korbat rule R5")).toBe(true);
    expect(words.endsWith(` ${ACCOUNT_MEASURE_SCOPE.measure}`)).toBe(true);
    expect(words).not.toMatch(/suspen|terminat|day|until/i);
    // The dispatch job mails the same line: the item's mail is made pending as the release makes a mailed one.
    await world.migrateDb.execute(sql`update intake_items set outcome_mail = 'pending' where intake_id = ${notice.intakeId}::uuid`);
    const mailed = (await pendingOutcomeLines(n.apiDb)).find((line) => line.intakeId === notice.intakeId)!;
    expect(mailed).toMatchObject({ targetType: "account", measure: true, retired: false });
    expect(updateLine(world.moderation.deps, mailed).outcome).toBe(words);
  });

  test("this file left no row behind: what it committed is removed, and the tables hold what they held before it", async () => {
    await world.moderation.settle();
    await n.cleanUp();
    expect(await n.counts()).toEqual(before);
  });
});

import { rolledBack } from "./staff-fixtures";

// Each test runs many statements in one open transaction, each a round trip: a loaded machine needs more than five seconds.
vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 120_000 });

/**
 * The standing ledger at the database's level (3e design, section 6.2; section 12.1, invariants 1, 2, 4 to 9, 11 and 13,
 * their database parts): the constants, the strike rule, the overruling, the ladder, a basis that breaks, one standing
 * measure at a time, the closed list of measures taken at once, the start that never comes before the earliest one, and
 * staff. Most tests run as korbat_api inside one transaction that is rolled back, deciding through the module's own
 * decide with the fixtures' flag that lifts the routes' list of kinds (decideWith), so every kind of 3e can be stored before
 * its route opens. Several posts of one author are dated a minute apart in the future, so that each is newer than the
 * time its author was told of the strike before it, all inside one transaction. What needs the clock to move commits,
 * and moves the times back with ageStandingForTest as the migrator; its rows are removed in the end. The file's last test
 * holds it to leaving no row behind.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the standing ledger", () => {
  let apiDb: Db;
  let authDb: Db;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let repo: AuthRepo;
  let mod: TestStaff;
  let admin: TestStaff;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  /** Profiles a committed scenario made, removed with everything they hold at the end. */
  const committed: string[] = [];

  beforeAll(async () => {
    const config = loadConfig();
    apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 4 });
    authDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_AUTH, { max: 2 });
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });
    repo = createAuthRepo(authDb);
    mod = await newTestStaff(authDb, migrateDb, repo, "moderator");
    admin = await newTestStaff(authDb, migrateDb, repo, "admin");
    before = await rowCounts(apiDb);
  }, 120_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    try {
      await closeDecisions();
      await removeFixtures(migrateDb, committed);
    } finally {
      await Promise.all([closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(authDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
    }
  }, 120_000);

  /** One test's world: a transaction of the API role that is rolled back, with both staff members' profiles in it. */
  const inWorld = (fn: (tx: DbTx) => Promise<void>, db: Db = apiDb) =>
    rolledBack(db, async (tx) => {
      await staffProfile(tx, mod);
      await staffProfile(tx, admin);
      await fn(tx);
    });
  const profile = (tx: DbTx) => newProfile(tx as unknown as Db);
  /** A time this many minutes after the transaction's start, as SQL. */
  const minutesOn = (minutes: number) => sql`now() + make_interval(mins => ${minutes}::int)`;

  /** A post of the author dated this many minutes after the transaction's start (30 days back when null), and its case, opened by an admin's finding. */
  async function postCase(tx: DbTx, authorId: string, minutes: number | null, rule: RuleId = "R1") {
    const postId = await newPostRow(tx, authorId, minutes === null ? {} : { createdAt: minutesOn(minutes) });
    const recorded = await intake(tx, ground.finding(admin.id, rule), aPost(postId));
    return { postId, caseId: recorded.items[0]!.caseId! };
  }
  /** A final removal of a new post of the author under the rule, which gives a strike: the decision. */
  async function strikeIn(tx: DbTx, authorId: string, minutes: number, rule: RuleId = "R1"): Promise<string> {
    const { caseId } = await postCase(tx, authorId, minutes, rule);
    const decision = await decideIn(tx, admin, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: rule, actions: [act("remove")] });
    expect((await actionsOf(tx, decision)).map((a) => a.kind), "the removal gives a strike").toContain("strike");
    return decision;

  async function accountCase(tx: DbTx, accountId: string, rule: RuleId = "R1", by: "finding" | "report" = "finding"): Promise<string> {
    const g = by === "finding" ? ground.finding(admin.id, rule) : ground.rule((await profile(tx)).id, rule);
    const recorded = await intake(tx, g, anAccount(accountId, "named"));

    decideIn(tx, staff, await accountCase(tx, accountId, rule, by), { kind: "final", ruleId: rule, actions });

  const columns = async (tx: DbTx, accountId: string) =>

  const activeStrikes = async (tx: DbTx, accountId: string) => (await tx.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from active_strikes where account_id = ${accountId}::uuid`))[0]!.n;
  /**

  async function rawRows(tx: DbTx, caseId: string, input: DecisionInput, rows: { kind: ActionKind; mediaId?: string | null; days?: number | null; announced?: boolean }[]) {
    const params = await decisionParams(tx, admin, caseId, { ...input, strike: false, overrule: false });
    return refusal(
      tx.transaction(async (sp) => {
        const id = randomUUID();
        await insertDecision(sp, { id, caseId, decidedBy: admin.id, params });
        for (const row of rows) await insertAction(sp, id, { kind: row.kind, mediaId: row.mediaId ?? null, days: row.days, announced: row.announced });

  const rowOf = async (tx: DbTx, decisionId: string, kind: string) => (await actionsOf(tx, decisionId)).find((a) => a.kind === kind) as unknown as Record<string, unknown> & { id: string };

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the constants and the enum

  test("standing_rules() holds the contracts' STANDING_RULES, name by name, and action_kind the contracts' 22 kinds in order", async () => {
    const [row] = await apiDb.execute<Record<string, unknown>>(sql`select * from public.standing_rules()`);
    const camel = (name: string) => name.replace(/_([a-z])/g, (_m, letter: string) => letter.toUpperCase());
    const read = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(row!).map(([name, value]) => [camel(name), Array.isArray(value) ? value : Number(value)]));
    expect(read).toEqual({ ...STANDING_RULES, ladderDays: [...STANDING_RULES.ladderDays] });
    const values = await apiDb.execute<{ value: string }>(sql`select unnest(enum_range(null::action_kind))::text as value`);
    expect(values.map((v) => v.value)).toEqual([...ACTION_KINDS]);
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- invariant 4: a strike exactly when one is due

  describe("a decision holds a strike exactly when the database says one is due (invariant 4)", () => {
    test("strike_due over its table: a post case on a korbat rule other than R2 and no suspect item, once a post, never before the newest strike was told", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {

          tx.execute<{ due: boolean }>(sql`select public.strike_due(${caseId}::uuid, ${g}::decision_ground, ${rule}::text, ${suspect}, null) as due`).then((r) => r[0]!.due);
        expect(await due(first.caseId, "incompatible", "R1")).toBe(true);

        expect(await refusal(decideIn(tx, admin, again, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R3", actions: [act("remove")] }))).toBeNull();
        // On the law, under R2 and while deciding no strike stands; nor on an account case, nor as the only measure.
        const other = await postCase(tx, author.id, 5);
        expect(await rawRows(tx, other.caseId, { kind: "interim" }, [act("withhold"), act("strike")])).toBe("invalid_decision");
        expect(await refusalDetail(decideIn(tx, admin, other.caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [], strike: true }))).toMatch(/^restricted: /);
        expect(await refusal(onAccount(tx, author.id, "R1", [act("reset_bio"), act("strike")]))).toBe("invalid_decision");
      });
    });

    test("the fixture's strikeDueFor, the console's question, agrees with what the commit accepts", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const author = await profile(tx);
        const { caseId } = await postCase(tx, author.id, 0);
        const [c] = await tx.execute<{ intake_seq: number }>(sql`select intake_seq from cases where id = ${caseId}::uuid`);
        expect(await strikeDueFor(tx, caseId, "incompatible", "R4", c!.intake_seq)).toBe(true);
        expect(await strikeDueFor(tx, caseId, "incompatible", "R2", c!.intake_seq)).toBe(false);
      });
    });
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- invariant 5: a strike falls only whole

  describe("a strike falls only with its whole finding, and stops counting in that transaction (invariant 5)", () => {
    test("overrule only in a review or correction that reverses; a full reversal without it, and a reversal in part that leaves only the strike, are refused", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const author = await profile(tx);
        const { postId, caseId } = await postCase(tx, author.id, 0);
        const imageA = await newImageRow(tx, author.id, postId, 0);
        const imageB = await newImageRow(tx, author.id, postId, 1);
        const removal = await decideIn(tx, admin, caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove_media", imageA), act("remove_media", imageB)] });
        const correct = (outcome: "reversed" | "partly_reversed", actions: DecisionInput["actions"], overrule = false) =>
          refusalDetail(decideIn(tx, admin, caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: removal, outcome, actions, overrule }));
        // An overruling in a reversal in part: the params' schema refuses it, and below it the trigger does.
        expect(await rawRows(tx, caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: removal, outcome: "partly_reversed" }, [act("overrule"), act("restore_media", imageA)])).toBe("invalid_decision");
        expect(await correct("reversed", [act("restore_media", imageA), act("restore_media", imageB)])).toMatch(/^reversed: a measure of the reviewed decision is still in force/);
        expect(await correct("partly_reversed", [act("restore_media", imageA), act("restore_media", imageB)])).toMatch(/^partly_reversed: .*but its strike/);
        // In a decision that is no review or correction an overruling has no place.
        expect(await rawRows(tx, (await postCase(tx, author.id, 5)).caseId, { kind: "final" }, [act("remove"), act("overrule")])).toBe("invalid_decision");
        // Reversed whole, with its overruling: the strike stops counting before the commit, and its row stays.
        expect(await activeStrikes(tx, author.id)).toBe(1);
        expect(await correct("reversed", [act("restore_media", imageA), act("restore_media", imageB)], true)).toBeNull();
        expect(await activeStrikes(tx, author.id)).toBe(0);
        expect((await actionsOf(tx, removal)).map((a) => a.kind)).toContain("strike");
      });
    });

    test("a review that reverses the decision overrules its strike, and one that keeps it keeps the strike", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const author = await profile(tx);
        const kept = await strikeIn(tx, author.id, 0);
        const reversed = await strikeIn(tx, author.id, 1);
        await appealOf(tx, kept, author.id);
        await appealOf(tx, reversed, author.id);
        expect(await refusal(reviewIn(tx, mod, kept))).toBeNull();
        expect(await refusalDetail(reviewIn(tx, mod, reversed, { actions: [act("restore")], overrule: false }))).toMatch(/^reversed: a measure of the reviewed decision is still in force/);
        expect(await refusal(reviewIn(tx, mod, reversed, { actions: [act("restore")] }))).toBeNull();
        expect(await activeStrikes(tx, author.id)).toBe(1);
      });
    });
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- invariant 13: staff

  test("no measure of 3e reaches a staff account: each of the six is refused staff_target (invariant 13)", async () => {
    await inWorld(async (tx) => {
      // A post of the moderator's own, struck: the strike's own row meets the rule when it is the decision's only one.
      const { caseId } = await postCase(tx, mod.id, 0);
      expect(await refusal(decideIn(tx, admin, caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [], strike: true }))).toBe("staff_target");
      for (const actions of [[timed("suspend", 3, true)], [timed("terminate", null, true)], [act("retire_handle")], [act("warn_reporting")], [timed("restrict_reporting", 3, false)]]) {
        expect(await refusal(onAccount(tx, mod.id, "R6", actions)), actions[0]!.kind).toBe("staff_target");
      }
    });
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- invariant 6: the ladder

  describe("the ladder is the database's (invariant 6)", () => {
    test("an announced suspension needs three active strikes, takes the rung's days at most, cites the newest strike's rule, and rests on the strikes, forced", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const account = await profile(tx);
        const strikes = [await strikeIn(tx, account.id, 0), await strikeIn(tx, account.id, 1)];
        expect(await refusalDetail(onAccount(tx, account.id, "R1", [timed("suspend", 3, true)]))).toMatch(/^basis: none fits/);
        strikes.push(await strikeIn(tx, account.id, 2));
        // More than the first rung is refused; a shorter one is allowed and still a step.
        expect(await refusalDetail(onAccount(tx, account.id, "R1", [timed("suspend", STANDING_RULES.ladderDays[0] + 1, true)]))).toMatch(/^days: at most 3 on the basis strikes/);
        // Taken at once, a step of the ladder fits no row.
        expect(await refusalDetail(onAccount(tx, account.id, "R1", [timed("suspend", 3, false)]))).toMatch(/^basis: none fits/);
        const decision = await onAccount(tx, account.id, "R1", [timed("suspend", 1, true)]);
        const row = await rowOf(tx, decision, "suspend");
        expect(row).toMatchObject({ days: 1, announced: true, basis: "strikes", replaced: null, ends_at: null });
        // The three strikes were decided in this one transaction, at one time: their order among themselves is the ids'.
        expect([...(row.rests_on as string[])].sort()).toEqual([...strikes].sort());
        // The earliest start is the decision plus the reply window: nothing is restricted yet.
        const [d] = await tx.execute<{ ok: boolean }>(
          sql`select a.starts_at = d.decided_at + make_interval(hours => ${STANDING_RULES.replyWindowHours}::int) as ok from decision_actions a join decisions d on d.id = a.decision_id where a.id = ${row.id}::uuid`,
        );
        expect(d!.ok).toBe(true);
        expect(await columns(tx, account.id)).toEqual({ from: null, until: null, restricted: null });
        expect(await liveRows(tx, account.id)).toBe(1);
        // Any moderator may announce one: the decision does not need an admin.
        expect((await decisionRow(tx, decision)).needs_admin).toBe(false);
      });
    });

    test("what the database forces is the database's: the API role cannot change a ledger row afterwards", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const account = await profile(tx);
        for (const minutes of [0, 1, 2]) await strikeIn(tx, account.id, minutes);
        const decision = await onAccount(tx, account.id, "R1", [timed("suspend", 3, true)]);
        const row = await rowOf(tx, decision, "suspend");
        expect(row.basis).toBe("strikes");
        expect(await refusal(tx.transaction((sp) => sp.execute(sql`update decision_actions set basis = 'flood' where id = ${row.id}::uuid`)))).toMatch(/^42501/);
      });
    });

    test("a ladder measure answers findings only: refused while its decision answers a user's report (open_reports)", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const account = await profile(tx);
        for (const minutes of [0, 1, 2]) await strikeIn(tx, account.id, minutes);
        expect(await refusalDetail(onAccount(tx, account.id, "R1", [timed("suspend", 3, true)], admin, "report"))).toBe("open_reports");
      });
    });
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- invariants 7 and 8: a broken basis, one at a time

  /** The case of a decision. */
  const caseOfDecision = async (tx: DbTx, decisionId: string) => (await tx.execute<{ case_id: string }>(sql`select case_id from decisions where id = ${decisionId}::uuid`))[0]!.case_id;

  describe("a suspension ends by derivation when its basis breaks, and one stands at a time (invariants 7 and 8)", () => {
    test("overruling one of three strikes clears the columns in that transaction, answers the waiting reply, and leaves no kept answer possible", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const account = await profile(tx);
        const strikes = [await strikeIn(tx, account.id, 0), await strikeIn(tx, account.id, 1), await strikeIn(tx, account.id, 2)];
        const announcing = await onAccount(tx, account.id, "R1", [timed("suspend", 3, true)]);
        // The relay accepted the notice: the start is fixed, and the columns are written.
        await tx.execute(sql`update decisions set author_mail = 'sent' where id = ${announcing}::uuid`);
        expect((await columns(tx, account.id)).from).not.toBeNull();
        // A reply filed before the start holds it.
        const suspend = await rowOf(tx, announcing, "suspend");
        await tx.execute(sql`insert into suspension_replies (action_id, account_id) values (${suspend.id}::uuid, ${account.id}::uuid)`);
        const [reply] = await tx.execute<{ on_time: boolean; answered_by: string | null }>(sql`select on_time, answered_by from suspension_replies where action_id = ${suspend.id}::uuid`);
        expect(reply).toEqual({ on_time: true, answered_by: null });
        expect(await columns(tx, account.id)).toEqual({ from: null, until: null, restricted: null });
        // One strike overruled with its whole finding: fewer than three stand, so the basis breaks now.
        const correction = await decideIn(tx, admin, await caseOfDecision(tx, strikes[1]!), { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: strikes[1]!, actions: [act("restore")] });
        expect(await liveRows(tx, account.id)).toBe(0);
        expect(await columns(tx, account.id)).toEqual({ from: null, until: null, restricted: null });
        const [basis] = await tx.execute<{ broken: string | null }>(sql`select public.standing_basis_broken_at(${suspend.id}::uuid)::text as broken`);
        expect(basis!.broken).not.toBeNull();
        expect((await tx.execute<{ answered_by: string | null }>(sql`select answered_by from suspension_replies where action_id = ${suspend.id}::uuid`))[0]!.answered_by).toBe(correction);
        // No reply is left to answer: a kept correction of the suspension is refused.
        expect(await refusal(decideIn(tx, admin, await caseOfDecision(tx, announcing), { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: announcing, outcome: "kept", actions: [] }))).toBe("invalid_decision");
      });
    });

    test("a reversed R5 decision ends the threat suspension at once that rests on it", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const account = await profile(tx);
        const threat = await strikeIn(tx, account.id, 0, "R5");
        const suspension = await onAccount(tx, account.id, "R5", [timed("suspend", 30, false)]);
        expect(await rowOf(tx, suspension, "suspend")).toMatchObject({ basis: "threat", rests_on: [threat], days: 30, announced: false });
        const running = await columns(tx, account.id);
        expect(running.from).not.toBeNull();
        expect(running.until).not.toBeNull();
        await decideIn(tx, admin, await caseOfDecision(tx, threat), { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: threat, actions: [act("restore")] });
        expect(await columns(tx, account.id)).toEqual({ from: null, until: null, restricted: null });
        expect(await liveRows(tx, account.id)).toBe(0);
      });
    });

    test("standing_conflict while one stands, one with no start included; accepted after a lift; replaced only for an announced one not started", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const account = await profile(tx);
        for (const minutes of [0, 1, 2]) await strikeIn(tx, account.id, minutes);
        const announcing = await onAccount(tx, account.id, "R1", [timed("suspend", 3, true)]);
        expect(await refusal(onAccount(tx, account.id, "R1", [timed("suspend", 3, true)]))).toBe("standing_conflict");
        // A lift signed replaced: the announced suspension had not started, so it is a withdrawal for another measure. Only an
        // admin withdraws (3e design, sections 7.6 step 12 and 8.7; the review's access5): a moderator's is admin_required.
        expect(
          await refusal(decideIn(tx, mod, await caseOfDecision(tx, announcing), { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: announcing, actions: [act("lift_suspension")], replaced: true })),
        ).toBe("admin_required");
        const withdrawal = await decideIn(tx, admin, await caseOfDecision(tx, announcing), { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: announcing, actions: [act("lift_suspension")], replaced: true });
        expect(await rowOf(tx, withdrawal, "lift_suspension")).toMatchObject({ replaced: true });
        expect(await liveRows(tx, account.id)).toBe(0);
        // A measure at once that runs: its lift cannot be a withdrawal.
        const threat = await strikeIn(tx, account.id, 3, "R5");
        const atOnce = await onAccount(tx, account.id, "R5", [timed("suspend", 7, false)]);
        expect(await rowOf(tx, atOnce, "suspend")).toMatchObject({ basis: "threat", rests_on: [threat] });
        const atOnceCase = await caseOfDecision(tx, atOnce);
        expect(await refusalDetail(decideIn(tx, admin, atOnceCase, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: atOnce, actions: [act("lift_suspension")], replaced: true }))).toMatch(/^replaced: /);
        expect(await refusal(decideIn(tx, admin, atOnceCase, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: atOnce, actions: [act("lift_suspension")] }))).toBeNull();
        expect(await columns(tx, account.id)).toEqual({ from: null, until: null, restricted: null });
      });
    });
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- invariant 9: measures at once, on the closed list

  test("a reporter is told that nothing changed only when nothing did: a reset that changed nothing beside a suspension at once that did is a measure that changed something", async () => {
    // 3e's review (access4, people4): the status line and the mail line read "It was already not shown ... nothing
    // changed now" from one expression, which looked at 3c's seven kinds only.
    await inWorld(async (tx) => {
      const [account, reporter] = [await profile(tx), await profile(tx)];
      await strikeIn(tx, account.id, 0, "R5");
      const recorded = await intake(tx, ground.rule(reporter.id, "R5"), anAccount(account.id, account.handle));
      const caseId = recorded.items[0]!.caseId!;
      // The bio is empty already, so its reset changes nothing; the suspension starts at once.
      const decision = await decideIn(tx, admin, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R5", actions: [act("reset_bio"), timed("suspend", 7, false)] });
      expect((await actionsOf(tx, decision)).map((a) => [a.kind, a.no_effect])).toEqual([
        ["reset_bio", "already"],
        ["suspend", null],
      ]);
      expect((await noticeItems(tx, recorded.intakeId)).map((item) => item.noEffect)).toEqual([false]);
      // The reset alone, in another case of the account: it changed nothing, and the reporter is told so.
      const other = await intake(tx, ground.rule((await profile(tx)).id, "R1"), anAccount(account.id, account.handle));
      await decideIn(tx, admin, other.items[0]!.caseId!, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R1", actions: [act("reset_bio")] });
      expect((await noticeItems(tx, other.intakeId)).map((item) => item.noEffect)).toEqual([true]);
    });
  });

  describe("taken at once only on the closed list, only by an admin (invariant 9)", () => {
    test("threat: accepted on a final R5 decision about a post of the account that stands; refused without one, after its reversal, and for a moderator", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const account = await profile(tx);
        expect(await refusalDetail(onAccount(tx, account.id, "R5", [timed("suspend", 3, false)]))).toMatch(/^basis: none fits/);
        const threat = await strikeIn(tx, account.id, 0, "R5");
        expect(await refusal(onAccount(tx, account.id, "R5", [timed("suspend", 3, false)], mod))).toBe("admin_required");
        expect(await refusal(onAccount(tx, account.id, "R5", [timed("suspend", STANDING_RULES.threatDays, false)]))).toBeNull();
        await decideIn(tx, admin, await caseOfDecision(tx, threat), { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: threat, actions: [act("restore")] });
        expect(await refusalDetail(onAccount(tx, account.id, "R5", [timed("suspend", 3, false)]))).toMatch(/^basis: none fits/);
      });
    });

    test("terrorist content: a decision on the law with the keyword about a post of the account; any other measure on the law is refused", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const account = await profile(tx);
        const postId = await newPostRow(tx, account.id);
        const notifier = await profile(tx);
        const postCaseId = (await intake(tx, ground.illegal(notifier.id), aPost(postId))).items[0]!.caseId!;
        const found = await decideIn(tx, admin, postCaseId, { kind: "final", ground: "illegal", categoryKeyword: "KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT", actions: [act("remove")] });
        // A decision on the law alone gives no strike.
        expect((await actionsOf(tx, found)).map((a) => a.kind)).toEqual(["remove"]);
        const onLaw = async (actions: DecisionInput["actions"], keyword: "KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT" | null) => {
          const caseId = (await intake(tx, ground.illegal((await profile(tx)).id), anAccount(account.id))).items[0]!.caseId!;
          return refusalDetail(decideIn(tx, admin, caseId, { kind: "final", ground: "illegal", categoryKeyword: keyword, actions }));
        };
        expect(await onLaw([timed("suspend", 3, true)], "KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT")).toMatch(/^basis: on the law only/);
        expect(await onLaw([timed("suspend", 3, false)], null)).toMatch(/^basis: on the law only/);
        expect(await onLaw([timed("suspend", STANDING_RULES.terroristDays, false)], "KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT")).toBeNull();
      });
    });

    test("flood: 19 posts in the hour are no floor, 20 are; up to floodDays days", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const account = await profile(tx);
        for (let i = 0; i < STANDING_RULES.floodPosts - 1; i++) await newPostRow(tx, account.id, { createdAt: sql`now()` });
        expect(await refusalDetail(onAccount(tx, account.id, "R6", [timed("suspend", 3, false)]))).toMatch(/^basis: none fits/);
        await newPostRow(tx, account.id, { createdAt: sql`now()` });
        expect(await refusalDetail(onAccount(tx, account.id, "R6", [timed("suspend", STANDING_RULES.floodDays + 1, false)]))).toMatch(/^days: at most 7 on the basis flood/);
        const decision = await onAccount(tx, account.id, "R6", [timed("suspend", STANDING_RULES.floodDays, false)]);
        expect(await rowOf(tx, decision, "suspend")).toMatchObject({ basis: "flood", rests_on: null });
      });
    });

    test("protective: on a seal for good of the account's images, once for that seal, never in the decision that seals, never a termination", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const account = await profile(tx);
        const postId = await newPostRow(tx, account.id);
        await newImageRow(tx, account.id, postId, 0);
        // No seal: refused; a termination under R2 is never established.
        const findingR2 = async () => (await intake(tx, ground.finding(admin.id, "R2"), anAccount(account.id))).items[0]!.caseId!;
        const caseId = await findingR2();
        expect(await refusalDetail(decideIn(tx, admin, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R2", actions: [timed("suspend", 3, false)] }))).toMatch(/^basis: under R2/);
        expect(await refusal(decideIn(tx, admin, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R2", actions: [timed("terminate", null, false)] }))).toBe("ground_not_established");
        // A seal taken while deciding is not enough; a seal and a suspension in one decision are refused.
        await decideIn(tx, admin, caseId, { kind: "interim", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] });
        expect(await refusalDetail(decideIn(tx, admin, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R2", actions: [timed("suspend", 3, false)] }))).toMatch(/^basis: under R2/);
        expect(await refusalDetail(decideIn(tx, admin, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media"), timed("suspend", 3, false)] }))).toMatch(/^A decision that seals/);
        // The seal for good closes the case; a new finding opens the account's next case, where the suspension is decided.
        const seal = await decideIn(tx, admin, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] });
        expect(await refusalDetail(decideIn(tx, admin, await findingR2(), { kind: "final", ruleId: "R2", actions: [timed("suspend", STANDING_RULES.protectiveDays + 1, false)] }))).toMatch(/^days: at most 14/);
        const protective = await decideIn(tx, admin, await findingR2(), { kind: "final", ruleId: "R2", actions: [timed("suspend", STANDING_RULES.protectiveDays, false)] });
        expect(await rowOf(tx, protective, "suspend")).toMatchObject({ basis: "protective", rests_on: [seal] });
        // Lifted by an admin's correction, it leaves the seal it rested on spent: a second needs a newer seal.
        await decideIn(tx, admin, await caseOfDecision(tx, protective), { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: protective, actions: [act("lift_suspension")] });
        expect(await refusalDetail(decideIn(tx, admin, await findingR2(), { kind: "final", ruleId: "R2", actions: [timed("suspend", 3, false)] }))).toMatch(/^basis: under R2/);
      });
    });

    test("a lifted seal ends the protective suspension that rests on it", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const account = await profile(tx);
        const postId = await newPostRow(tx, account.id);
        await newImageRow(tx, account.id, postId, 0);
        const findingR2 = async () => (await intake(tx, ground.finding(admin.id, "R2"), anAccount(account.id))).items[0]!.caseId!;
        const seal = await decideIn(tx, admin, await findingR2(), { kind: "final", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] });
        await decideIn(tx, admin, await findingR2(), { kind: "final", ruleId: "R2", actions: [timed("suspend", 7, false)] });
        expect((await columns(tx, account.id)).from).not.toBeNull();
        await decideIn(tx, admin, await caseOfDecision(tx, seal), { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: seal, actions: [act("unseal_media")] });
        expect(await columns(tx, account.id)).toEqual({ from: null, until: null, restricted: null });
        expect(await liveRows(tx, account.id)).toBe(0);
      });
    });
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- invariant 11: the start

  describe("an announced suspension never starts before its earliest start, and the API role cannot move it (invariant 11)", () => {
    /** An announced suspension of a new account on three strikes, and its ledger row. */
    async function announced(tx: DbTx) {
      const account = await profile(tx);
      for (const minutes of [0, 1, 2]) await strikeIn(tx, account.id, minutes);
      const decision = await onAccount(tx, account.id, "R1", [timed("suspend", 3, true)]);
      return { account, decision, row: await rowOf(tx, decision, "suspend") };
    }
    const period = async (tx: DbTx, actionId: string) =>
      (await tx.execute<{ starts: string; ends: string; from_start: number; from_created: number }>(
        sql`select p.starts_at::text as starts, p.ends_at::text as ends, extract(epoch from p.starts_at - a.starts_at)::float8 as from_start,
                   extract(epoch from p.starts_at - a.created_at)::float8 as from_created
              from suspension_periods p join decision_actions a on a.id = p.action_id where p.action_id = ${actionId}::uuid`,
      ))[0];

    test("no start while the mail is pending; sent: the relay's acceptance plus the window, never before starts_at; the API role cannot move or un-send it", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const s = await announced(tx);
        expect(await period(tx, s.row.id)).toBeUndefined();
        expect(await decisionRow(tx, s.decision)).toMatchObject({ author_mail: "pending" });
        // pending to a state other than the three, and a time chosen by the API, are refused.
        const update = (set: ReturnType<typeof sql>) => refusal(tx.transaction((sp) => sp.execute(sql`update decisions set ${set} where id = ${s.decision}::uuid`)));
        expect(await update(sql`author_mail = 'none'`)).toMatch(/^42501/);
        expect(await update(sql`author_mail_at = now() - interval '1 day'`)).toMatch(/^42501/);
        // Sent, with a time in the past supplied: the database writes its own.
        expect(await update(sql`author_mail = 'sent', author_mail_at = now() - interval '30 days'`)).toBeNull();
        const [mail] = await tx.execute<{ ok: boolean }>(sql`select author_mail_at = now() as ok from decisions where id = ${s.decision}::uuid`);
        expect(mail!.ok).toBe(true);
        const p = await period(tx, s.row.id);
        expect(p!.from_start).toBe(0);

      expect(await wouldDecide(account.id, "R5", [timed("suspend", STANDING_RULES.threatDays, true)])).toMatch(/^days: at most 3 on the basis strikes/);

  test("a kept answer before the earliest start starts the suspension at that start, never sooner for having replied; its statement and mail say so, and the six months count again from the answer", async () => {

    // A correction drafted now, then the reply, then the key: the reply raised the case's version.

    await fileReply(n.deps, hal.id, decisionId, { statement: "Please read this first." });
    await expect(world.moderation.forStaff.decide(admin.session, await world.confirm(admin, caseId, stale), { requestId: `req-${randomUUID()}` })).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "case_changed" });
    // The withdrawal: a lift signed `replaced`, of a measure that has not started.

    expect((await periodOf(decisionId)).answeredBy).toBe(withdrawal);

    await decided(admin, await accountCase(hal, "R5"), { kind: "final", ruleId: "R5", actions: [timed("suspend", 3, false)] });
    expect((await stateOf(hal.id))?.state).toBe("running");
  });

  test("this file left no row behind: what it committed is removed, and the tables hold what they held before it", async () => {
    await world.moderation.settle();
    await n.cleanUp();
    expect(await n.counts()).toEqual(before);
  });
});

 * measures). The first part runs at the database's level, as korbat_api (or as the migrator where a release must be
