```ts
    likeCount: 0,
    repostCount: 0,
    replyCount: 0,
    quoteCount: 0,
    createdAt: new Date("2026-10-04T10:00:00.000Z"),
    deletedAt: null,
    author: { id: authorId, handle: authorId === ME ? "me" : "other", displayName: "A", verified: false },
    replyToHandle: null,
    replyToAuthorId: null,
    replyToState: null,
    ...extra,
  });

  /** The social module's view source over rows held in memory, with a record of what the moderation module was asked. */
  function source(rows: PostRow[], facts: Record<string, PostModeration>) {
    const asked: { viewer: string; postIds: string[] }[] = [];
    const moderation: ModerationForSocial = {
      authorFacts: async (viewer, postIds) => {
        asked.push({ viewer, postIds: [...postIds] });
        return new Map(Object.entries(facts));
      },
    };
    const repo = {
      findPosts: async (ids: string[]) => new Map(rows.filter((r) => ids.includes(r.id)).map((r) => [r.id, r])),
      blockedEitherWay: async () => new Set<string>(),
      viewerPostStates: async (_viewer: string, ids: string[]) => new Map(ids.map((postId) => [postId, { liked: false, reposted: false, bookmarked: false }])),
      listedInExplore: async () => new Set<string>(),
    } as unknown as SocialDeps["repo"];
    const media = { forPosts: async () => new Map() } as unknown as SocialDeps["media"];
    return { asked, view: { repo, media, moderation } };
  }

  test("the viewer's own withheld and removed posts carry the decision the moderation module names, asked once for the page", async () => {
    const rows = [row(1, ME, "withheld"), row(2, ME, "removed"), row(3, ME, "visible"), row(4, OTHER, "visible")];
    const chips = { [id(1)]: { decisionId: id(51), ruleId: "R4" as const, legal: false, interim: true, strikeUntil: null }, [id(2)]: { decisionId: id(52), ruleId: null, legal: true, interim: false, strikeUntil: null } };
    const s = source(rows, chips);
    const views = await loadPostViews(s.view, ME, rows.map((r) => r.id));
    expect(s.asked).toEqual([{ viewer: ME, postIds: [id(1), id(2)] }]);
    const moderationOf = (n: number) => {
      const view = views.get(id(n))!;
      return isTombstone(view) ? "tombstone" : view.moderation;
    };
    expect(moderationOf(1)).toEqual(chips[id(1)]);
    expect(moderationOf(2)).toEqual(chips[id(2)]);
    expect(moderationOf(3)).toBeUndefined();
    expect(moderationOf(4)).toBeUndefined();
    const visible = views.get(id(3))!;
    expect("moderation" in visible).toBe(false);
  });

  test("nothing is asked for a signed-out reader, for a page of other people's posts, or for a page of the viewer's visible posts", async () => {
    const rows = [row(1, OTHER, "visible"), row(2, ME, "visible")];
    for (const viewer of [null, ME, OTHER]) {
      const s = source(rows, {});
      await loadPostViews(s.view, viewer, rows.map((r) => r.id));
      expect(s.asked, String(viewer)).toEqual([]);
    }
  });

  test("a restricted post the module names no decision for carries no chip, and a quoted embed never carries one", async () => {
    const rows = [row(1, ME, "removed"), row(2, ME, "visible", { quoteOfId: id(3) }), row(3, ME, "withheld")];
    const s = source(rows, { [id(3)]: { decisionId: id(53), ruleId: "R1", legal: false, interim: true, strikeUntil: null } });
    const views = await loadPostViews(s.view, ME, [id(1), id(2)]);
    const first = views.get(id(1))!;
    const second = views.get(id(2))!;
    if (isTombstone(first) || isTombstone(second)) throw new Error("the author sees their own posts");
    expect("moderation" in first).toBe(false);
    // The quoted post is the viewer's own and withheld: its embed shows it, without a chip of its own.
    expect(second.quoteOf).toMatchObject({ id: id(3), state: "withheld" });
    expect("moderation" in (second.quoteOf as object)).toBe(false);
    // Only the posts of the page itself are asked about.
    expect(s.asked).toEqual([{ viewer: ME, postIds: [id(1)] }]);
  });
});
```

```ts
 * module is one that records what it is asked to lock and to copy, and the media module one that records the pairs it is

 * this holds only their order and how often a target's open case is read.

const POST_TWO = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002";

  contactId: null,
  ruleId: "R1",
  allegesIllegal: false,
  csam: false,
  category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC",
  categoryKeyword: null,
  citedLaw: null,
  explanation: null,
  bonaFide: false,
};

/**
 * The module's dependencies over a recording transaction. `openCases` says what each read of a target's open case
 * answers, in order: a case's id, or null for none; when a target's answers run out, its last one is repeated.
 */
function recording(openCases: Record<string, (string | null)[]>) {
  const dialect = new PgDialect();
  const events: string[] = [];
  const reads: Record<string, number> = {};
  /** What each stored snapshot lists as the target's images. */
  const snapshots: { target: string; media: unknown }[] = [];
  let runs = 0;
  const tx = {
    execute: async (query: SQL) => {
      const { sql: text, params } = dialect.sqlToQuery(query);
      const statement = text.trim();
      if (statement.startsWith("select set_config('lock_timeout'")) return [];
      if (statement.startsWith("insert into intakes")) return events.push("intake"), [{ id: randomUUID() }];
      if (statement.startsWith("insert into cases")) return events.push(`open ${String(params[0])} ${String(params[1])}`), [];
      if (statement.startsWith("select id from cases")) {
        const target = String(params[1]);
        const answers = openCases[target] ?? [`case-of-${target}`];
        const answer = answers[Math.min(reads[target] ?? 0, answers.length - 1)];
        reads[target] = (reads[target] ?? 0) + 1;
        events.push(`read ${String(params[0])} ${target}`);
        return answer === null || answer === undefined ? [] : [{ id: answer }];
      }
      // The insert answers the position and the lane the database stored: for an item that is no re-examination, the ones it was given.
      if (statement.startsWith("insert into intake_items")) {
        return events.push(`item ${String(params[2])} ${String(params[3])} in ${String(params[1])}`), [{ id: randomUUID(), seq: 1, position: Number(params[4]), lane: Number(params[5]) }];
      }
      if (statement.startsWith("select to_char(")) return events.push("time"), [{ at: TAKEN }];
      if (statement.startsWith("select display_name, bio, handle from evidence_snapshots")) return [];
      if (statement.startsWith("insert into evidence_snapshots")) {
        snapshots.push({ target: String(params[2]), media: params[9] === null ? null : JSON.parse(String(params[9])) });
        return events.push(`snapshot ${String(params[1])} ${String(params[2])}`), [{ id: randomUUID(), taken_at: TAKEN }];
      }
      // 3e's review (database1): the closing judgment of a signed-in sender under a rule, the transaction's last read.
      if (statement.startsWith("select p.deleted_at is not null as deleted")) return events.push("judge sender"), [{ deleted: false, suspended: false, reports_restricted: false }];
      throw new Error(`the intake issued a statement this test does not know: ${statement}`);
    },
  };
  /** The media module's hold: every pair it was given, in order, and one image for each post it was asked to hold. */
  const media = {
    hold: async (within: unknown, pairs: readonly ({ caseId: string; postId: string } | { ownerId: string })[]) => {
      if (within !== tx) throw new Error("the hold ran outside the intake's transaction");
      events.push(`hold ${pairs.map((pair) => ("postId" in pair ? `post ${pair.postId} for ${pair.caseId}` : `owner ${pair.ownerId}`)).join(", ") || "nothing"}`);
      return new Map(pairs.flatMap((pair) => ("postId" in pair ? [[pair.postId, [{ id: `image-of-${pair.postId}`, alt: "an image", width: 1200, height: 800 }]] as const] : [])));
    },
  };
  const social = {
    // 3e: each row says whether its account is suspended and restricted in its reports; this sender is neither.
    lockAccounts: async (_tx: unknown, ids: readonly string[]) => (events.push("lock sender"), ids.map((id) => ({ id, deleted: false, suspended: false, reportsRestricted: false }))),
    capturePost: async (_tx: unknown, id: string) => (
      events.push(`copy post ${id}`),
      { id, authorId: randomUUID(), authorHandle: "author", body: "a post", state: "visible", createdAt: new Date(TAKEN), replyToId: null, quoteOfId: null, erased: false }
    ),
    captureProfile: async (_tx: unknown, id: string) => (events.push(`copy account ${id}`), { id, handle: "named", displayName: "Named", bio: "", deleted: false }),
  };
  const apiDb = {
    transaction: async (fn: (transaction: typeof tx) => Promise<unknown>) => {
      runs++;
      events.push(`run ${runs}`);

  };
  const deps = { apiDb, social, media, config: {}, log: pino({ level: "silent" }), now: () => new Date() } as unknown as ModerationDeps;
  return { deps, events, snapshots, runs: () => runs };
}

/** The targets in an order that is not the cases' own: the account first, then the later post, then the earlier one. */

      `open post ${POST_TWO}`,
      `read post ${POST_TWO}`,
      `item post ${POST_TWO} in case-of-${POST_TWO}`,
      `open account ${ACCOUNT}`,
      `read account ${ACCOUNT}`,
      `item account ${ACCOUNT} in case-of-${ACCOUNT}`,
      // No post is copied, and so none is locked, before the last case is taken.
      "time",
      `copy post ${POST_ONE}`,

    expect(world.events.filter((event) => event.startsWith("hold"))).toEqual([`hold post ${POST_ONE} for case-of-${POST_ONE}, post ${POST_TWO} for case-of-${POST_TWO}, owner ${ACCOUNT}`]);
```

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import pino from "pino";
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import type { CaseDecidedParams } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { REDRESS_VERSION, RULES_VERSION } from "@korbat/rules";
import type { ActiveStaffSession, StaffStepUpConfirmed } from "../src/auth";
import { ModerationError, type ModerationDeps } from "../src/moderation/context";
import { decide } from "../src/moderation/decide";
import { recordIntake, type IntakeGround, type IntakeRecorded } from "../src/moderation/intake";
import { fileReply } from "../src/moderation/standing";

/**
 * When the moderation module runs a transaction again (3c design, sections 7.1 and 7.5), without a database: the pool is
 * a stand-in whose transaction never runs its statements and ends the way the test scripts it, with the errors PostgreSQL
 * gives and drizzle wraps. The races that produce these errors for real are in the integration tests.
 */

/** PostgreSQL's error as drizzle hands it over: its own error, with the driver's as the cause. */
const pg = (code: string, extra: Record<string, unknown> = {}) => new Error("Failed query", { cause: Object.assign(new Error(String(extra.message ?? code)), { code, ...extra }) });
const raisedAs = (message: string) => pg("P0001", { message });

/**
 * The module's dependencies over a pool whose transactions end as scripted, one entry for each run; a read finds the case
 * about an account. What a decision starts after its commit is counted and never run.
 */
function scripted(ends: (Error | unknown)[], options: { now?: Date; knowsCase?: boolean } = {}) {
  const subject = randomUUID();
  let runs = 0;
  let started = 0;
  const apiDb = {
    execute: async () => (options.knowsCase === false ? [] : [{ target_type: "account", target_id: subject }]),
    transaction: async () => {
      const end = ends[runs++];
      if (end instanceof Error) throw end;
      if (end === undefined) throw new Error("the transaction ran more often than the test scripted");
      return end;
    },
  };
  const background = { start: () => void started++, settle: async () => undefined };
  const deps = { apiDb, social: {}, background, config: {}, log: pino({ level: "silent" }), now: () => options.now ?? new Date() } as unknown as ModerationDeps;
  return { deps, runs: () => runs, started: () => started };
}

describe("the intake's transaction is run again when it changed nothing and may now succeed", () => {
  const ground: IntakeGround = {
    kind: "user",
    channel: "signed_in",
    reporterId: randomUUID(),
    findingBy: null,
    contactId: null,
    ruleId: "R1",
    allegesIllegal: false,
    csam: false,
    category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC",
    categoryKeyword: null,
    citedLaw: null,
    explanation: null,
    bonaFide: false,
  };
  const request = { ground, live: [{ type: "post" as const, id: randomUUID(), position: 1 }] };
  const stored: IntakeRecorded = { intakeId: randomUUID(), ref: "N-ABCDEFGHIJ", token: null, suspect: false, items: [] };

  test("a case that closed under it, a deadlock and a lock timeout each start it over, and the fourth run's answer is the intake's", async () => {
    // The attach trigger reports a closed case as a serialization failure.
    const world = scripted([pg("40001", { message: "case_closed" }), pg("40P01"), pg("55P03"), stored]);
    expect(await recordIntake(world.deps, request)).toBe(stored);
    expect(world.runs()).toBe(4);
  });

  test("a reference another intake already has starts it over too: the next run draws a new one", async () => {
    const world = scripted([pg("23505", { constraint_name: "intakes_ref_unique" }), stored]);
    expect(await recordIntake(world.deps, request)).toBe(stored);
    expect(world.runs()).toBe(2);
  });

  test("when the fourth run fails the same way the answer is case_closed, and no fifth run is made", async () => {
    const world = scripted([pg("40001"), pg("40001"), pg("40P01"), pg("55P03")]);
    await expect(recordIntake(world.deps, request)).rejects.toMatchObject({ name: "ModerationError", code: "case_closed", status: 409 });
    expect(world.runs()).toBe(4);
  });

  test("a second report by the same sender on the same ground is already_reported, at once", async () => {
    const world = scripted([pg("23505", { constraint_name: "intake_items_reporter_once" })]);
    await expect(recordIntake(world.deps, request)).rejects.toMatchObject({ name: "ModerationError", code: "already_reported" });
    expect(world.runs()).toBe(1);
  });

  test("any other error is thrown as it is, at once", async () => {
    for (const failure of [pg("23503"), pg("23505", { constraint_name: "intake_items_target_once" }), pg("P0001", { message: "quote_item_missing" }), new Error("the connection ended")]) {
      const world = scripted([failure]);
      await expect(recordIntake(world.deps, request)).rejects.toBe(failure);
      expect(world.runs()).toBe(1);
    }
  });
});

describe("a confirmed decision's transaction is run once more only when it changed nothing and time is left", () => {
  const caseId = randomUUID();
  const keyId = randomUUID();
  const session = { userId: randomUUID(), keyId, handle: randomUUID(), role: "admin" } as unknown as ActiveStaffSession;
  const params: CaseDecidedParams = {
    kind: "final",
    stateVersion: 0,
    throughSeq: 1,
    reviewsDecisionId: null,
    snapshotId: randomUUID(),
    snapshotDigest: "a".repeat(64),
    outcome: "no_violation",
    ground: null,
    ruleId: null,
    rulesVersion: RULES_VERSION,
    redressVersion: REDRESS_VERSION,
    category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC",
    categoryKeyword: null,
    actions: [],
    factsDigest: null,
    reasonDigest: null,
    legalReferenceDigest: null,
    unfounded: [],
    replaced: false,
  };
  const now = new Date("2026-10-04T12:00:00.000Z");
  /** A confirmation of the params whose challenge has this many seconds left. */
  const confirmed = (secondsLeft: number, changed: Partial<CaseDecidedParams> = {}): StaffStepUpConfirmed => ({
    action: "case_decided",
    target: { type: "case", id: caseId },
    params: { ...params, ...changed },
    actionHash: "b".repeat(64),
    keyId,
    assertion: { authenticatorData: "AAAA", clientDataJSON: "BBBB", signature: "CCCC" },
    expiresAt: new Date(now.getTime() + secondsLeft * 1000),
  });
  const run = (world: ReturnType<typeof scripted>, secondsLeft = 600, changed: Partial<CaseDecidedParams> = {}) => decide(world.deps, session, confirmed(secondsLeft, changed), { requestId: "req-1" });
  const done = { decisionId: randomUUID() };

  test("a deadlock or a lock timeout runs it once more with the same confirmation", async () => {
    for (const code of ["40P01", "55P03"]) {
      const world = scripted([pg(code), done], { now });
      expect(await run(world), code).toBe(done);
      expect(world.runs(), code).toBe(2);
      // What follows a decision's commit is started once, for the run that committed.
      expect(world.started(), code).toBe(1);
    }
  });

  test("a second failure of that kind is answered as late, without a third run", async () => {
    const world = scripted([pg("40P01"), pg("55P03")], { now });
    expect(await run(world)).toBe("late");
    expect(world.runs()).toBe(2);
    // Nothing committed, so nothing follows: no statement is mailed and no decision counted.
    expect(world.started()).toBe(0);
  });

  test("with a minute or less of the challenge left it is not run again", async () => {
    for (const secondsLeft of [60, 5]) {
      const world = scripted([pg("40P01")], { now });
      expect(await run(world, secondsLeft), String(secondsLeft)).toBe("late");
      expect(world.runs()).toBe(1);
    }
    const world = scripted([pg("40P01"), done], { now });
    expect(await run(world, 61)).toBe(done);
  });

  test("the audit row's refusals are answers, not errors: the key or the account ended, or the challenge's time ran out", async () => {
    const [ended, late] = [scripted([raisedAs("staff_confirmation_ended")], { now }), scripted([raisedAs("staff_confirmation_late")], { now })];
    expect(await run(ended)).toBe("ended");
    expect(await run(late)).toBe("late");
    expect([ended.started(), late.started()]).toEqual([0, 0]);
  });

  test("a code a trigger raised is thrown as its ModerationError; anything else as it is", async () => {
    for (const code of ["case_changed", "staff_recused", "staff_target", "admin_required", "decision_cap", "profile_changed", "snapshot_mismatch", "snapshot_erased", "text_not_found", "invalid_decision"] as const) {
      const world = scripted([raisedAs(code)], { now });
      await expect(run(world), code).rejects.toMatchObject({ name: "ModerationError", code });
      expect(world.runs()).toBe(1);
    }
    for (const failure of [raisedAs("something_else"), pg("23503"), pg("40001")]) {
      const world = scripted([failure], { now });
      await expect(run(world)).rejects.toBe(failure);
      expect(world.runs()).toBe(1);
    }
  });

  test("a decision under other texts than the API serves is refused before anything is read or written", async () => {
    for (const changed of [{ redressVersion: REDRESS_VERSION + 1 }, { rulesVersion: RULES_VERSION - 1 }]) {
      const world = scripted([done], { now });
      await expect(run(world, 600, changed)).rejects.toMatchObject({ name: "ModerationError", code: "invalid_decision" });
      expect(world.runs()).toBe(0);
    }
  });

  test("a case that does not exist is not found", async () => {
    const world = scripted([done], { now, knowsCase: false });
    const err = await run(world).catch((caught: unknown) => caught);
    expect(err).toBeInstanceOf(ModerationError);
    expect(err).toMatchObject({ code: "not_found", status: 404 });
    expect(world.runs()).toBe(0);
  });

  test("a confirmation of anything but this decision by this session's key is a wiring fault, not a refusal", async () => {
    const world = scripted([done], { now });
    const other = { ...confirmed(600), keyId: randomUUID() };
    await expect(decide(world.deps, session, other, { requestId: "req-1" })).rejects.toThrow(/needs a step-up that confirmed it/);
    const revoked = { ...confirmed(600), action: "staff_session_revoked" } as unknown as StaffStepUpConfirmed;
    await expect(decide(world.deps, session, revoked, { requestId: "req-1" })).rejects.toThrow(/needs a step-up that confirmed it/);
    expect(world.runs()).toBe(0);
  });
});

describe("the reply's transaction is run again when it changed nothing (3e design, section 7.6 step 9)", () => {
  /** The reply's dependencies over a pool whose read finds the decision's measure and whose transactions end as scripted. */
  function replying(ends: unknown[]) {
    let runs = 0;
    const apiDb = {
      execute: async () => [{ id: randomUUID() }],
      transaction: async () => {
        const end = ends[runs++];
        if (end instanceof Error) throw end;
        if (end === undefined) throw new Error("the transaction ran more often than the test scripted");
        return end;
      },
    };
    return { deps: { apiDb, social: {} } as unknown as Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb" | "social">, runs: () => runs };
  }
  const filed = { filedAt: "2026-10-12T10:00:00.000Z", onTime: true };

  test("a deadlock, a lock timeout and the bound's statement timeout each run it again, and the third run's answer is the reply's", async () => {
    const world = replying([pg("40P01"), pg("55P03"), filed]);
    expect(await fileReply(world.deps, randomUUID(), randomUUID(), {})).toBe(filed);
    expect(world.runs()).toBe(3);
    const bounded = replying([pg("57014"), filed]);
    expect(await fileReply(bounded.deps, randomUUID(), randomUUID(), {})).toBe(filed);
    expect(bounded.runs()).toBe(2);
  });

  test("when the third run fails the same way the answer is service_unavailable, and no fourth run is made", async () => {
    const world = replying([pg("40P01"), pg("55P03"), pg("57014")]);
    await expect(fileReply(world.deps, randomUUID(), randomUUID(), {})).rejects.toMatchObject({ name: "ModerationError", code: "service_unavailable", status: 503 });
    expect(world.runs()).toBe(3);
  });

  test("a reply that is not open is answered at once, whether the trigger or the primary key finds it; anything else is thrown as it is", async () => {
    for (const failure of [raisedAs("reply_not_open"), pg("23505", { constraint_name: "suspension_replies_pkey" })]) {
      const world = replying([failure]);
      await expect(fileReply(world.deps, randomUUID(), randomUUID(), {})).rejects.toMatchObject({ name: "ModerationError", code: "reply_not_open" });
      expect(world.runs()).toBe(1);
    }
    const other = pg("23503");
    const world = replying([other]);
    await expect(fileReply(world.deps, randomUUID(), randomUUID(), {})).rejects.toBe(other);
    expect(world.runs()).toBe(1);
  });
});
```

```tsx
    expect(readdirSync(path.join(SRC, "app", "settings", "cases")).sort()).toEqual(["[id]", "[id].tsx", "index.tsx"]);
    // 3e Task 4: the reply screen sits beside the decision's screen, at /settings/cases/<id>/reply.
    expect(readdirSync(path.join(SRC, "app", "settings", "cases", "[id]")).sort()).toEqual(["reply.tsx"]);
    for (const file of ["index.tsx", "[id].tsx"]) expect(read("app", "settings", "cases", file), file).toContain('<SettingsNav current="cases" />');
    // Two tabs, and the list each shows.
    const screen = read("app", "settings", "cases", "index.tsx");
    expect(screen).toContain('accessibilityRole="tablist"');
    expect(screen).toContain("moderation.cases(");
    expect(screen).toContain("moderation.reports(");
    expect(screen).toContain("moderation.resumeReportMail()");
  });

  const row = (extra: Partial<AuthorCaseRow> = {}): AuthorCaseRow => ({
    id: id(3),
    kind: "final",
    outcome: "restricted",
    decidedOn: "2026-10-05",
    post: { id: id(1), createdAt: TIME },
    actions: ["remove"],
    endedInterim: false,
    ruleId: "R3",
    legal: false,
    appealUntil: "2027-04-05T10:00:00.000Z",
    reversedOn: null,
    appeal: null,
    strike: null,
    ...extra,
  });

  test("About you lists each decision with its day, what was done, the post's time, the rule or the law and where its appeal stands, each a link to its screen", () => {
    const rows = [
      row(),
      row({ id: id(4), kind: "interim", actions: ["seal_media", "withhold"], ruleId: null, legal: true, appealUntil: null }),
      row({ id: id(5), post: null, actions: ["reset_bio"], ruleId: "R6", appealUntil: null, reversedOn: "2026-10-06" }),
      row({ id: id(6), outcome: "no_violation", actions: [], endedInterim: true, ruleId: null, appealUntil: null }),
      row({ id: id(7), kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed", actions: ["restore"], ruleId: null, appealUntil: null }),
    ];
    const out = html(<DecisionsList decisions={rows} />);
    const text = textOf(out);
    expect(hrefs(out)).toEqual(rows.map((one) => `/settings/cases/${one.id}`));
    expect(count(text, CASES_WORDS.decidedOn("2026-10-05"))).toBe(5);
    expect(text).toContain(CASES_WORDS.post(utcMinute(TIME)));
    expect(text).toContain(CASES_WORDS.profile);
    // What was done, in the measures' own labels.
    for (const label of ["Remove", "Seal the images this case reaches", "Withhold the post", "Reset bio", "Lift the restriction of the post"]) expect(text, label).toContain(label);
    expect(text).toContain(CASES_WORDS.rule("R3"));
    expect(text).toContain(CASES_WORDS.law);
    expect(text).toContain(CASES_WORDS.whileDeciding);
    expect(text).toContain(CASES_WORDS.ended);
    expect(text).toContain(CASES_WORDS.correction);
    expect(count(text, "You can appeal until")).toBe(1);
    expect(text).toContain(CASES_WORDS.appealOpen(utcMinute("2027-04-05T10:00:00.000Z")));
    expect(text).toContain(CASES_WORDS.reversed("2026-10-06"));
    expect(textOf(html(<DecisionsList decisions={[]} />))).toContain(CASES_WORDS.noDecisions);
  });

  test("the answer to an appeal that kept the decision reads as a kept decision, never as No action; a reversal by what it lifted", () => {
    const kept = row({ id: id(8), kind: "review", outcome: "kept", actions: [], ruleId: null, appealUntil: null });
    const reversed = row({ id: id(9), kind: "review", outcome: "reversed", actions: ["restore"], ruleId: null, appealUntil: null });
    const text = textOf(html(<DecisionsList decisions={[kept, reversed, row()]} />));
    expect(CASES_WORDS.keptDecision).toBe("korbat kept its decision");
    expect(count(text, CASES_WORDS.keptDecision)).toBe(1);
    expect(text).not.toContain(CASES_WORDS.noAction);
    expect(text).toContain(MEASURES.restore.label);
    // A final decision without a measure that ended nothing still reads No action.
    expect(textOf(html(<DecisionsList decisions={[row({ id: id(10), outcome: "no_violation", actions: [], ruleId: null, appealUntil: null })]} />))).toContain(CASES_WORDS.noAction);
  });

  const reports = (extra: Partial<ReportsPage> = {}): ReportsPage => ({
    reports: [
      { ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", receivedAt: TIME, items: [{ ...item({ link: `${APP}/u/old_handle`, scope: "account", outcome: "no_violation", reexamination: { open: true, until: UNTIL } }), id: id(21), unfounded: false }, { ...waiting, position: 2, id: id(22), unfounded: false }] },
      { ref: "N-BCDEFGH234", receivedAt: TIME, items: [{ ...item({ outcome: "not_evident", unseen: true, reexamination: { open: true, until: UNTIL } }), id: id(23), unfounded: false }] },
    ],
    nextCursor: null,
    reportMailStopped: false,
    ...extra,
  });

  test("Your reports lists each report with its items as the status page words them: the account under the handle the report named, the outcome once released, and whether it can still be examined again", () => {
    const answer = reports();
    const out = html(<ReportsList page={answer} />);
    const text = textOf(out);
    expect(text).toContain("N-ABCDEFGH23");
    expect(text).toContain(`${APP}/u/old_handle`);
    expect(text).toContain(itemOutcomeWords(answer.reports[0]!.items[0]!)!);
    expect(text).toContain(STATUS_WORDS.reexaminationOpen(utcMinute(UNTIL)));
    expect(text).toContain(STATUS_WORDS.waiting);
    expect(text).toContain(UNSEEN_NO_ACTION);
    expect(text).not.toContain(STATUS_WORDS.final);
    // Without a stop there is no notice and no button.
    expect(text).not.toContain(CASES_WORDS.mailStopped);
    expect(buttons(out)).toEqual([]);
    expect(textOf(html(<ReportsList page={reports({ reports: [] })} />))).toContain(CASES_WORDS.noReports);
  });

  test("when the account's address stopped korbat's report mails, the tab says so above the list, with the button that resumes them and what that also allows", () => {
    const out = html(<ReportsList page={reports({ reportMailStopped: true })} />);
    const text = textOf(out);
    expect(text).toContain(CASES_WORDS.mailStopped);
    expect(buttons(out)).toEqual([CASES_WORDS.resume]);
    expect(text).toContain(CASES_WORDS.resumeHint);
    expect(text.indexOf(CASES_WORDS.mailStopped)).toBeLessThan(text.indexOf("N-ABCDEFGH23"));
    expect(read("lib", "moderation.ts")).toContain('resumeReportMail: () => api("/api/moderation/report-mail/resume", { method: "POST" })');
  });
});

describe("a decision's screen", () => {
  const statement = {
    kind: "final" as const,
    outcome: "restricted" as const,
    ground: "incompatible" as const,
    ruleId: "R3" as const,
    rulesVersion: 2,
    redressVersion: 1,
    legalReference: null,
    facts: "The post attacks a group for its religion.",
    reason: "That is an attack on people, not on an idea.",
    source: "report" as const,
    decidedAt: TIME,
    post: { id: id(1), createdAt: "2026-09-01T08:30:00.000Z" },
    measures: [{ kind: "remove" as const, mediaId: null, noEffect: null, sealed: null }],
    reversals: [],
    endedMeasures: [],
    reviewed: null,
  };
  const image = (n: number) => ({ id: id(n), alt: `picture ${n}`, width: 800, height: 600, small: `/api/media/${id(n)}/small.webp`, large: `/api/media/${id(n)}/large.webp` });
  const view = (extra: Partial<DecisionView> = {}): DecisionView => ({
    id: id(3),
    ...statement,
    appealUntil: "2027-04-04T10:00:00.000Z",
    reversedOn: null,
    content: { kind: "post", body: "the words that were judged", deletedByAuthor: false, images: [image(7)], imageCount: 1, imagesHidden: null },
    appeal: null,
    strike: null,
    standing: null,
    ...extra,
  });
  const screen = (extra: Partial<DecisionView> = {}) => html(<DecisionDetail view={view(extra)} />);

  test("a final restriction: the statement as the mail rendered it, the post's time, the content it was made on, and Appeal with its deadline", () => {
    const out = screen();
    const text = textOf(out);
    for (const paragraph of statementParagraphs(view())) expect(text).toContain(paragraph);
    expect(text).toContain(`"${getRule("R3", 2)!.title}"`);
    expect(text).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.automation);
    expect(text).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.post("2026-09-01 08:30 UTC"));
    expect(text).toContain("the words that were judged");
    // The image comes from the app's own image route, with its description.
    expect(loaded(out)).toEqual([expect.stringContaining(`/api/media/${id(7)}/small.webp`)]);
    expect(out).toContain('alt="picture 7"');
    expect(text).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.appeal);
    expect(text).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.appealUntil("2027-04-04 10:00 UTC"));
    expect(text).not.toContain("Reversed in full");
  });

  test("a decision taken while korbat decides: the interim redress, and no Appeal", () => {
    const interim = { kind: "interim" as const, measures: [{ kind: "withhold" as const, mediaId: null, noEffect: null, sealed: null }], appealUntil: null };
    const text = textOf(screen(interim));
    expect(text).toContain(REDRESS_TEXTS[1].interim);
    expect(text).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.scope.interim);
    // Neither the section nor its sentence: the interim redress never says the word.
    expect(text).not.toContain("Appeal");
    expect(text).not.toContain("You can appeal this decision until");
    expect(text).not.toContain("Reversed in full");
  });

  test("a restriction reversed in full says on which day, in place of Appeal", () => {
    const text = textOf(screen({ appealUntil: null, reversedOn: "2026-10-06" }));
    expect(text).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.reversed("2026-10-06"));
    expect(text).not.toContain("You can appeal this decision until");
  });

  test("a post whose images are sealed keeps its text: each sealed image is drawn as its placeholder, and nothing is loaded for it", () => {
    const sealed = {
      kind: "interim" as const,
      ruleId: "R2" as const,
      measures: [{ kind: "seal_media" as const, mediaId: null, noEffect: null, sealed: { posts: 1, images: 2, deletedImages: 0 } }],
      appealUntil: null,
      content: { kind: "post" as const, body: "text beside the images", deletedByAuthor: false, images: [], imageCount: 2, imagesHidden: "sealed" as const },
    };
    const out = screen(sealed);
    const text = textOf(out);
    expect(text).toContain("text beside the images");
    expect(count(text, SEALED_IMAGE)).toBe(2);
    expect(loaded(out)).toEqual([]);
    expect(text).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.sealPost("2026-09-01 08:30 UTC", 2));
  });

  test("a post its author deleted: korbat's copy of the text under its own heading, and its images kept and not shown", () => {
    const out = screen({ content: { kind: "post", body: "deleted since", deletedByAuthor: true, images: [], imageCount: 2, imagesHidden: "deleted_by_author" } });
    const text = textOf(out);
    expect(text).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.deleted);
    expect(text.indexOf(DECISION_WORDS.deleted)).toBeLessThan(text.indexOf("deleted since"));
    expect(count(text, DECISION_WORDS.deletedImages)).toBe(1);
    expect(loaded(out)).toEqual([]);
    // A deleted post without images says nothing of images.
    expect(textOf(screen({ content: { kind: "post", body: "deleted since", deletedByAuthor: true, images: [], imageCount: 0, imagesHidden: "deleted_by_author" } }))).not.toContain(DECISION_WORDS.deletedImages);
  });

  test("content korbat no longer holds: erased under the retention rules on its day, with the profile sentence only for a post its author kept; or erased by the R4 decision", () => {
    const kept = textOf(screen({ content: { kind: "erased", contentErasedOn: "2027-04-06", postKept: true } }));
    expect(kept).toContain(`${DECISION_WORDS.erased("2027-04-06")} ${DECISION_WORDS.postKept}`);
    const gone = textOf(screen({ content: { kind: "erased", contentErasedOn: "2027-04-06", postKept: false } }));
    expect(gone).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.erased("2027-04-06"));
    expect(gone).not.toContain(DECISION_WORDS.postKept);
    const redacted = textOf(screen({ ruleId: "R4", content: { kind: "r4_redacted" } }));
    expect(redacted).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.r4Redacted);
    expect(redacted).not.toContain("was erased on");
    // The post's time stays on the screen whatever became of the content.
    for (const text of [kept, gone, redacted]) expect(text).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.post("2026-09-01 08:30 UTC"));
  });

  test("a decision about the account shows the fields as korbat copied them, and links the decision that reset a field while its value is still kept", () => {
    const reset = {
      post: null,
      ruleId: "R6" as const,
      measures: [{ kind: "reset_bio" as const, mediaId: null, noEffect: null, sealed: null }],
      content: { kind: "account" as const, handle: "ada", displayName: "Ada", bio: "what the bio said" },
    };
    const text = textOf(screen(reset));
    expect(text).toContain(`${DECISION_WORDS.bio} what the bio said`);
    expect(text).toContain(`${DECISION_WORDS.displayName} Ada`);
    expect(text).not.toContain("Your post of");
    // A later decision that lifts the reset: its statement says where the old value can be read, and the screen links there.
    const lifted = {
      kind: "correction" as const,
      outcome: "reversed" as const,
      ground: null,
      ruleId: null,
      facts: null,
      post: null,
      measures: [],
      reversals: [{ kind: "restore_bio" as const, mediaId: null, resetDecisionId: id(3), oldValueKept: true, resetRuleId: "R6" as const }],
      reviewed: { kind: "final" as const, ground: "incompatible" as const, ruleId: "R6" as const, rulesVersion: 2, legalReference: null, decidedAt: TIME },
      appealUntil: null,
      content: { kind: "account" as const, handle: "ada", displayName: "Ada", bio: "what the bio said" },
    };
    const out = screen({ id: id(8), ...lifted });
    expect(textOf(out)).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.oldValueKept);
    expect(textOf(out)).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.resetDecision);
    expect(hrefs(out)).toContain(`/settings/cases/${id(3)}`);
    // Once the old value is gone, nothing links there.
    const erased = screen({ id: id(8), ...lifted, reversals: [{ ...lifted.reversals[0]!, oldValueKept: false }] });
    expect(hrefs(erased)).not.toContain(`/settings/cases/${id(3)}`);
  });

  test("the screen asks for the decision by the id in its address and says when there is none for this account", () => {
    const source = read("app", "settings", "cases", "[id].tsx");
    expect(source).toContain("moderation.decision(id)");
    expect(source).toContain("DECISION_WORDS.notFound");
    expect(read("lib", "moderation.ts")).toContain("decision: (id: string) => api(`/api/moderation/decisions/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { schema: DecisionView })");
  });
});

describe("the chips and the labels", () => {
  const post = (extra: Partial<PostView> = {}): PostView => ({
    id: id(1),
    author: { id: id(900), handle: "ada", displayName: "Ada", verified: false },
    body: "my own post",
    createdAt: TIME,
    state: "removed",
    replyTo: null,
    counts: { likes: 0, reposts: 0, replies: 0, quotes: 0 },
    media: [],
    quoteOf: null,
    ...extra,
  });
  const me = (userId: string) => ({ status: "signed-in", me: { user: { id: userId, onboarded: true }, profile: { handle: "ada" } } });
  const image = (n: number, moderation?: MediaView["moderation"]): MediaView => ({ id: id(n), width: 800, height: 600, blurhash: "LEHV6nWB2yk8", alt: `picture ${n}`, small: `/api/media/${id(n)}/small.webp`, large: `/api/media/${id(n)}/large.webp`, ...(moderation ? { moderation } : {}) });

  test("the chip's four texts: under review or removed, under a rule or as illegal content", () => {
    expect(CHIP_WORDS).toEqual({ underReview: "Under review", removed: "Removed", illegal: "illegal content" });
    const decision = { decisionId: id(3), ruleId: "R4" as const, legal: false, interim: true, strikeUntil: null };
    expect(chipText(decision)).toBe("Under review: R4");
    expect(chipText({ ...decision, ruleId: null, legal: true })).toBe("Under review: illegal content");
    expect(chipText({ ...decision, ruleId: "R3", interim: false })).toBe("Removed: R3");
    expect(chipText({ ...decision, ruleId: null, legal: true, interim: false })).toBe("Removed: illegal content");
  });

  test("3e: a removed post's chip names its strike while the strike stands and counts, with the day it stops counting", () => {
    const until = "2027-01-10T09:00:00.000Z";
    const decision = { decisionId: id(3), ruleId: "R3" as const, legal: false, interim: false, strikeUntil: until };
    expect(chipText(decision)).toBe(`Removed: R3, strike until ${standingDay(until)}`);
    expect(chipText({ ...decision, strikeUntil: null })).toBe("Removed: R3");
    session.state = me(id(900));
    const removed = textOf(html(<PostCard post={post({ moderation: decision })} />));
    expect(removed).toContain(STANDING_TEXTS.chip("Removed: R3", until));
  });

  test("the author's own withheld or removed post shows the chip as a link to the decision's statement, amber while korbat decides and red once removed", () => {
    session.state = me(id(900));
    const removed = html(<PostCard post={post({ moderation: { decisionId: id(3), ruleId: "R3", legal: false, interim: false, strikeUntil: null } })} />);
    expect(textOf(removed)).toContain("Removed: R3");
    expect(hrefs(removed)).toContain(`/settings/cases/${id(3)}`);
    const held = html(<PostCard post={post({ state: "withheld", moderation: { decisionId: id(4), ruleId: null, legal: true, interim: true, strikeUntil: null } })} />);
    expect(textOf(held)).toContain("Under review: illegal content");
    expect(hrefs(held)).toContain(`/settings/cases/${id(4)}`);
    // The colours are class names, which a render without the style compiler does not carry: they are read from the source.
    const card = read("components", "social", "PostCard.tsx");
    expect(card).toContain('const amber = decision ? decision.interim : post.state === "withheld";');
    expect(card).toContain('const surface = `self-start rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 ${amber ? "bg-amber-500/15" : "bg-red-500/15"}`;');
    // Without the decision's facts the chip still says the state, and links nowhere.
    const bare = html(<PostCard post={post()} />);
    expect(textOf(bare)).toContain("Removed");
    expect(hrefs(bare).filter((href) => href.startsWith("/settings/cases"))).toEqual([]);
    // A post whose images are sealed keeps its text and its place, without a chip: the post itself is visible.
    const sealedMedia: HiddenMedia[] = [{ id: id(21), hidden: true, sealed: true }, { id: id(22), hidden: true, sealed: true }];
    const sealed = html(<PostCard post={post({ state: "visible", media: sealedMedia })} />);
    expect(textOf(sealed)).toContain("my own post");
    expect(count(textOf(sealed), SEALED_IMAGE)).toBe(2);
    expect(hrefs(sealed).filter((href) => href.startsWith("/settings/cases"))).toEqual([]);
    session.state = { status: "signed-out" };
    // Anyone else reads the placeholder of a hidden image for each of them.
    const others = html(<PostCard post={post({ state: "visible", media: [{ id: id(21), hidden: true }, { id: id(22), hidden: true }] })} />);
    expect(count(textOf(others), HIDDEN_IMAGE)).toBe(2);
    expect(textOf(others)).not.toContain(SEALED_IMAGE);
  });

  test("the author's own withheld image says Under review on itself and a removed one Removed, in the post and in the viewer; anyone else gets one placeholder for both", () => {
    const own = html(<MediaGrid media={[image(1, "withheld"), image(2, "removed"), image(3)]} postId={id(1)} own />);
    const text = textOf(own);
    expect(count(text, "Under review")).toBe(1);
    expect(count(text, "Removed")).toBe(1);
    // The author still sees their own images.
    expect(loaded(own)).toHaveLength(3);
    const noop = () => undefined;
    expect(textOf(html(<MediaViewerContent media={[image(1, "withheld")]} index={0} onIndex={noop} onClose={noop} />))).toContain("Under review");
    expect(textOf(html(<MediaViewerContent media={[image(2, "removed")]} index={0} onIndex={noop} onClose={noop} />))).toContain("Removed");
    expect(textOf(html(<MediaViewerContent media={[image(3)]} index={0} onIndex={noop} onClose={noop} />))).not.toMatch(/Under review|Removed/);
    // For anyone else the API sends the same hidden image for a withheld and a removed one: one placeholder, which does not say which.
    const hidden: HiddenMedia = { id: id(1), hidden: true };
    const others = textOf(html(<MediaGrid media={[hidden, { ...hidden, id: id(2) }]} postId={id(1)} />));
    expect(count(others, HIDDEN_IMAGE)).toBe(2);
    expect(others).not.toMatch(/Under review|Removed/);
  });
});

describe("3e: strikes on Cases and on the decision's screen (design, sections 9.2 and 9.4)", () => {
  const COUNTS = "2027-01-10T09:00:00.000Z";
  const row = (extra: Partial<AuthorCaseRow> = {}): AuthorCaseRow => ({
    id: id(3),
    kind: "final",
    outcome: "restricted",
    decidedOn: "2026-10-12",
    post: { id: id(1), createdAt: TIME },
    actions: ["remove", "strike"],
    endedInterim: false,
    ruleId: "R3",
    legal: false,
    appealUntil: null,
    reversedOn: null,
    appeal: null,
    strike: { countsUntil: COUNTS, overruledAt: null },
    ...extra,
  });
  const list = (extra: Partial<AuthorCaseRow>, now = new Date("2026-10-12T10:00:00.000Z")) => textOf(html(<DecisionsList decisions={[row(extra)]} now={now} />));

  test("the numbers of the sentences are STANDING_RULES', and a time names the device's minute and the UTC one", () => {
    expect(STANDING_TEXTS.cases.strikes(2)).toBe("Active strikes: 2 of 3. At 3, a moderator may announce a suspension; you would be told first and could reply.");
    expect(STANDING_TEXTS.cases.none).toBe("You have no active strikes.");
    expect(standingTime("2026-10-16T14:05:00.000Z").endsWith("(14:05 UTC)")).toBe(true);
    expect(standingTime("2026-10-16T14:05:00.000Z").startsWith(standingDay("2026-10-16T14:05:00.000Z"))).toBe(true);
  });

  test("Your standing stands above About you: the active strikes and what that many leads to, or that there are none", () => {
    expect(textOf(html(<StandingBlock activeStrikes={0} />))).toBe(`${STANDING_TEXTS.cases.title} ${STANDING_TEXTS.cases.none}`);
    expect(textOf(html(<StandingBlock activeStrikes={2} />))).toContain(STANDING_TEXTS.cases.strikes(2));
    const screen = read("app", "settings", "cases", "index.tsx");
    expect(screen).toContain("setActiveStrikes(page.activeStrikes)");
    expect(screen.indexOf("<StandingBlock")).toBeLessThan(screen.indexOf("<DecisionsList"));
  });

  test("a row names the strike after the post measure, with where it stands, and an overruling in its own words", () => {
    expect(list({})).toContain(`Remove, ${CASE_ROW_WORDS.strike} (${CASE_ROW_WORDS.counts(COUNTS)})`);
    expect(list({}, new Date("2027-02-01T00:00:00.000Z"))).toContain(`${CASE_ROW_WORDS.strike} (${CASE_ROW_WORDS.expired})`);
    expect(list({ strike: { countsUntil: COUNTS, overruledAt: "2026-10-20T08:00:00.000Z" } })).toContain(`${CASE_ROW_WORDS.strike} (${CASE_ROW_WORDS.overruled})`);
    expect(list({ kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed", actions: ["overrule", "restore"], strike: null })).toContain(`${CASE_ROW_WORDS.overrule}, ${MEASURES.restore.label}`);
  });

  test("the decision's screen says where its strike stands now, below the statement", () => {
    const view: DecisionView = {
      id: id(3),
      kind: "final",
      outcome: "restricted",
      ground: "incompatible",
      ruleId: "R3",
      rulesVersion: 3,
      redressVersion: 2,
      legalReference: null,
      facts: "The post attacks a group for its religion.",
      reason: "That is an attack on people, not on an idea.",
      source: "report",
      decidedAt: TIME,
      post: { id: id(1), createdAt: "2026-09-01T08:30:00.000Z" },

    expect(list({ ...lift, liftedStanding: { kind: "suspend", replaced: false } })).toContain(CASE_ROW_WORDS.lifted);

      reporting: null,

    expect(textOf(out)).toContain(refusalSentence(running));
    expect(textOf(out)).toContain(STANDING_TEXTS.refused.read);
    expect(out).toContain(`href="/settings/cases/${id(9)}"`);
    expect(textOf(html(<RefusedNotice standing={null} />))).toBe(STANDING_TEXTS.refused.over);
    expect(isSuspendedRefusal(new ApiError(403, "account_suspended", "server wording"))).toBe(true);
    expect(isSuspendedRefusal(new ApiError(403, "reauth_required", "x"))).toBe(false);
    // A static render cannot press a button: the card and the profile's follow read their refusals through these two.
    for (const file of [["components", "social", "PostCard.tsx"], ["app", "u", "[handle]", "index.tsx"]]) {

      expect(source, file.join("/")).toContain("isSuspendedRefusal(err)");
      expect(source, file.join("/")).toContain("<RefusedNotice");
    }
  });
});
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { MEASURES, MEASURE_KINDS, RETENTION, REVERSAL_KINDS, SEAL_DRAFTS, STANDING_RULES, appealDeadline, type DecisionStatement, type MeasureKind, type ReversalKind } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { REDRESS_TEXTS, RULEBOOKS, STATEMENT_WORDS, getRule, retireEnd, statementParagraphs, type StatementInput } from "../src/index";

/**
 * The statement of reasons (3c design, section 10): one pure function renders it for the author's screen, the console's
 * preview and the mail, from the decision's data and the versions it was made under. These tests hold it to the six
 * elements of Article 17(3) of the Digital Services Act for every kind of decision, and to the design's sentences word
 * for word.
 */
const POST = { id: "7e2d9a10-6c3b-4f5e-8a21-0d4c7b9e1f36", createdAt: "2026-10-01T12:00:00.000Z" };
const POST_TIME = "2026-10-01 12:00 UTC";
const DECIDED = "2026-10-04T09:30:15.250Z";
const IMAGE = "0a1b2c3d-4e5f-4a6b-8c7d-9e0f1a2b3c4d";
const RESET_DECISION = "3f1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a";
const NO_RESET = { resetDecisionId: null, oldValueKept: false, resetRuleId: null } as const;

const measure = (kind: MeasureKind, more: Partial<DecisionStatement["measures"][number]> = {}): DecisionStatement["measures"][number] => ({
  kind,
  mediaId: MEASURES[kind].target === "image" ? IMAGE : null,
  noEffect: null,
  sealed: kind === "seal_media" ? { posts: 1, images: 2, deletedImages: 0 } : null,
  ...more,
});
const reversal = (kind: ReversalKind, more: Partial<DecisionStatement["reversals"][number]> = {}): DecisionStatement["reversals"][number] => ({
  kind,
  mediaId: MEASURES[kind].target === "image" ? IMAGE : null,
  ...NO_RESET,
  ...more,
});

/** A final removal of a post under R1, following a report: the plainest restricting decision. */
function statement(more: Partial<StatementInput> = {}): StatementInput {
  return {
    kind: "final",
    outcome: "restricted",
    ground: "incompatible",
    ruleId: "R1",
    rulesVersion: 2,
    redressVersion: 1,
    legalReference: null,
    facts: "The post shows explicit sexual acts.",
    reason: "That is content whose primary purpose is sexual arousal.",
    source: "report",
    decidedAt: DECIDED,
    post: POST,
    measures: [measure("remove")],
    reversals: [],
    endedMeasures: [],
    reviewed: null,
    ...more,
  };
}

const W = STATEMENT_WORDS;
const text = (input: StatementInput) => statementParagraphs(input).join("\n");
const appeal = (decidedAt: string) => REDRESS_TEXTS[1].appeal.replace("{deadline}", `${appealDeadline(new Date(decidedAt)).toISOString().slice(0, 10)} ${appealDeadline(new Date(decidedAt)).toISOString().slice(11, 16)} UTC`);

describe("statementParagraphs", () => {
  test("a final removal under a rule, paragraph by paragraph: what was done, where and how long, how it came to korbat, no automation, the rule as its version words it, the facts, the reason and the appeal", () => {
    expect(statementParagraphs(statement())).toEqual([
      `korbat removed your post of ${POST_TIME}: other people can no longer see it.`,
      "This applies everywhere korbat is available and has no end date.",
      "korbat decided this following a report by another user.",
      "No automated means were used to find this or to decide it.",
      `It breaks korbat rule R1, "No sexual or pornographic content": ${getRule("R1", 2)!.text}`,
      "The facts: The post shows explicit sexual acts.",
      "korbat's reasons: That is content whose primary purpose is sexual arousal.",
      appeal(DECIDED),
    ]);
    // The deadline is the appeal's own: six months after the decision, to the minute, in UTC.
    expect(text(statement())).toContain("until 2027-04-04 09:30 UTC");
  });

  test("a time is printed as the mails print one: the date and the minute, in UTC", () => {
    expect(text(statement({ post: { id: POST.id, createdAt: "2026-02-28T23:59:59.999Z" } }))).toContain("your post of 2026-02-28 23:59 UTC");
  });

  test("an old statement renders with the rulebook it was made under", () => {
    for (const version of [1, 2, 3] as const) {
      for (const rule of RULEBOOKS[version]) {
        const out = text(statement({ ruleId: rule.id as StatementInput["ruleId"], rulesVersion: version }));
        expect(out, `${rule.id} v${version}`).toContain(`It breaks korbat rule ${rule.id}, "${rule.title}": ${rule.text}`);
      }
    }
    // R6 changed its title, R1 its text: version 1 keeps the old words.
    expect(text(statement({ ruleId: "R6", rulesVersion: 1 }))).toContain('"No spam, scams, or impersonation"');
    expect(text(statement({ ruleId: "R6", rulesVersion: 2 }))).toContain('"No spam, scams, impersonation or coordinated manipulation"');
    expect(text(statement({ ruleId: "R1", rulesVersion: 1 }))).toContain("Images that score high on the automated check");
    expect(text(statement({ ruleId: "R1", rulesVersion: 2 }))).not.toContain("Images that score high on the automated check");
    // A version the package does not hold cannot be rendered as another one.
    expect(() => statementParagraphs(statement({ rulesVersion: 9 }))).toThrow(/rulebook/);
    expect(() => statementParagraphs(statement({ redressVersion: 9 }))).toThrow(/redress/);
  });

  test("a decision on the law names the law, never a rule, and says that it applies everywhere", () => {
    const out = statementParagraphs(statement({ ground: "illegal", ruleId: null, legalReference: "Section 241 of the criminal code (threats).", source: "notice" }));
    expect(out).toContain("korbat found it illegal. The law it rests on: Section 241 of the criminal code (threats).");
    expect(out).toContain("korbat cannot restrict content for one country alone, so this applies everywhere, which is more than the law of a single country asks for.");
    expect(out).toContain("korbat decided this following a notice under Article 16 of the Digital Services Act.");
    expect(out.join("\n")).not.toMatch(/korbat rule R[1-6]/);
  });

  test("the source is one of three phrases", () => {
    expect(W.source).toEqual({
      notice: "following a notice under Article 16 of the Digital Services Act",
      report: "following a report by another user",
      own_initiative: "found by a moderator",
    });
    expect(text(statement({ source: "own_initiative" }))).toContain("What this decision is about was found by a moderator.");
    for (const source of ["notice", "report", "own_initiative"] as const) expect(text(statement({ source })), source).toContain(W.source[source]);
  });

  describe("the redress text follows the decision's own kind and outcome, never a later event", () => {
    test("an interim decision carries the interim text and no appeal", () => {
      const out = statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "interim", measures: [measure("withhold")] }));
      expect(out[0]).toBe(`korbat hid your post of ${POST_TIME} from other people while it decides.`);
      expect(out).toContain("This applies everywhere korbat is available, for as long as korbat decides the case.");
      expect(out.at(-1)).toBe(REDRESS_TEXTS[1].interim);
      expect(out.join("\n")).not.toContain("You can appeal this decision once");
    });

    test("a final restriction carries korbat's appeal with its deadline", () => {
      expect(statementParagraphs(statement()).at(-1)).toBe(appeal(DECIDED));
    });

    test("every other decision carries the text for a decision its author cannot appeal", () => {
      const reviewed = { kind: "final" as const, ground: "incompatible" as const, ruleId: "R1" as const, rulesVersion: 2, legalReference: null, decidedAt: "2026-10-01T09:00:00.000Z" };
      const others: StatementInput[] = [
        statement({ outcome: "no_violation", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, reason: null, measures: [], endedMeasures: [{ kind: "withhold", mediaId: null, ...NO_RESET }] }),
        statement({ outcome: "not_evident", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, reason: null, measures: [] }),
        statement({ kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, measures: [], reversals: [reversal("restore")], reviewed }),
        statement({ kind: "correction", outcome: "partly_reversed", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, measures: [], reversals: [reversal("restore_media")], reviewed }),
        statement({ kind: "review", outcome: "kept", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, measures: [], reviewed }),
        statement({ kind: "review", outcome: "reversed", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, measures: [], reversals: [reversal("restore")], reviewed }),
      ];
      for (const input of others) expect(statementParagraphs(input).at(-1), `${input.kind} ${input.outcome}`).toBe(REDRESS_TEXTS[1].notAppealable);
    });
  });

  test("every restricting decision carries the six elements of Article 17(3): each measure, kind, ground and rulebook version", () => {
    const grounds = [
      { ground: "incompatible" as const, ruleId: "R3" as const, legalReference: null },
      { ground: "illegal" as const, ruleId: null, legalReference: "Section 130 of the criminal code." },
    ];
    for (const kind of ["interim", "final"] as const) {
      // 3c's seven measures; 3e's are held to their own sentences below and in later tasks.
      for (const measureKind of MEASURE_KINDS.slice(0, 7)) {
        if (!MEASURES[measureKind][kind]) continue;
        for (const ground of grounds) {
          for (const rulesVersion of [1, 2]) {
            const account = MEASURES[measureKind].target === "display_name" || MEASURES[measureKind].target === "bio";
            const input = statement({ kind, ...ground, rulesVersion, post: account ? null : POST, measures: [measure(measureKind)] });
            const out = statementParagraphs(input);
            const label = `${kind} ${measureKind} ${ground.ground} v${rulesVersion}`;
            // (a) the restriction, where it applies and for how long.
            expect(out[0], label).toMatch(/^korbat (hid|removed|sealed|reset) /);
            expect(out, label).toContain(kind === "interim" ? W.scope.interim : W.scope.final);
            // (b) the facts, and whether the decision followed a notice or korbat's own finding.
            expect(out, label).toContain("The facts: The post shows explicit sexual acts.");
            expect(out, label).toContain("korbat decided this following a report by another user.");
            // (c) the use of automated means.
            expect(out, label).toContain(W.automation);
            // (d) and (e) the legal ground, or the rule, with its explanation: as a finding only for a final restriction
            // that seals nothing; while deciding, as what korbat is checking; for a seal, as what the step rests on.
            const rule = getRule("R3", rulesVersion)!;
            const seals = measureKind === "seal_media";
            if (ground.ground === "illegal") {
              expect(out, label).toContain(seals ? "This step rests on the law: Section 130 of the criminal code." : kind === "interim" ? "korbat is checking whether this is illegal. The law in question: Section 130 of the criminal code." : "korbat found it illegal. The law it rests on: Section 130 of the criminal code.");
            } else {
              expect(out, label).toContain(`${seals ? "This step rests on" : kind === "interim" ? "korbat is checking this against" : "It breaks"} korbat rule R3, "${rule.title}": ${rule.text}`);
            }
            if (seals || kind === "interim") expect(out.join(" "), label).not.toMatch(/It breaks korbat rule|korbat found it illegal/);
            expect(out, label).toContain("korbat's reasons: That is content whose primary purpose is sexual arousal.");
            // (f) redress.
            expect(out.at(-1)!.startsWith(kind === "interim" ? REDRESS_TEXTS[1].interim : "You can appeal this decision once"), label).toBe(true);
            // One paragraph is one line, but for a staff text that holds line feeds of its own, and none is empty.
            for (const paragraph of out) expect(paragraph.trim().length, label).toBeGreaterThan(0);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  });

  describe("what was done, for each measure", () => {
    test("a post and an image, while deciding and for good", () => {
      expect(statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "interim", measures: [measure("withhold_media")] }))[0]).toBe(`korbat hid one image of your post of ${POST_TIME} from other people while it decides.`);
      expect(statementParagraphs(statement({ measures: [measure("remove_media")] }))[0]).toBe(`korbat removed one image of your post of ${POST_TIME}: other people can no longer see it.`);
      // Several measures in one decision: one paragraph each, in the decision's order.
      const both = statementParagraphs(statement({ measures: [measure("remove"), measure("remove_media")] }));
      expect(both.slice(0, 2)).toEqual([`korbat removed your post of ${POST_TIME}: other people can no longer see it.`, `korbat removed one image of your post of ${POST_TIME}: other people can no longer see it.`]);
    });

    test("a field reset says that the placeholder was written once and that the old value does not come back", () => {
      const name = statementParagraphs(statement({ post: null, measures: [measure("reset_display_name")] }));
      expect(name[0]).toBe(
        "korbat reset your display name. korbat wrote this placeholder once. You may set your display name again; what you set is judged on its own if someone reports it, and korbat does not put the old value back when this measure ends or is lifted.",
      );
      const bio = statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "interim", post: null, measures: [measure("reset_bio")] }));
      expect(bio[0]).toBe(
        "korbat reset your bio while it decides. korbat wrote this placeholder once. You may set your bio again; what you set is judged on its own if someone reports it, and korbat does not put the old value back when this measure ends or is lifted.",
      );
    });

    test("each noEffect sentence: another decision already holds it, the post or the account is deleted, the field already held the placeholder", () => {
      const first = (input: StatementInput) => statementParagraphs(input)[0];
      expect(first(statement({ measures: [measure("remove", { noEffect: "already" })] }))).toBe(
        `korbat removed your post of ${POST_TIME}: other people can no longer see it. Another decision already keeps this post from being shown, so this changes nothing anyone sees now. It stays in force should that decision be reversed.`,
      );
      expect(first(statement({ measures: [measure("remove_media", { noEffect: "already" })] }))).toBe(
        `korbat removed one image of your post of ${POST_TIME}: other people can no longer see it. Another decision already keeps this image from being shown, so this changes nothing anyone sees now. It stays in force should that decision be reversed.`,
      );
      expect(first(statement({ measures: [measure("remove", { noEffect: "deleted" })] }))).toBe(
        `korbat removed your post of ${POST_TIME}: other people can no longer see it. You had deleted this post, so this changes nothing anyone sees.`,
      );
      expect(first(statement({ post: null, measures: [measure("reset_bio", { noEffect: "already" })] }))).toBe("korbat reset your bio. The field already held korbat's placeholder, so this changes nothing now.");
      expect(first(statement({ post: null, measures: [measure("reset_display_name", { noEffect: "deleted" })] }))).toBe("korbat reset your display name. Your account is deleted, so this changes nothing.");
      // A reset that changed nothing wrote no placeholder, so it does not say that it wrote one.
      expect(first(statement({ post: null, measures: [measure("reset_bio", { noEffect: "already" })] }))).not.toContain("wrote this placeholder once");
    });
  });

  describe("the ground is worded by what the decision is", () => {
    const r2 = getRule("R2", 2)!;
    const r5 = getRule("R5", 2)!;

    test("the words, each a constant", () => {
      expect(W.ground.sealRule("R2", "Title", "Text.")).toBe('This step rests on korbat rule R2, "Title": Text.');
      expect(W.ground.sealLaw("Section 184b.")).toBe("This step rests on the law: Section 184b.");
      expect(W.ground.checkingRule("R5", "Title", "Text.")).toBe('korbat is checking this against korbat rule R5, "Title": Text.');
      expect(W.ground.checkingLaw("Section 241.")).toBe("korbat is checking whether this is illegal. The law in question: Section 241.");
      expect(W.ground.breaks("R1", "Title", "Text.")).toBe('It breaks korbat rule R1, "Title": Text.');
      expect(W.ground.illegal("Section 241.")).toBe("korbat found it illegal. The law it rests on: Section 241.");
      expect(W.ground.restedOnRule("R1", "Title", "Text.")).toBe('That decision rested on korbat rule R1, "Title": Text.');
      expect(W.ground.restedOnLaw("Section 241.")).toBe("That decision rested on the law: Section 241.");
      expect(W.ground.referenceErased).toBe("its reference was erased under korbat's retention rules.");
    });

    test("a seal, while deciding and for good, on a report alone: the step rests on rule R2, and nothing says that the rule is broken or the images illegal", () => {
      const sealing = (kind: "interim" | "final") =>
        statementParagraphs(statement({ kind, ruleId: "R2", facts: SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.notice_post, reason: kind === "interim" ? SEAL_DRAFTS.reason.deciding : SEAL_DRAFTS.reason.final, source: "notice", measures: [measure("seal_media")] }));
      for (const kind of ["interim", "final"] as const) {
        const out = sealing(kind);
        expect(out, kind).toContain(`This step rests on korbat rule R2, "${r2.title}": ${r2.text}`);
        expect(out.join(" "), kind).not.toMatch(/It breaks korbat rule|korbat found it illegal|korbat is checking/);
      }
      // A seal in the category Protection of minors, on the law: the same, with the law.
      const law = statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "interim", ground: "illegal", ruleId: null, legalReference: "Section 184b of the criminal code.", source: "notice", measures: [measure("seal_media")] }));
      expect(law).toContain("This step rests on the law: Section 184b of the criminal code.");
      expect(law.join(" ")).not.toMatch(/found it illegal|korbat is checking/);
    });

    test("a decision taken while deciding that seals nothing says what korbat is checking, on a rule and on the law", () => {
      const rule = statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "interim", ruleId: "R5", measures: [measure("withhold")] }));
      expect(rule).toContain(`korbat is checking this against korbat rule R5, "${r5.title}": ${r5.text}`);
      const law = statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "interim", ground: "illegal", ruleId: null, legalReference: "Section 241 of the criminal code (threats).", source: "notice", measures: [measure("withhold")] }));
      expect(law).toContain("korbat is checking whether this is illegal. The law in question: Section 241 of the criminal code (threats).");
      // Beside "while it decides", nothing states a finding.
      for (const out of [rule, law]) expect(out.join(" ")).not.toMatch(/It breaks korbat rule|korbat found it illegal/);
    });

    test("a final restriction that seals nothing states what korbat found", () => {
      expect(statementParagraphs(statement())).toContain(`It breaks korbat rule R1, "No sexual or pornographic content": ${getRule("R1", 2)!.text}`);
      expect(statementParagraphs(statement({ ground: "illegal", ruleId: null, legalReference: "Section 241." }))).toContain("korbat found it illegal. The law it rests on: Section 241.");
    });
  });

  describe("the seal's sentences", () => {
    const seal = (sealed: { posts: number; images: number; deletedImages: number }, more: Partial<DecisionStatement["measures"][number]> = {}) => measure("seal_media", { sealed, ...more });
    const sealing = (more: Partial<StatementInput>) => statement({ ruleId: "R2", facts: SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.notice_post, reason: SEAL_DRAFTS.reason.deciding, source: "notice", ...more });

    test("on a post case, while deciding: the images of the post, with their number, and the interim redress", () => {
      const out = statementParagraphs(sealing({ kind: "interim", measures: [seal({ posts: 1, images: 3, deletedImages: 0 })] }));
      expect(out[0]).toBe(`korbat sealed the images of your post of ${POST_TIME} (3 in all): nobody can see them, you included.`);
      expect(out).toContain(`The facts: ${SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.notice_post}`);
      expect(out).toContain(`korbat's reasons: ${SEAL_DRAFTS.reason.deciding}`);
      expect(out.at(-1)).toBe(REDRESS_TEXTS[1].interim);
      // Neither sentence of a seal for good (the rule's own text speaks of both, so they are looked for as whole paragraphs' parts).
      expect(out[0]).not.toContain(W.sealForGood);
      expect(out.at(-1)).not.toContain(W.sealAppeal);
    });

    test("on an account case: every image on the account's posts, with and without posts the author had deleted", () => {
      const live = statementParagraphs(sealing({ kind: "interim", post: null, measures: [seal({ posts: 4, images: 9, deletedImages: 0 })] }));
      expect(live[0]).toBe("korbat sealed every image it held on your posts at that time (9 on 4 posts): nobody can see them, you included.");
      const kept = statementParagraphs(sealing({ kind: "interim", post: null, measures: [seal({ posts: 4, images: 9, deletedImages: 2 })] }));
      expect(kept[0]).toBe(
        "korbat sealed every image it held on your posts at that time (9 on 4 posts): nobody can see them, you included. 2 of them are on posts you had deleted, which korbat had kept under its terms (Your data).",
      );
    });

    test("for good: kept only for the authorities, and the appeal waits until they have assessed the images", () => {
      const out = statementParagraphs(sealing({ reason: SEAL_DRAFTS.reason.final, measures: [seal({ posts: 1, images: 2, deletedImages: 0 })] }));
      expect(out[0]).toBe(`korbat sealed the images of your post of ${POST_TIME} (2 in all): nobody can see them, you included. They are kept only for the authorities korbat reports this to.`);
      expect(out.at(-1)).toBe(`${appeal(DECIDED)} An appeal of a seal waits until the authorities have assessed the images.`);
      const account = statementParagraphs(sealing({ post: null, measures: [seal({ posts: 2, images: 5, deletedImages: 1 })] }));
      expect(account[0]).toBe(
        "korbat sealed every image it held on your posts at that time (5 on 2 posts): nobody can see them, you included. 1 of them is on a post you had deleted, which korbat had kept under its terms (Your data). They are kept only for the authorities korbat reports this to.",
      );
    });

    test("a seal that changed nothing says so: already sealed, or the post or the account deleted", () => {
      const first = (more: Partial<StatementInput>, noEffect: "already" | "deleted") => statementParagraphs(sealing({ kind: "interim", measures: [seal({ posts: 1, images: 2, deletedImages: 0 }, { noEffect })], ...more }))[0];
      expect(first({}, "already")).toBe(
        `korbat sealed the images of your post of ${POST_TIME} (2 in all): nobody can see them, you included. Another decision already keeps these images sealed, so this changes nothing anyone sees now. It stays in force should that decision be reversed.`,
      );
      expect(first({}, "deleted")).toBe(`korbat sealed the images of your post of ${POST_TIME} (2 in all): nobody can see them, you included. You had deleted this post, so this changes nothing anyone sees.`);
      expect(first({ post: null }, "deleted")).toBe("korbat sealed every image it held on your posts at that time (2 on 1 post): nobody can see them, you included. Your account is deleted, so this changes nothing.");
    });

    test("a lifted seal", () => {
      const reviewed = { kind: "final" as const, ground: "incompatible" as const, ruleId: "R2" as const, rulesVersion: 2, legalReference: null, decidedAt: "2026-10-01T09:00:00.000Z" };
      const out = statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, reason: "The authority answered on 2 October 2026.", measures: [], reversals: [reversal("unseal_media")], reviewed }));
      expect(out[0]).toBe("korbat corrected its decision of 2026-10-01 09:00 UTC and reversed it.");
      expect(out[1]).toBe("korbat lifted the seal on these images. If an image is still not shown, another decision listed in Settings, Cases applies.");
    });
  });

  describe("reversals and what ended", () => {
    const reviewed = { kind: "final" as const, ground: "incompatible" as const, ruleId: "R1" as const, rulesVersion: 2, legalReference: null, decidedAt: "2026-10-01T09:00:00.000Z" };
    const correction = (more: Partial<StatementInput>) => statement({ kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, reason: "The post is satire.", measures: [], reviewed, ...more });
    const FIELD = (field: string) => `korbat does not put back your ${field} as it was before the reset: set it again in Settings, Profile if you wish.`;
    const KEPT = `The screen of the decision that reset it shows what it was for at least ${RETENTION.resetValueDays} days.`;
    const KEPT_R4 = `The screen of the decision that reset it shows what it was for at least ${RETENTION.resetValueDays} days, unless korbat had already erased it under rule R4.`;

    test("a correction of a final decision renders that decision's rule from its own row and version, and its reason", () => {
      // The corrected decision was made under rulebook version 1: its rule reads as that version worded it.
      const out = statementParagraphs(correction({ reviewed: { ...reviewed, rulesVersion: 1 }, reversals: [reversal("restore")] }));
      expect(out).toEqual([
        "korbat corrected its decision of 2026-10-01 09:00 UTC and reversed it.",
        `Your post of ${POST_TIME}: korbat lifted this restriction. If your post or image is still restricted, another decision listed in Settings, Cases applies, or its content was erased under korbat's retention rules.`,
        "No automated means were used to find this or to decide it.",
        `That decision rested on korbat rule R1, "No sexual or pornographic content": ${getRule("R1", 1)!.text}`,
        "Why korbat changed it: The post is satire.",
        REDRESS_TEXTS[1].notAppealable,
      ]);
      const part = statementParagraphs(correction({ outcome: "partly_reversed", reversals: [reversal("restore_media")] }));
      expect(part[0]).toBe("korbat corrected its decision of 2026-10-01 09:00 UTC and reversed part of it.");
      expect(part[1]).toBe(
        `One image of your post of ${POST_TIME}: korbat lifted this restriction. If your post or image is still restricted, another decision listed in Settings, Cases applies, or its content was erased under korbat's retention rules.`,
      );
      // A corrected decision on the law renders its legal reference.
      const law = statementParagraphs(correction({ reversals: [reversal("restore")], reviewed: { ...reviewed, ground: "illegal", ruleId: null, legalReference: "Section 241." } }));
      expect(law).toContain("That decision rested on the law: Section 241.");
    });

    test("a correction of an interim decision lifts what was done while deciding", () => {
      const out = statementParagraphs(correction({ reversals: [reversal("restore")], reviewed: { ...reviewed, kind: "interim" } }));
      expect(out[0]).toBe("korbat lifted what it did while deciding on 2026-10-01 09:00 UTC.");
      expect(out.at(-1)).toBe(REDRESS_TEXTS[1].notAppealable);
    });

    test("a review answers the appeal: kept, reversed in part or reversed", () => {
      expect(statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "review", outcome: "kept", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, reason: "The post was read again.", measures: [], reviewed }))).toEqual([
        "korbat reviewed your appeal against its decision of 2026-10-01 09:00 UTC and kept that decision.",
        "No automated means were used to find this or to decide it.",
        `That decision rested on korbat rule R1, "No sexual or pornographic content": ${getRule("R1", 2)!.text}`,
        "Why korbat kept it: The post was read again.",
        REDRESS_TEXTS[1].notAppealable,
      ]);
      expect(statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "review", outcome: "reversed", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, measures: [], reversals: [reversal("restore")], reviewed }))[0]).toBe(
        "korbat reviewed your appeal against its decision of 2026-10-01 09:00 UTC and reversed that decision.",
      );
      expect(statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "review", outcome: "partly_reversed", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, measures: [], reversals: [reversal("restore_media")], reviewed }))[0]).toBe(
        "korbat reviewed your appeal against its decision of 2026-10-01 09:00 UTC and reversed part of that decision.",
      );
    });

    test("the field-restore sentence, with and without its 30-day sentence, and with the R4 form", () => {
      const lifted = (more: Partial<DecisionStatement["reversals"][number]>, kind: ReversalKind = "restore_bio") => statementParagraphs(correction({ post: null, reversals: [reversal(kind, { resetDecisionId: RESET_DECISION, ...more })] }))[1];
      expect(lifted({ oldValueKept: false })).toBe(`korbat lifted the reset of your bio. ${FIELD("bio")}`);
      expect(lifted({ oldValueKept: true })).toBe(`korbat lifted the reset of your bio. ${FIELD("bio")} ${KEPT}`);
      expect(lifted({ oldValueKept: true, resetRuleId: "R4" })).toBe(`korbat lifted the reset of your bio. ${FIELD("bio")} ${KEPT_R4}`);
      expect(lifted({ oldValueKept: true, resetRuleId: "R3" }, "restore_display_name")).toBe(`korbat lifted the reset of your display name. ${FIELD("display name")} ${KEPT}`);
    });

    test("a final no-action decision that ends measures taken while deciding names them, and nothing else it did", () => {
      const out = statementParagraphs(
        statement({
          outcome: "no_violation",
          ground: null,
          ruleId: null,
          facts: null,
          reason: null,
          measures: [],
          endedMeasures: [
            { kind: "withhold", mediaId: null, ...NO_RESET },
            { kind: "withhold_media", mediaId: IMAGE, ...NO_RESET },
          ],
        }),
      );
      expect(out).toEqual([
        `What korbat did while deciding has ended: ${MEASURES.withhold.label}, ${MEASURES.withhold_media.label}.`,
        "korbat decided this following a report by another user.",
        "No automated means were used to find this or to decide it.",
        REDRESS_TEXTS[1].notAppealable,
      ]);
    });

    test("the field sentence after an interim reset ended by a closing decision, with and without its 30-day sentence, and none for a field the closing decision resets itself", () => {
      const ended = (more: Partial<DecisionStatement["endedMeasures"][number]>, kind: MeasureKind = "reset_bio") => ({ kind, mediaId: null, resetDecisionId: RESET_DECISION, oldValueKept: false, resetRuleId: null, ...more });
      const closing = (endedMeasures: DecisionStatement["endedMeasures"], more: Partial<StatementInput> = {}) =>
        statementParagraphs(statement({ outcome: "no_violation", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, reason: null, post: null, measures: [], endedMeasures, ...more }));
      expect(closing([ended({})])[0]).toBe(`What korbat did while deciding has ended: ${MEASURES.reset_bio.label}. ${FIELD("bio")}`);
      expect(closing([ended({ oldValueKept: true })])[0]).toBe(`What korbat did while deciding has ended: ${MEASURES.reset_bio.label}. ${FIELD("bio")} ${KEPT}`);
      expect(closing([ended({ oldValueKept: true, resetRuleId: "R4" })])[0]).toBe(`What korbat did while deciding has ended: ${MEASURES.reset_bio.label}. ${FIELD("bio")} ${KEPT_R4}`);
      // Two resets of two fields: one field sentence each.
      expect(closing([ended({}, "reset_display_name"), ended({ oldValueKept: true })])[0]).toBe(
        `What korbat did while deciding has ended: ${MEASURES.reset_display_name.label}, ${MEASURES.reset_bio.label}. ${FIELD("display name")} ${FIELD("bio")} ${KEPT}`,
      );
```
