### Create `apps/app/src/components/moderation/RefusedNotice.tsx`

```tsx
import { Pressable, Text, View } from "react-native";
import { Link } from "expo-router";
import type { AccountStanding } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { refusalSentence, runningMeasure, STANDING_TEXTS } from "@/lib/standing";

/**
 * A write refused account_suspended where it was attempted (3e design, section 9.4): a card's like, repost or bookmark,
 * and a follow. It reads /me's standing as the session holds it, which the app reads again after such a refusal, so the
 * sentence names the end of the suspension, the termination, or that the suspension has just ended; and while a measure
 * runs, the link to its decision.
 */
export function RefusedNotice({ standing }: { standing: AccountStanding | null | undefined }) {
  const running = runningMeasure(standing);
  return (
    <View className="mt-1">
      <Text accessibilityRole="alert" className="text-xs text-red-400">
        {refusalSentence(standing)}
      </Text>
      {running !== null ? (
        <Link href={`/settings/cases/${running.decisionId}`} asChild>
          <Pressable>
            <Text className="text-xs text-sky-400 underline">{STANDING_TEXTS.refused.read}</Text>
          </Pressable>
        </Link>
      ) : null}
    </View>
  );
}
```

### Create `packages/db/migrations/0025_standing_review.sql`

```sql
-- What the review of account sanctions as built upheld, in the database (3e design, section 19; the design names no
-- migration for it). Written by hand: this migration changes no table. It replaces one view and four functions, each
-- stated whole from its newest text (CREATE OR REPLACE keeps each one's owner, grants and trigger), and back-fills the
-- tallies of reports sent before the reporting counts' migration (0022) existed.
--
-- As in 0016 to 0024: every function is owned by the migrator, pins its search path, names every object schema-qualified
-- and has EXECUTE taken from PUBLIC; errors carry their code as the message under SQLSTATE P0001; times the database
-- writes are now(), the transaction's start; a read that must see what committed while a lock waited is a statement of
-- its own after that lock. No statement here names a value that 3e's schema migration added to action_kind outside a
-- PL/pgSQL body, and every number is read from standing_rules(), never typed as an interval (enum-literals.test.ts,
-- standing-grants.test.ts).
--
-- 1. A mark counts only once its item's outcome is released (intake_items.outcome_sent_at is set): before the daily
-- release the person cannot read the mark, nor ask for a re-examination of it, so no warning or restriction may rest on
-- it (3e design, section 7.9 step 3). reporting_record, replaced (0022), counts and lists only such marks; everything
-- 0022 says of it stands. decision_actions_check, replaced (0021), counts the marked reports sent since the warning, for a
-- restriction, by the same rule; everything 0021 says of it stands, stated again in full.
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "public"."reporting_record" WITH (security_invoker = true) AS
WITH frame AS (SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date - k.report_frame_days AS before FROM public.standing_rules() k)
SELECT a.account_id,
       coalesce((SELECT sum(t.reports) FROM public.report_tallies t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.day > f.before), 0)::integer AS reports,
       (SELECT count(DISTINCT m.intake_id) FROM public.unfounded_marks m
         WHERE m.account_id = a.account_id AND m.withdrawn_by IS NULL AND (m.reported_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date > f.before
           AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.intake_items o WHERE o.id = m.item_id AND o.outcome_sent_at IS NOT NULL)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.intake_items x WHERE x.reexamines_item_id = m.item_id AND x.outcome IN ('restricted_rule', 'restricted_legal')))::integer AS unfounded
  FROM frame f,
       LATERAL (SELECT t.account_id FROM public.report_tallies t WHERE t.day > f.before
                UNION
                SELECT m.account_id FROM public.unfounded_marks m WHERE m.withdrawn_by IS NULL AND (m.reported_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date > f.before
                   AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.intake_items o WHERE o.id = m.item_id AND o.outcome_sent_at IS NOT NULL)) a;--> statement-breakpoint
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."decision_actions_check"() RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE
  d public.decisions;
  c public.cases;
  subject uuid;
  is_measure boolean;
  lifted public.action_kind[];
  target uuid;
  target_decision public.decisions;
  decider_role text;
  post_state public.post_state;
  post_level public.moderation_level;
  image_state public.media_moderation_state;
  profile public.profiles;
  rules record;
  max_days integer;
  basis_decision uuid;
  earlier_decision uuid;
  ladder_count integer;
  ladder_decisions uuid[];
  newest_strike_at timestamptz;
  newest_rule text;
  last_ladder_at timestamptz;
  rungs_used integer;
  ladder_holds boolean := false;
  reports_sent integer;
  reports_marked integer;
  warning_decision uuid;
  warning_told timestamptz;
BEGIN
  -- 1.
  SELECT x.* INTO d FROM public.decisions x WHERE x.id = NEW.decision_id;
  IF NOT FOUND OR d.xact IS DISTINCT FROM pg_current_xact_id() OR d.decided_at IS DISTINCT FROM now() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'A measure or a reversal is added only in the transaction of its own decision.';
  END IF;
  SELECT k.* INTO c FROM public.cases k WHERE k.id = d.case_id;

  -- 2.
  NEW.subject_account_id := NULL;
  NEW.post_id := NULL;
  NEW.reverses_action_id := NULL;
  NEW.no_effect := NULL;
  NEW.created_at := now();
  NEW.basis := NULL;
  NEW.rests_on := NULL;
  NEW.starts_at := NULL;
  NEW.ends_at := NULL;
  IF NEW.kind NOT IN ('suspend', 'restrict_reporting') THEN
    NEW.days := NULL;
  END IF;
  IF NEW.kind NOT IN ('suspend', 'terminate', 'restrict_reporting') THEN
    NEW.announced := NULL;
  END IF;
  NEW.replaced := CASE WHEN NEW.kind = 'lift_suspension' THEN coalesce(NEW.replaced, false) END;
  IF NEW.kind IN ('seal_media', 'unseal_media') THEN
    NEW.media_id := NULL;
  END IF;
  IF c.target_type = 'post' THEN
    SELECT p.author_id INTO subject FROM public.posts p WHERE p.id = c.target_id;
  ELSE
    subject := c.target_id;
  END IF;
  IF subject IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'The case''s target does not exist.';
  END IF;
  NEW.subject_account_id := subject;
  IF NEW.kind IN ('withhold', 'remove', 'restore', 'withhold_media', 'remove_media', 'restore_media') THEN
    NEW.post_id := c.target_id;
  END IF;
  is_measure := NEW.kind IN ('withhold', 'remove', 'seal_media', 'withhold_media', 'remove_media', 'reset_display_name', 'reset_bio',
                             'strike', 'suspend', 'terminate', 'retire_handle', 'warn_reporting', 'restrict_reporting');

  -- 3.
  IF (NEW.post_id IS NOT NULL AND c.target_type <> 'post')
     OR (NEW.kind IN ('reset_display_name', 'reset_bio', 'restore_display_name', 'restore_bio') AND c.target_type <> 'account') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'Post and image measures belong to a post case, field measures to an account case.';
  END IF;
  IF (NEW.kind IN ('strike', 'overrule') AND c.target_type <> 'post')
     OR (NEW.kind IN ('suspend', 'terminate', 'retire_handle', 'warn_reporting', 'restrict_reporting', 'lift_suspension', 'unretire_handle', 'lift_reporting') AND c.target_type <> 'account') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'A strike and its overruling belong to a post case, the account measures and their reversals to an account case.';
  END IF;
  IF NOT (CASE d.kind
            WHEN 'interim' THEN NEW.kind IN ('withhold', 'withhold_media', 'reset_display_name', 'reset_bio', 'seal_media', 'restore', 'restore_media')
            WHEN 'final' THEN NEW.kind IN ('remove', 'remove_media', 'reset_display_name', 'reset_bio', 'seal_media', 'restore', 'restore_media',
                                           'strike', 'suspend', 'terminate', 'retire_handle', 'warn_reporting', 'restrict_reporting')
            ELSE NOT is_measure END) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'A decision of this kind does not hold this measure or reversal.';
  END IF;
  IF NEW.kind = 'overrule' AND d.outcome <> 'reversed' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'A strike falls only with its whole finding: it is overruled only by a review or a correction that reverses the decision.';
  END IF;
  IF NEW.kind = 'retire_handle' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.decision_actions x WHERE x.decision_id = d.id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'The retirement of a handle is its decision''s first measure.';
  END IF;
  IF (NEW.kind = 'suspend' AND (NEW.days IS NULL OR NEW.announced IS NULL))
     OR (NEW.kind = 'terminate' AND NEW.announced IS NULL)
     OR (NEW.kind = 'restrict_reporting' AND (NEW.days IS NULL OR NEW.announced IS DISTINCT FROM false)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'A suspension names its days and whether it is announced, a termination whether it is announced, a restriction of reporting its days and that it is not announced.';
  END IF;
  IF (NEW.kind IN ('suspend', 'terminate') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.decision_actions x WHERE x.decision_id = d.id AND x.kind = 'seal_media'))
     OR (NEW.kind = 'seal_media' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.decision_actions x WHERE x.decision_id = d.id AND x.kind IN ('suspend', 'terminate'))) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'A decision that seals holds no suspension or termination: each has a decision, a statement and an appeal of its own.';
  END IF;
  IF NEW.kind IN ('withhold', 'remove') AND EXISTS (
       SELECT 1 FROM public.decision_actions x WHERE x.decision_id = d.id AND x.kind IN ('withhold', 'remove')) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'A decision holds at most one post measure.';
  END IF;
  IF NEW.kind IN ('withhold_media', 'remove_media', 'restore_media') THEN
    IF NEW.media_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.post_media m WHERE m.id = NEW.media_id AND m.post_id = c.target_id) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'An image measure names an image of the case''s post.';
    END IF;
  ELSIF NEW.media_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'Only an image measure names an image.';
  END IF;

  -- 4.
  IF c.target_type = 'post' THEN
    PERFORM 1 FROM public.posts p WHERE p.id = c.target_id FOR UPDATE;
  END IF;

  -- 5.
  IF d.kind = 'interim' AND NEW.kind IN ('withhold', 'withhold_media') AND EXISTS (
       SELECT 1 FROM public.measures_in_force m
        WHERE m.case_id = c.id AND m.decision_kind = 'interim' AND m.kind = NEW.kind AND m.media_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.media_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'The case already holds this interim measure in force.';
  END IF;

  -- 6.
  IF NOT is_measure THEN
    lifted := CASE NEW.kind
                WHEN 'restore' THEN ARRAY['withhold', 'remove']
                WHEN 'unseal_media' THEN ARRAY['seal_media']
                WHEN 'restore_media' THEN ARRAY['withhold_media', 'remove_media']
                WHEN 'restore_display_name' THEN ARRAY['reset_display_name']
                WHEN 'overrule' THEN ARRAY['strike']
                WHEN 'lift_suspension' THEN ARRAY['suspend', 'terminate']
                WHEN 'unretire_handle' THEN ARRAY['retire_handle']
                WHEN 'lift_reporting' THEN ARRAY['warn_reporting', 'restrict_reporting']
                ELSE ARRAY['reset_bio'] END::public.action_kind[];
    IF d.kind IN ('review', 'correction') THEN
      SELECT a.id INTO target FROM public.decision_actions a
       WHERE a.decision_id = d.reviews_decision_id AND a.kind = ANY(lifted) AND a.media_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.media_id;
    ELSE
      SELECT m.id INTO target FROM public.measures_in_force m
       WHERE m.case_id = c.id AND m.decision_kind = 'interim' AND m.media_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.media_id
         AND m.kind = CASE NEW.kind WHEN 'restore' THEN 'withhold' ELSE 'withhold_media' END::public.action_kind;
    END IF;
    IF target IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.measures_in_force m WHERE m.id = target) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'A reversal lifts a measure that is in force.';
    END IF;
    NEW.reverses_action_id := target;
  END IF;

  -- 7.
  IF NEW.kind = 'seal_media' AND NOT (d.suspect AND (d.rule_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'R2' OR d.category = 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS')) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'A seal needs a decision that rests on a suspect item, under R2 or in the category Protection of minors.';
  END IF;

  -- 8. The subject's row is held FOR SHARE since decisions_record, so the lock order holds.
  IF is_measure AND public.account_is_staff(subject) AND d.kind <> 'interim' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'staff_target';
  END IF;

  -- 9. The deciding account's row is held FOR SHARE since decisions_record; this reads the same row again.
  IF NEW.kind = 'unseal_media' THEN
    UPDATE public.decisions x SET needs_admin = true WHERE x.id = d.id;
    SELECT u.role::text INTO decider_role FROM auth.users u WHERE u.id = d.decided_by FOR SHARE;
    IF decider_role IS DISTINCT FROM 'admin' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'admin_required';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- 9a. A standing measure.
  IF NEW.kind IN ('suspend', 'terminate') THEN
    SELECT k.* INTO rules FROM public.standing_rules() k;
    -- 9a.1. Free when the API holds the row FOR UPDATE, as it does for these decisions.
    PERFORM 1 FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id = subject FOR UPDATE;
    -- 9a.2. A statement of its own after the lock: one standing measure at a time, one with no start yet included.
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.standing_live s WHERE s.account_id = subject) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'standing_conflict';
    END IF;
    -- 9a.3 and 9a.4. The basis: the first row of the table that fits the decision's own columns.
    IF d.rule_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'R2' THEN
      -- A seal for good of the subject's images (a seal of a final decision about the account or one of its posts) in
      -- force, at most basis_age_days old, on which no protective suspension, standing or lifted, has rested yet.
      IF NEW.kind = 'suspend' AND NOT NEW.announced THEN
        SELECT m.decision_id INTO basis_decision
          FROM public.measures_in_force m JOIN public.decisions x ON x.id = m.decision_id
         WHERE m.kind = 'seal_media' AND m.decision_kind = 'final' AND m.subject_account_id = subject
           AND x.decided_at >= now() - make_interval(days => rules.basis_age_days)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.decision_actions p WHERE p.kind = 'suspend' AND p.basis = 'protective' AND m.decision_id = ANY(p.rests_on))
         ORDER BY x.decided_at DESC, x.id DESC LIMIT 1;
        IF basis_decision IS NOT NULL THEN
          NEW.basis := 'protective';
          NEW.rests_on := ARRAY[basis_decision];
          max_days := rules.protective_days;
        END IF;
      END IF;
      IF NEW.basis IS NULL THEN
        IF NEW.kind = 'terminate' THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'ground_not_established';
        END IF;
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'basis: under R2 only a protective suspension at once is open, on a seal for good no protective suspension rested on.';
      END IF;
    ELSIF d.ground IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'illegal' THEN
      IF NEW.kind = 'suspend' AND NOT NEW.announced AND d.category_keyword IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT' THEN
        SELECT x.id INTO basis_decision
          FROM public.decisions x JOIN public.cases xc ON xc.id = x.case_id AND xc.target_type = 'post'
          JOIN public.posts xp ON xp.id = xc.target_id AND xp.author_id = subject
         WHERE x.kind = 'final' AND x.outcome = 'restricted' AND x.ground = 'illegal' AND x.category_keyword = 'KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT'
           AND x.decided_at >= now() - make_interval(days => rules.basis_age_days)
           AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.measures_in_force f WHERE f.decision_id = x.id)
         ORDER BY x.decided_at DESC, x.id DESC LIMIT 1;
        IF basis_decision IS NOT NULL THEN
          NEW.basis := 'terrorist';
          NEW.rests_on := ARRAY[basis_decision];
          max_days := rules.terrorist_days;
        END IF;
      END IF;
      IF NEW.basis IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'basis: on the law only a suspension at once on terrorist content is open, on a final decision that found it in a post of the account.';
      END IF;
    ELSE
      IF d.rule_id = 'R5' AND NEW.kind = 'suspend' AND NOT NEW.announced THEN
        SELECT x.id INTO basis_decision
          FROM public.decisions x JOIN public.cases xc ON xc.id = x.case_id AND xc.target_type = 'post'
          JOIN public.posts xp ON xp.id = xc.target_id AND xp.author_id = subject
         WHERE x.kind = 'final' AND x.outcome = 'restricted' AND x.rule_id = 'R5'
           AND x.decided_at >= now() - make_interval(days => rules.basis_age_days)
           AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.measures_in_force f WHERE f.decision_id = x.id)
         ORDER BY x.decided_at DESC, x.id DESC LIMIT 1;
        IF basis_decision IS NOT NULL THEN
          NEW.basis := 'threat';
          NEW.rests_on := ARRAY[basis_decision];
          max_days := rules.threat_days;
        END IF;
      ELSIF d.rule_id = 'R5' AND NEW.kind = 'terminate' AND NOT NEW.announced THEN
        -- A suspension of the subject on the basis threat that stands, whose basis holds and that was decided within
        -- ladder_memory_days, and a final R5 decision as above about a post made after that suspension's decision was told.
        SELECT a.rests_on[1], x.id INTO earlier_decision, basis_decision
          FROM public.decision_actions a
          JOIN public.decisions ad ON ad.id = a.decision_id
          JOIN public.posts xp ON xp.author_id = subject AND xp.created_at > ad.informed_at
          JOIN public.cases xc ON xc.target_type = 'post' AND xc.target_id = xp.id
          JOIN public.decisions x ON x.case_id = xc.id
         WHERE a.subject_account_id = subject AND a.kind = 'suspend' AND a.basis = 'threat'
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.decision_actions r WHERE r.reverses_action_id = a.id)
           AND public.standing_basis_broken_at(a.id) IS NULL
           AND ad.decided_at >= now() - make_interval(days => rules.ladder_memory_days)
           AND x.kind = 'final' AND x.outcome = 'restricted' AND x.rule_id = 'R5'
           AND x.decided_at >= now() - make_interval(days => rules.basis_age_days)
           AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.measures_in_force f WHERE f.decision_id = x.id)
         ORDER BY x.decided_at DESC, x.id DESC, ad.decided_at DESC LIMIT 1;
        IF basis_decision IS NOT NULL THEN
          NEW.basis := 'threat_repeat';
          NEW.rests_on := ARRAY[earlier_decision, basis_decision];
        END IF;
      ELSIF d.rule_id = 'R6' AND NEW.kind = 'suspend' AND NOT NEW.announced THEN
        -- The count is a floor under the admin's finding, which the decision's facts state, and never the finding.
        IF (SELECT count(*) FROM public.posts p WHERE p.author_id = subject AND p.created_at > now() - make_interval(mins => rules.flood_minutes)) >= rules.flood_posts THEN
          NEW.basis := 'flood';
          max_days := rules.flood_days;
        END IF;
      END IF;
      IF NEW.basis IS NULL AND NEW.announced THEN
        -- The ladder. The subject's active strikes, oldest first, and the rule of the newest.
        SELECT count(*), coalesce(array_agg(s.decision_id ORDER BY s.created_at, s.action_id), '{}'::uuid[]), max(s.created_at)
          INTO ladder_count, ladder_decisions, newest_strike_at
          FROM public.active_strikes s WHERE s.account_id = subject;
        SELECT x.rule_id INTO newest_rule
          FROM public.active_strikes s JOIN public.decisions x ON x.id = s.decision_id
         WHERE s.account_id = subject ORDER BY s.created_at DESC, s.action_id DESC LIMIT 1;
        SELECT max(a.created_at) INTO last_ladder_at FROM public.decision_actions a
         WHERE a.subject_account_id = subject AND a.kind IN ('suspend', 'terminate') AND a.basis IN ('strikes', 'ladder_end')
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.decision_actions r WHERE r.reverses_action_id = a.id);
        SELECT count(*) INTO rungs_used FROM public.decision_actions a JOIN public.decisions ad ON ad.id = a.decision_id
         WHERE a.subject_account_id = subject AND a.kind = 'suspend' AND a.basis = 'strikes'
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.decision_actions r WHERE r.reverses_action_id = a.id)
           AND public.standing_basis_broken_at(a.id) IS NULL
           AND ad.decided_at >= now() - make_interval(days => rules.ladder_memory_days);
        ladder_holds := ladder_count >= rules.ladder_strikes
                        AND (last_ladder_at IS NULL OR newest_strike_at > last_ladder_at)
                        AND d.rule_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM newest_rule;
        IF ladder_holds AND NEW.kind = 'suspend' THEN
          NEW.basis := 'strikes';
          NEW.rests_on := ladder_decisions;
          max_days := rules.ladder_days[least(rungs_used + 1, cardinality(rules.ladder_days))];
        ELSIF ladder_holds AND NEW.kind = 'terminate' AND rungs_used >= cardinality(rules.ladder_days) THEN
          NEW.basis := 'ladder_end';
          NEW.rests_on := ladder_decisions;
        END IF;
      END IF;
      IF NEW.basis IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'basis: none fits. A measure at once needs its ground (R5 threat or second threat, R6 flood); an announced one the ladder.';
      END IF;
    END IF;
    -- 9a.5.
    IF NEW.kind = 'suspend' AND NEW.days > max_days THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = format('days: at most %s on the basis %s.', max_days, NEW.basis);
    END IF;
    -- 9a.6.
    NEW.starts_at := CASE WHEN NEW.announced THEN now() + make_interval(hours => rules.reply_window_hours) ELSE now() END;
    -- 9a.7. The deciding account's row is held FOR SHARE since decisions_record; this reads the same row again.
    IF NOT NEW.announced OR NEW.kind = 'terminate' THEN
      UPDATE public.decisions x SET needs_admin = true WHERE x.id = d.id;
      SELECT u.role::text INTO decider_role FROM auth.users u WHERE u.id = d.decided_by FOR SHARE;
      IF decider_role IS DISTINCT FROM 'admin' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'admin_required';
      END IF;
    END IF;
    -- 9a.8. Findings only: such a measure judges nothing a report in this case named.
    IF NEW.basis IN ('strikes', 'protective', 'ladder_end') AND EXISTS (
         SELECT 1 FROM public.intake_items i JOIN public.intakes n ON n.id = i.intake_id WHERE i.answered_by = d.id AND n.kind = 'user') THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'open_reports';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- 9b. A strike.
  IF NEW.kind = 'strike' THEN
    SELECT k.* INTO rules FROM public.standing_rules() k;
    PERFORM 1 FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id = subject FOR NO KEY UPDATE;
    NEW.ends_at := now() + make_interval(days => rules.strike_days);
  END IF;

  -- 9c. A warning and a restriction of reporting (3e design, section 6.3). The counts are of reports (intakes): a report
  -- is marked when one of its items holds a mark that counts, which is a mark whose report was sent on a UTC day within
  -- report_frame_days, that no correction withdrew, and whose item no re-examination ended in a restriction. The view
  -- reporting_record is the reporting counts' migration's: PL/pgSQL resolves it only when this branch runs, which no
  -- route allows before that migration exists. The refusal open_reports comes first, before any count is read.
  IF NEW.kind IN ('warn_reporting', 'restrict_reporting') THEN
    SELECT k.* INTO rules FROM public.standing_rules() k;
    IF d.rule_id IS DISTINCT FROM 'R6' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'A warning or a restriction of reporting cites R6.';
    END IF;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.intake_items i JOIN public.intakes n ON n.id = i.intake_id WHERE i.answered_by = d.id AND n.kind = 'user') THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'open_reports';
    END IF;
    IF NEW.kind = 'warn_reporting' THEN
      SELECT r.reports, r.unfounded INTO reports_sent, reports_marked FROM public.reporting_record r WHERE r.account_id = subject;
      IF coalesce(reports_marked, 0) < rules.report_warn_marks OR coalesce(reports_marked, 0) < rules.report_warn_share * coalesce(reports_sent, 0) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'warning: the account''s marked reports are below the threshold.';
      END IF;
      IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.decision_actions w WHERE w.subject_account_id = subject AND w.kind = 'warn_reporting' AND w.ends_at > now()
                    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.decision_actions r WHERE r.reverses_action_id = w.id)) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'warning: a warning of the account still counts.';
      END IF;
      NEW.basis := 'reports';
      NEW.ends_at := now() + make_interval(days => rules.report_frame_days);
    ELSE
      SELECT w.decision_id, wd.informed_at INTO warning_decision, warning_told
        FROM public.decision_actions w JOIN public.decisions wd ON wd.id = w.decision_id
       WHERE w.subject_account_id = subject AND w.kind = 'warn_reporting' AND w.ends_at > now()
         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.decision_actions r WHERE r.reverses_action_id = w.id)
       ORDER BY w.created_at DESC, w.id DESC LIMIT 1;
      IF warning_decision IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'restriction: the account has no warning that still counts.';
      END IF;
      -- Reports the person sent after korbat told them of the warning, never reports sent before it and decided after.
      SELECT count(DISTINCT m.intake_id) INTO reports_marked
        FROM public.unfounded_marks m
       WHERE m.account_id = subject AND m.reported_at > warning_told AND m.withdrawn_by IS NULL
         AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.intake_items o WHERE o.id = m.item_id AND o.outcome_sent_at IS NOT NULL)
         AND (m.reported_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date - rules.report_frame_days
         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.intake_items x WHERE x.reexamines_item_id = m.item_id AND x.outcome IN ('restricted_rule', 'restricted_legal'));
      IF reports_marked < rules.report_restrict_marks THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'restriction: too few marked reports sent since the warning.';
      END IF;
      IF NEW.days > rules.report_restrict_days THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = format('days: at most %s for a restriction of reporting.', rules.report_restrict_days);
      END IF;
      IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.decision_actions x WHERE x.subject_account_id = subject AND x.kind = 'restrict_reporting'
                    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.decision_actions r WHERE r.reverses_action_id = x.id)
                    AND public.standing_basis_broken_at(x.id) IS NULL AND x.starts_at + make_interval(days => x.days) > now()) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'restriction: a restriction of the account''s reports still runs.';
      END IF;
      NEW.basis := 'reports';
      NEW.rests_on := ARRAY[warning_decision];
      NEW.starts_at := now();
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- 10.
  IF is_measure AND NEW.kind NOT IN ('seal_media', 'strike') THEN
    IF c.target_type = 'post' THEN
      SELECT p.state, p.moderation_level INTO post_state, post_level FROM public.posts p WHERE p.id = c.target_id;
      IF post_state = 'deleted_by_author' THEN
        NEW.no_effect := 'deleted';
      ELSIF NEW.kind = 'withhold' THEN
        NEW.no_effect := CASE WHEN post_level <> 'visible' THEN 'already' END;
      ELSIF NEW.kind = 'remove' THEN
        NEW.no_effect := CASE WHEN post_level = 'removed' THEN 'already' END;
      ELSE
        SELECT m.moderation_state INTO image_state FROM public.post_media m WHERE m.id = NEW.media_id;
        NEW.no_effect := CASE WHEN post_level <> 'visible'
                                OR (NEW.kind = 'withhold_media' AND image_state <> 'visible')
                                OR (NEW.kind = 'remove_media' AND image_state IN ('removed', 'sealed')) THEN 'already' END;
      END IF;
    ELSE
      SELECT p.* INTO profile FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id = subject;
      IF profile.deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN
        NEW.no_effect := 'deleted';
      ELSIF (NEW.kind = 'reset_display_name' AND profile.display_name = profile.handle) OR (NEW.kind = 'reset_bio' AND profile.bio = '') THEN
        NEW.no_effect := 'already';
      ELSIF NEW.kind = 'retire_handle' AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM public.evidence_snapshots s JOIN public.handle_history h ON h.handle_lower = lower(s.handle)
               WHERE s.id = d.snapshot_id AND h.retired_at IS NOT NULL) THEN
        NEW.no_effect := 'already';
      END IF;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- 11.
  IF target IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT x.* INTO target_decision FROM public.decisions x JOIN public.decision_actions a ON a.decision_id = x.id WHERE a.id = target;
    IF target_decision.kind = 'interim' AND target_decision.author_mail <> 'none' THEN
      UPDATE public.decisions x
         SET ended_interim = true, author_mail = CASE WHEN x.author_mail = 'none' THEN 'pending'::public.delivery_state ELSE x.author_mail END
       WHERE x.id = d.id;
    END IF;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $$;--> statement-breakpoint
-- 2. decision_holds, replaced (0021). Everything 0016 and 0021 say of it stands, stated again in full. Added: a stored
-- replaced = true (a withdrawal of an announced measure for another) is accepted only when the deciding account is an
-- admin (admin_required otherwise), read from its auth row, which decisions_record already holds FOR SHARE.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."decision_holds"(decision uuid) RETURNS void
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE
  d public.decisions;
  a public.audit_log;
  params jsonb;
  compared jsonb;
  expected jsonb;
  recorded jsonb;
  held jsonb;
  differing text;
  measures integer;
  reversals integer;
  strikes integer;
  in_force integer;
  signed_marks jsonb;
  stored_marks jsonb;
  signed_replaced jsonb;
  stored_replaced boolean;
  lifted uuid;
  decider_role text;
BEGIN
  -- The row as it stands now: later triggers of its transaction may have marked it since its insert.
  SELECT x.* INTO d FROM public.decisions x WHERE x.id = decision_holds.decision;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN;
  END IF;
  SELECT l.* INTO a FROM public.audit_head h JOIN public.audit_log l ON l.chain_seq = h.seq WHERE h.id = 1;
  IF NOT FOUND OR a.metadata ->> 'decisionId' IS DISTINCT FROM d.id::text THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'decisionId: the transaction''s last audit row does not name this decision.';
  END IF;
  IF a.step_up IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'stepUp: the audit row carries no confirmation.';
  END IF;
  IF a.actor_id IS DISTINCT FROM d.decided_by THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'actor: the audit row was written by another account than the decision''s.';
  END IF;
  IF d.kind = 'review' THEN
    IF a.action IS DISTINCT FROM 'appeals_reviewed' OR a.target_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'decision' OR a.target_id IS DISTINCT FROM d.reviews_decision_id::text THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'target: the audit row is not appeals_reviewed on the reviewed decision.';
    END IF;
    expected := jsonb_build_object('stateVersion', d.seen_state_version, 'appealId', d.appeal_id, 'snapshotId', d.snapshot_id,
      'snapshotDigest', d.snapshot_digest, 'outcome', d.outcome, 'rulesVersion', d.rules_version, 'redressVersion', d.redress_version,
      'category', d.category, 'reasonDigest', d.reason_digest);
  ELSE
    IF a.action IS DISTINCT FROM 'case_decided' OR a.target_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'case' OR a.target_id IS DISTINCT FROM d.case_id::text THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'target: the audit row is not case_decided on the decision''s case.';
    END IF;
    expected := jsonb_build_object('kind', d.kind, 'stateVersion', d.seen_state_version, 'throughSeq', d.through_seq,
      'reviewsDecisionId', d.reviews_decision_id, 'snapshotId', d.snapshot_id, 'snapshotDigest', d.snapshot_digest, 'outcome', d.outcome,
      'ground', d.ground, 'ruleId', d.rule_id, 'rulesVersion', d.rules_version, 'redressVersion', d.redress_version, 'category', d.category,
      'categoryKeyword', d.category_keyword, 'factsDigest', d.facts_digest, 'reasonDigest', d.reason_digest,
      'legalReferenceDigest', d.legal_reference_digest);
  END IF;
  params := a.metadata -> 'params';
  IF params IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(params) <> 'object' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'params: the audit row carries none.';
  END IF;
  -- A decision's two members of 3e are checked on their own below; a row made before 3e carries neither.
  compared := CASE WHEN d.kind = 'review' THEN params - 'actions' ELSE params - 'actions' - 'unfounded' - 'replaced' END;
  IF compared IS DISTINCT FROM expected THEN
    SELECT string_agg(x.key, ', ' ORDER BY x.key) INTO differing
      FROM (SELECT coalesce(e.key, p.key) AS key
              FROM jsonb_each(expected) e FULL JOIN jsonb_each(compared) p ON p.key = e.key
             WHERE e.value IS DISTINCT FROM p.value) x;
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = format('params: %s differ from the decision.', differing);
  END IF;
  recorded := params -> 'actions';
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(CASE WHEN x.announced IS NULL THEN jsonb_build_object('kind', x.kind, 'mediaId', x.media_id)
                                 ELSE jsonb_build_object('kind', x.kind, 'mediaId', x.media_id, 'days', x.days, 'announced', x.announced) END), '[]'::jsonb),
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.kind IN ('withhold', 'remove', 'seal_media', 'withhold_media', 'remove_media', 'reset_display_name', 'reset_bio',
                                           'strike', 'suspend', 'terminate', 'retire_handle', 'warn_reporting', 'restrict_reporting')),
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.kind NOT IN ('withhold', 'remove', 'seal_media', 'withhold_media', 'remove_media', 'reset_display_name', 'reset_bio',
                                               'strike', 'suspend', 'terminate', 'retire_handle', 'warn_reporting', 'restrict_reporting')),
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.kind = 'strike')
    INTO held, measures, reversals, strikes
    FROM public.decision_actions x WHERE x.decision_id = d.id;
  IF recorded IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(recorded) <> 'array' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'actions: the audit row''s params list none.';
  END IF;
  IF NOT ((held) @> (recorded) AND (recorded) @> (held)) OR jsonb_array_length(held) <> jsonb_array_length(recorded) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'actions: the decision''s measures and reversals are not those the audit row''s params list.';
  END IF;

  IF d.kind <> 'review' THEN
    signed_marks := coalesce(params -> 'unfounded', '[]'::jsonb);
    IF jsonb_typeof(signed_marks) <> 'array' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'unfounded: the audit row''s params list no marks.';
    END IF;
    SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(m.item_id::text), '[]'::jsonb) INTO stored_marks FROM public.unfounded_marks m WHERE m.decision_id = d.id;
    IF NOT (stored_marks @> signed_marks AND signed_marks @> stored_marks) OR jsonb_array_length(stored_marks) <> jsonb_array_length(signed_marks) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'unfounded: the decision''s marks are not those the audit row''s params list.';
    END IF;
    signed_replaced := coalesce(params -> 'replaced', 'false'::jsonb);
    SELECT x.replaced, x.reverses_action_id INTO stored_replaced, lifted FROM public.decision_actions x WHERE x.decision_id = d.id AND x.kind = 'lift_suspension';
    IF jsonb_typeof(signed_replaced) <> 'boolean' OR (signed_replaced = 'true'::jsonb) IS DISTINCT FROM coalesce(stored_replaced, false) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'replaced: the decision''s lift is not what the audit row''s params say.';
    END IF;
    IF coalesce(stored_replaced, false) AND (
         d.kind <> 'correction'
         OR (SELECT count(*) FROM public.decision_actions x WHERE x.decision_id = d.id) <> 1
         OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.decision_actions l WHERE l.id = lifted AND l.announced)
         OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.suspension_periods p WHERE p.action_id = lifted AND p.starts_at < d.decided_at)) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'replaced: only a correction whose one row lifts an announced measure that has not started withdraws it for another measure.';
    END IF;
    -- 0025: a withdrawal for another measure is an admin's (3e design, sections 7.6 step 12 and 8.7), whoever signs it.
    IF coalesce(stored_replaced, false) THEN
      SELECT u.role::text INTO decider_role FROM auth.users u WHERE u.id = d.decided_by;
      IF decider_role IS DISTINCT FROM 'admin' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'admin_required';
      END IF;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  IF d.outcome = 'restricted' AND measures = 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'restricted: a restriction holds at least one measure.';
  END IF;
  IF d.outcome = 'restricted' AND measures = strikes THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'restricted: a restriction holds at least one measure that is not a strike.';
  END IF;
  IF d.kind = 'final' AND d.outcome = 'restricted' AND (strikes > 0) IS DISTINCT FROM public.strike_due(d.case_id, d.ground, d.rule_id, d.suspect, d.id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'strike_mismatch';
  END IF;
  IF d.outcome IN ('no_violation', 'not_evident') AND measures > 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'no action: a decision that finds no breach holds no measure.';
  END IF;
  IF d.outcome = 'kept' AND measures + reversals > 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'kept: a review that keeps the decision holds no measure and no reversal.';
  END IF;
  IF d.outcome IN ('reversed', 'partly_reversed') THEN
    IF reversals = 0 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'reversed: a reversing decision holds at least one reversal.';
    END IF;
    SELECT count(*) INTO in_force FROM public.measures_in_force m WHERE m.decision_id = d.reviews_decision_id;
    IF d.outcome = 'reversed' AND in_force > 0 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'reversed: a measure of the reviewed decision is still in force.';
    END IF;
    IF d.outcome = 'partly_reversed' AND in_force = 0 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'partly_reversed: no measure of the reviewed decision is left in force.';
    END IF;
    IF d.outcome = 'partly_reversed' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.measures_in_force m WHERE m.decision_id = d.reviews_decision_id AND m.kind <> 'strike') THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'partly_reversed: no measure of the reviewed decision but its strike is left in force.';
    END IF;
  END IF;
END $$;--> statement-breakpoint
-- 3. suspension_replies_check, replaced (0021). Everything 0021 says of it stands, stated again in full. Added to step 4:
-- reply_not_open when the account's auth row is marked deleted. The take-down marks it in the auth module's own
-- transaction while it holds the profile FOR UPDATE, and this step runs after the profile's lock, so a reply that waited
-- behind the take-down sees its commit and is refused; the profile itself is marked deleted only by the purge after it.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."suspension_replies_check"() RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE
  measure public.decision_actions;
  period_start timestamptz;
  period_end timestamptz;
BEGIN
  -- 1.
  NEW.answered_by := NULL;
  NEW.answered_at := NULL;
  NEW.erased_at := NULL;
  -- 2.
  SELECT a.* INTO measure FROM public.decision_actions a WHERE a.id = NEW.action_id;
  IF NOT FOUND OR measure.kind NOT IN ('suspend', 'terminate') OR measure.subject_account_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.account_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'reply_not_open';
  END IF;
  -- 3.
  PERFORM 1 FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id = NEW.account_id FOR UPDATE;
  -- 4.
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id = NEW.account_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'reply_not_open';
  END IF;
  -- 0025: an account the take-down took down is marked deleted in auth first; its profile only by the purge after it.
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM auth.users u WHERE u.id = NEW.account_id AND u.deleted_at IS NOT NULL) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'reply_not_open';
  END IF;
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.decision_actions r WHERE r.reverses_action_id = measure.id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'reply_not_open';
  END IF;
  IF public.standing_basis_broken_at(measure.id) IS NOT NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'reply_not_open';
  END IF;
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.suspension_replies r WHERE r.action_id = measure.id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'reply_not_open';
  END IF;
  -- 5.
  SELECT p.starts_at, p.ends_at INTO period_start, period_end FROM public.suspension_periods p WHERE p.action_id = measure.id;
  NEW.filed_at := clock_timestamp();
  IF period_end IS NOT NULL AND period_end <= NEW.filed_at THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'reply_not_open';
  END IF;
  NEW.on_time := period_start IS NULL OR NEW.filed_at < period_start;
  RETURN NEW;
END $$;--> statement-breakpoint
-- 4. erase_reply_statements, replaced (0024). Everything 0024 says of it stands, stated again in full. Added: an answered
-- reply's text also goes once the decision of the measure it replied to holds nothing in force (measures_in_force), the
-- moment an appeal of it is no longer open (appeals_check), so a text is never kept for an appeal that cannot come.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."erase_reply_statements"() RETURNS integer
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE
  n integer;
BEGIN
  PERFORM 1
     FROM public.suspension_replies r
     JOIN public.decision_actions a ON a.id = r.action_id
    WHERE r.statement IS NOT NULL AND r.answered_at IS NOT NULL
      AND (public.decision_final_at(a.decision_id) <= now() OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.measures_in_force f WHERE f.decision_id = a.decision_id))
    ORDER BY r.action_id
      FOR UPDATE OF r;
  UPDATE public.suspension_replies r SET statement = NULL, statement_salt = NULL, erased_at = now()
    FROM public.decision_actions a
   WHERE a.id = r.action_id AND r.statement IS NOT NULL AND r.answered_at IS NOT NULL
     AND (public.decision_final_at(a.decision_id) <= now() OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.measures_in_force f WHERE f.decision_id = a.decision_id));
  GET DIAGNOSTICS n = ROW_COUNT;
  RETURN n;
END $$;--> statement-breakpoint
-- 5. The tallies of the signed-in reports under a rule that korbat received within the frame before 0022 existed: its
-- trigger counts only the reports received after it, so a mark set on such a report afterwards would count on one side
-- of reporting_record only. Each account's tally of each UTC day within report_frame_days is set to at least the number
-- of such reports it sent that day, which is what report_tallies_count would have written. The larger of the two is kept,
-- so a database whose trigger already counted some of them (one that ran 0022 before this migration) counts none twice,
-- and running it again changes nothing.
INSERT INTO "public"."report_tallies" AS t (account_id, day, reports)
SELECT n.reporter_id, (n.received_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date, count(*)::integer
  FROM public.intakes n CROSS JOIN public.standing_rules() k
 WHERE n.kind = 'user' AND n.reporter_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT n.alleges_illegal AND NOT n.csam
   AND (n.received_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date - k.report_frame_days
 GROUP BY n.reporter_id, (n.received_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date
ON CONFLICT (account_id, day) DO UPDATE SET reports = greatest(t.reports, excluded.reports);
```

```json
        "decisions_api_all": {
          "name": "decisions_api_all",
          "as": "PERMISSIVE",
          "for": "ALL",
          "to": [
            "korbat_api"
          ],
          "using": "true",
          "withCheck": "true"
        }
      },
      "checkConstraints": {
        "decisions_rule_id": {
          "name": "decisions_rule_id",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"rule_id\" in ('R1', 'R2', 'R3', 'R4', 'R5', 'R6')"
        },
        "decisions_category": {
          "name": "decisions_category",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"category\" in ('STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ANIMAL_WELFARE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CONSUMER_INFORMATION', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE_AGAINST_WOMEN', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_DATA_PROTECTION_AND_PRIVACY_VIOLATIONS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ILLEGAL_OR_HARMFUL_SPEECH', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_INTELLECTUAL_PROPERTY_INFRINGEMENTS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NEGATIVE_EFFECTS_ON_CIVIC_DISCOURSE_OR_ELECTIONS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_RISK_FOR_PUBLIC_SECURITY', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SCAMS_AND_FRAUD', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SELF_HARM', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_UNSAFE_AND_PROHIBITED_PRODUCTS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE')"
        },
        "decisions_category_keyword": {
          "name": "decisions_category_keyword",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"category_keyword\" in ('KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT')"
        },
        "decisions_automated_decision": {
          "name": "decisions_automated_decision",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"automated_decision\" in ('fully', 'partially', 'not_automated')"
        },
        "decisions_territorial_scope": {
          "name": "decisions_territorial_scope",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"territorial_scope\" = 'worldwide'"
        },
        "decisions_review_target": {
          "name": "decisions_review_target",
          "value": "(\"decisions\".\"kind\" in ('review', 'correction')) = (\"decisions\".\"reviews_decision_id\" is not null) and (\"decisions\".\"kind\" = 'review') = (\"decisions\".\"appeal_id\" is not null)"
        },
        "decisions_interim": {
          "name": "decisions_interim",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"kind\" <> 'interim' or \"decisions\".\"through_seq\" = 0"
        },
        "decisions_ground_rule": {
          "name": "decisions_ground_rule",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"ground\" is distinct from 'incompatible' or \"decisions\".\"rule_id\" is not null"
        },
        "decisions_ground_law": {
          "name": "decisions_ground_law",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"ground\" is distinct from 'illegal' or \"decisions\".\"legal_reference_digest\" is not null"
        },
        "decisions_restricted": {
          "name": "decisions_restricted",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"outcome\" <> 'restricted' or (\"decisions\".\"ground\" is not null and \"decisions\".\"facts_digest\" is not null and \"decisions\".\"reason_digest\" is not null)"
        },
        "decisions_digests": {
          "name": "decisions_digests",
          "value": "(\"decisions\".\"facts_digest\" is null or \"decisions\".\"facts_digest\" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') and (\"decisions\".\"reason_digest\" is null or \"decisions\".\"reason_digest\" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') and (\"decisions\".\"legal_reference_digest\" is null or \"decisions\".\"legal_reference_digest\" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')"
        },
        "decisions_keyword": {
          "name": "decisions_keyword",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"category_keyword\" is null or \"decisions\".\"ground\" is not distinct from 'illegal'"
        },
        "decisions_law_no_rule": {
          "name": "decisions_law_no_rule",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"ground\" is distinct from 'illegal' or \"decisions\".\"rule_id\" is null"
        },
        "decisions_reversal_plain": {
          "name": "decisions_reversal_plain",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"kind\" not in ('review', 'correction') or (\"decisions\".\"ground\" is null and \"decisions\".\"rule_id\" is null and \"decisions\".\"category_keyword\" is null and \"decisions\".\"facts_digest\" is null and \"decisions\".\"legal_reference_digest\" is null)"
        }
      },
      "isRLSEnabled": true
    },

          "value": "\"intakes\".\"rule_id\" in ('R1', 'R2', 'R3', 'R4', 'R5', 'R6')"
        },
        "intakes_category": {
          "name": "intakes_category",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"category\" in ('STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ANIMAL_WELFARE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CONSUMER_INFORMATION', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE_AGAINST_WOMEN', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_DATA_PROTECTION_AND_PRIVACY_VIOLATIONS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ILLEGAL_OR_HARMFUL_SPEECH', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_INTELLECTUAL_PROPERTY_INFRINGEMENTS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NEGATIVE_EFFECTS_ON_CIVIC_DISCOURSE_OR_ELECTIONS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_RISK_FOR_PUBLIC_SECURITY', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SCAMS_AND_FRAUD', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SELF_HARM', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_UNSAFE_AND_PROHIBITED_PRODUCTS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE')"
        },

          "name": "intakes_explanation_len",
          "value": "char_length(\"intakes\".\"explanation\") <= 2000"
        },
        "intakes_has_ground": {
          "name": "intakes_has_ground",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"rule_id\" is not null or \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\" or \"intakes\".\"csam\""
        },
        "intakes_illegal_elements": {
          "name": "intakes_illegal_elements",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"kind\" <> 'user' or not \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\" or \"intakes\".\"csam\" or (\"intakes\".\"bona_fide\" and (\"intakes\".\"explanation\" is not null or \"intakes\".\"erased_at\" is not null))"
        },
        "intakes_finding_legal": {
          "name": "intakes_finding_legal",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"kind\" <> 'finding' or not \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\""
        },
        "intakes_illegal_not_tc": {
          "name": "intakes_illegal_not_tc",
          "value": "not \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\" or \"intakes\".\"category\" <> 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC'"
        },
        "intakes_csam": {
          "name": "intakes_csam",
          "value": "not \"intakes\".\"csam\" or (\"intakes\".\"category\" = 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS' and \"intakes\".\"reporter_id\" is null and \"intakes\".\"contact_id\" is null)"
        },

        },

          "value": "\"intakes\".\"reporter_id\" is null or \"intakes\".\"channel\" = 'signed_in'"
        },
        "intakes_finding": {
          "name": "intakes_finding",
          "value": "(\"intakes\".\"kind\" = 'finding') = (\"intakes\".\"finding_by\" is not null) and (\"intakes\".\"kind\" = 'finding') = (\"intakes\".\"channel\" = 'staff')"
        },
        "intakes_lookup": {
          "name": "intakes_lookup",
          "value": "(\"intakes\".\"lookup_hash\" is not null) = (\"intakes\".\"channel\" = 'signed_out' or \"intakes\".\"csam\")"
        },
        "intakes_erased": {
          "name": "intakes_erased",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"erased_at\" is null or (\"intakes\".\"explanation\" is null and \"intakes\".\"cited_law\" is null)"
        },
        "intakes_r2_finding_only": {
          "name": "intakes_r2_finding_only",
```

### Replace `README.md` (whole file)

````markdown
# korbat

Pseudonymous social platform with a narrow public rulebook and transparent moderation. Self-hosted.

- Design spec: `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-03-korbat-design.md`
- Accounts and sessions (sub-project 1a): `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-14-identity-auth-1a-design.md`
- Posting and feed (sub-project 2a): `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-17-posting-feed-2a-design.md`
- Plans: `docs/superpowers/plans/`

## Dev quick start
```bash
pnpm install
node scripts/gen-dev-env.mjs                # creates or completes infra/.env, apps/api/.env, apps/app/.env and apps/worker/.env, and derives apps/api/.env.test; values are random and never printed
docker compose -f infra/compose.yml -f infra/compose.dev.yml up -d postgres redis mailpit   # dev host ports 55432, 56379, 51025, 58025 (movable: DEV_*_PORT in infra/.env)
pnpm --filter @korbat/api dev               # http://localhost:3000/api/health; reads apps/api/.env
pnpm --filter @korbat/worker dev            # the image worker; reads apps/worker/.env and works on .data/media
pnpm --filter @korbat/app web               # http://localhost:8081
pnpm --filter @korbat/admin dev             # the staff console at http://localhost:8090 (never 127.0.0.1); forwards /api/staff/* to the API above
```

Emails sent in development (sign-in codes, new-device alerts, lockout notices) land in Mailpit at http://localhost:58025. Locally the web app uses Cloudflare's always-pass Turnstile test key, so the human check never blocks you.

The data services are PostgreSQL 18 and Valkey (the BSD-licensed fork of Redis, still under the service name `redis`, on its own volume `valkeydata`: Valkey 9 cannot read the RDB format 12 that Redis 7.4 wrote into the old `redisdata` volume, which held only transient state and can be removed with `docker volume rm`). Valkey needs the password from `infra/.env`; `gen-dev-env` writes it into the API's `REDIS_URL` too, so an older `.env` is fixed by running it again.

korbat once ran MinIO and never used it. Images live on two Docker volumes instead, `media-uploads` and `media-store`. If an old stack left a `korbat_miniodata` volume behind, `docker volume rm korbat_miniodata` removes it.

## Tests
```bash
pnpm test                                     # unit tests of every package
node scripts/test-db.mjs                      # creates or migrates the korbat_test database; run it again after adding a migration
pnpm --filter @korbat/api test:integration    # needs postgres, redis and mailpit up
```

Integration tests have their own database, `korbat_test`, and their own Redis database, 15. Both are named in `apps/api/.env.test`, which `node scripts/gen-dev-env.mjs` derives from `apps/api/.env`. Every run starts by emptying them, and refuses to start if a URL points anywhere else, so tests never touch development data.

Before they had their own database, the integration suites left accounts, profiles and posts in the development database, and the smoke test still leaves its first account per run, by then a moderator, with one open moderation case on that account's post. To see and remove them:

```bash
node scripts/clean-dev-fixtures.mjs          # lists test accounts and profiles without an account; deletes nothing
node scripts/clean-dev-fixtures.mjs --yes    # deletes them with everything they made
```

It only matches emails of the tests' shape, `<word>-<uuid>@korbat.local`, recomputes the counters of kept profiles and posts they touched, and refuses to run unless `API_APP_ORIGIN` in `infra/.env` is a localhost origin. It keeps an account that holds a staff key or that the moderation record names (one that decided anything, one on either side of a staff link, the subject of a case that a decision or a reveal names), and counts it as kept; every other case about a deleted account or one of its posts is deleted with it, the smoke test's open case included.

## Full stack
```bash
docker compose -f infra/compose.yml -f infra/compose.dev.yml up -d --build   # http://localhost:8080, and the staff console at http://localhost:8090
node scripts/smoke-auth-stack.mjs --base http://localhost:8080 --console http://localhost:8090 --mailpit http://localhost:58025 --terms draft-2026-09 -- docker compose -f infra/compose.yml -f infra/compose.dev.yml
```

The smoke test first checks the staff console's site: its page carries the console's own policy and is never stored, and the staff API answers there (401 without a session) and nowhere else (Caddy's own 404 on the app's site); the console's case routes (the overview, the queue, a case, the appeals) answer the same two ways, and the console's site refuses the app's own moderation routes with a 404 of its own. It then signs up a throwaway account through Caddy, reads its code from Mailpit, posts and reads the post back from the public Latest timeline. It uploads a JPEG carrying a GPS position, posts it, and checks that the served file is a fresh WebP without metadata, that a symlink planted in the store from inside the worker gets a 404, and that deleting the post removes the image from disk. It checks the worker's isolation, then grants the account a staff role with the CLI and checks that its session was revoked. A second throwaway account edits its bio, changes its handle, reports the first account's post under a rule, finds that report undecided in its own list and as the last member, `moderation`, of its export, and deletes itself. Last, signed out, a notice that the same post is illegal is taken with the human check: it answers a reference and a token, the status page opens with that token, the receipt arrives in Mailpit, and the token in the receipt's link opens the same page. Nothing in it decides the case, since a decision needs a staff key: every run leaves one open case in lane 2 on the first account's post. One network can run it five times an hour and twenty times a day, since its two sign-ups count against the hourly sign-up limit and its signed-out notice against the limits of reports sent without an account.

After every sharp upgrade, add `--worst-case`: it also uploads flat-colour files at the pixel caps (48 MP 16-bit interlaced PNG, 48 MP progressive JPEG, 48 MP GIF, 16 MP AVIF), expects each to be ready without the worker being OOM-killed or restarted, and prints the worker's memory peak.

Caddy listens on 8080 inside its container as its own user, proxies `/api` to the API and serves the web app with the page's security headers; `index.html` is revalidated on every load and the hashed bundles are cached for a year. On 8090 it serves the staff console under the console's own policy and proxies only `/api/staff/*`, which the app's site refuses. The compose file keeps cloudflared, Caddy, the API and the data services on separate networks, so cloudflared reaches only Caddy and Caddy only the API.

## Upgrading PostgreSQL

The stack runs PostgreSQL 18 on the `pgdata18` volume. A database from the earlier PostgreSQL 16 volume (`pgdata`) is moved by:

```bash
node scripts/pg-major-upgrade.mjs -- docker compose -f infra/compose.yml -f infra/compose.dev.yml
```

It dumps the old cluster with the old image in a throwaway container, starts the new server, restores the dump with every owner kept, and compares the row counts. The old volume stays until you remove it; the test database is created again by `node scripts/test-db.mjs`. Run `staff.js audit-verify` with every kept place before and after a major upgrade; Before going public says why.

## Restoring

Restore the database and the `media-store` volume from the same moment. The API's sweeper deletes images that have no row: after a database restored from an older snapshot it would delete every image posted since. It refuses when there are many such images, but for a restore window set `MEDIA_RECONCILE=off` in `infra/.env` before starting the API, and put it back to `on` once the store matches the database. `force` makes one pass delete them anyway, for when they really are orphans.

Keep no backup of the database or of `media-store` more than 30 days after it was taken (`RETENTION.backupDays`, which the terms publish), and delete older ones, except a backup that korbat must keep for the authorities (step 5), which you keep until they have answered. A backup holds what korbat erased after it was taken, among it content erased under rule R4.

The staff steps run with the api service stopped (`docker compose -f infra/compose.yml stop api`), before it starts again, with the commands under Staff console and Moderation; step 5 says which of its parts wait until the API runs again:

1. Run `staff.js audit-head` on the restored database. Its place and hash go to the keeper with the restore's date: new rows will take the places lost with the backup's later rows, with other hashes, so every place kept after the backup would fail as a rewrite does. The keeper retires those places with that note, `audit-verify` runs from then on with the places at or before the restored one, and a failing place that no announced restore explains is a rewrite.
2. Run `staff.js revoke <email> all` for every account `staff.js keys` lists, since the restore brings back every staff key, staff session and enrolment link revoked or cancelled after the backup, and the auth events and audit rows that recorded those revocations are gone with it.
3. Run grant-role for every staff account with the role on your own list, and `user` for any other account `staff.js keys` lists, as after an API incident: it sets back any role changed after the backup and ends every session and staff session of the account, app sessions revoked after the backup included. Then compare the accounts `staff.js keys` lists with that list.
4. Each person enrols again, two keys each.
5. Moderation. Every decision, review and seal confirmed after the backup is gone with its audit rows, and what it restricted is back: sealed images are served again, and a removed post is public again. Reports, notices and re-examinations received after the backup are gone too, and so is everything `staff.js` wrote since: links and unlinks and limits. So are the stops that people pressed on a report's page after the backup, and the report mail that accounts resumed in Settings since; korbat may mail such an address about reports again, though its holder asked it to stop, until they press stop again, and an account that resumed its report mail gets none until it resumes again. Nothing on the server or in your records names them, so none can be applied again. Until sub-project 3f's off-server copy of decisions, nothing on the server names the lost decisions either. So before the api service starts again after step 3, take the app's public hostname off the tunnel and leave the console's on (with `TUNNEL=off`, close the port that reaches Caddy's 8080 to everyone but yourself). Before it starts, also delete the moderation dispatch's daily markers, which live in Valkey and are not restored with the database: `docker compose -f infra/compose.yml exec -T redis sh -c 'export VALKEYCLI_AUTH="$REDIS_PASSWORD"; valkey-cli --scan --pattern "*moderation-dispatched:*" | while read -r k; do valkey-cli del "$k"; done'`. The dispatch's first round then releases again every outcome and changed outcome that was answered before the day's dispatch hour and not yet released at the backup, so the status pages, the re-examination windows and the mails agree again; a person whose outcome mail or statement went out after the backup's time gets it a second time. Before it starts, also set `API_MODERATION_RETENTION=off` in `infra/.env`. The restored database no longer holds the cases, freezes and seals made after the backup. From its first round, 10 minutes after the start, the retention job would make R4 redactions final, erase case evidence and delete the images that these cases, freezes and seals no longer protect. That includes images sealed and reported to the police since the backup, long before an admin has enrolled and sealed them again. While the switch is off nothing is erased or deleted, and the console's count of late erasures rises. Before anyone decides anything, run `staff.js link` and `staff.js unlink` until the links match your records, and check that the count `staff.js keys` prints for each staff account equals your records'; then run `staff.js limits` with the numbers you last set. Once the staff have enrolled again, an admin first opens a finding citing R2 on every post or account that your R2 records show was sealed after the backup's time, unless its case is open in the restored database, and seals its images again. Only then, once every such seal has been applied again, set `API_MODERATION_RETENTION=on` in `infra/.env` and run `docker compose -f infra/compose.yml up -d api`, which recreates the API with it, and put the app's public hostname back on the tunnel. Its next rounds make up the erasures that fell due meanwhile. Then tell the authority each of these was reported to what was lost and when it was sealed again, and keep the backup you restored from until that authority has answered, also past the 30 days. Sub-project 3d adds the release of sealed images and its replay after a restore. Then the cases that were open at the backup are open again in the queue: decide them again at once, lane 0 first. Each moderator also opens a finding on any other target they remember restricting since the backup's time.

A suspect or revoked staff key is never cleared or revived.

## Posting and feed
Text posts up to 1000 characters, replies, quotes, likes, reposts and bookmarks; follows, blocks and mutes; a chronological Following timeline and a public Latest timeline; threads and profile pages. The web app's home is the timeline; sign-in lives at `/signin`.

- **Reading signed out:** Latest, threads and profiles are public. Following, bookmarks, likes, follower lists and privacy settings need a session.
- **Blocks** are enforced in every query, not just the interface: neither account sees the other while signed in, follows are removed both ways, and the blocked side gets `not_found` so nothing is revealed. Posts are public, so a block does not hide them from someone who signs out; the interface says so.
- **Mutes** are one-way and silent, and hide an account from your timelines only.
- **Liker lists are never exposed.** Counts are public; likes and bookmarks are private to their owner.
- **Write limits** per account, tiered by account age: in the first 24 hours 5 posts and 20 replies an hour and no reposts or quotes for 48 hours; afterwards 30 posts and 60 replies an hour. Everyone: 100 likes an hour, 50 follows an hour and 400 a day, 30 blocks or mutes an hour. Undo actions are never limited.
- **Deleting** blanks the text in the database and leaves a tombstone only where a thread or a quote needs it. There is no editing. A post that a report or a moderator's finding named before it was deleted keeps a copy with its case, read by staff only, for as long as the case needs it (Moderation, Evidence and retention).
- **Moderation states.** A post is `visible`, `withheld` (while a case about it is being decided) or `removed`, as the database derives it from the measures that moderators' decisions recorded; nothing else writes the state, and the API's role cannot. A withheld or removed post is shown to its author alone, with a chip ("Under review" in amber, "Removed" in red) that names the rule or says "illegal content" and links to the decision's statement under Settings, Cases; everyone else finds it in no list and gets `not_found` for it.

## Images
Posts, replies and quotes can carry up to four images, and every image needs a description of up to 1000 characters. The web composer takes JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF and still GIF files up to 20 MB, and refuses HEIC with advice to export a JPEG.

- **Nothing of the original is kept.** The upload goes to the `media-uploads` volume, a separate worker container decodes it and writes fresh WebP files in two sizes (1024 and 2048 pixels on the long side) without any metadata to `media-store`, and the original is deleted once the image is ready.
- **The worker is boxed in.** It has no network, no credentials and no capabilities, runs as a non-root user on a read-only file system within 768 MiB, one CPU and 64 processes, and only reads `media-uploads`. Decoders outside the allowlist are blocked, and the pixel count is checked from the header before decoding: 50 MP, 16 MP for AVIF, 16383 pixels on a side.
- **Formats can be switched off** without a deploy, for example while a codec advisory is open: remove it from `MEDIA_FORMATS` in `infra/.env` and restart `api` and `worker`.
- **Who sees an image** follows its post and, since moderation cases, its own state: anyone when the post and the image are both visible, with a public five-minute cache; only the author when either is withheld or removed, never cached, while everyone else reads "Image hidden by korbat moderation" in its place on a visible post; nobody when the image is sealed (reported as child sexual abuse material, Moderation), its author included, who reads "Sealed: not shown to anyone, you included" in its place; nobody once its content or its post's was erased or the post is deleted. A deleted post's files leave the disk at once, except images that a moderation case holds as evidence or that an unanswered report of child sexual abuse material or a seal freezes: their rows and files are kept, served and listed to nobody and exported to nobody, and the retention job deletes them once nothing retains them.
- **Behind Cloudflare**, set Browser Cache TTL to "Respect Existing Headers", or browsers keep images for four hours whatever the server says.

## Explore
A ranked list of recent original posts, the third tab of Home (`/?tab=explore`). Its whole formula is published at `/explore/about`, printed from `EXPLORE_V2` in `packages/contracts/src/explore.ts`, the constant the ranking itself uses (formula version 2, since account sanctions); changing any number means a new formula version with a dated entry in its change log.
- **What is ranked.** Visible top-level posts that are not quotes, from the last 48 hours, by live accounts that are not suspended at the round's time and have not switched Explore off. A post that a decision hid and a later decision restored gets back the hours it was hidden: its window and its age count from `explore_from`, its creation time moved on by those hours, which only the database's writer of a post's level sets. Replies belong to their threads, and quotes stay out so that a mocking quote cannot put its target's post on a public page.
- **What counts.** Approving accounts: the distinct accounts other than the author that liked or reposted the post, each at least 48 hours old when it did, still live and not suspended at the round's time, the like or repost at least 10 minutes old. The score is approving accounts / (hours since posting + 2)^1.8; a post needs at least 3; one account has at most 2 posts in a ranking of 300. Replies, quotes, followers, the badge and reports are never read.
- **The refresh.** The API's `explore-refresh` job ranks at start and every five minutes under the shared job lock, and a round within 4.5 minutes of the last writes nothing, however many instances run. Each ranking is a numbered generation in `explore_runs` and `explore_items`; the two newest are kept so a reader can finish paging, and a round logs only its generation, its counts and its milliseconds.
- **Reading.** `GET /api/timeline/explore` shows only the order, never a score, count or position. Its cursor names the ranking and the last post read; a pruned ranking answers 409 `explore_refreshed`, and the app goes on from the newest ranking without repeating a post. Moderation states, the author's switch or deletion, blocks in both directions and mutes apply at every read. Signed out: the first 20 posts and no cursor. Every answer is `no-store`.
- **Authors.** Settings > Privacy has "Show my posts in Explore" (`POST` and `DELETE /api/me/explore`, on by default): off takes the posts out at the next read, on brings them back at the next refresh. `GET /api/posts/:id/explore` tells the author alone whether a post is in Explore and which rule keeps it out, never with a count, and the author's listed posts show "In Explore".
- **Tests.** A ranking is a function of the time it is computed at, so the integration suites rank in past epochs of their own (2020 to 2023), each test in its own span after emptying `explore_runs`.

## Staff roles
No API endpoint changes roles. Run this on the server:
```bash
docker compose -f infra/compose.yml run --rm api node dist/grant-role.js <email> <user|moderator|admin>
```
Every session of the account, staff sessions included, is revoked and the change is written to the audit log. Since account sanctions, grant-role refuses to make staff an account that holds a suspension, a termination or a restriction of reporting that stands and has not ended: it says so, changes nothing and exits 1, and an admin lifts a wrong measure with a correction first. Moderators and admins act only on the staff console, with a staff key; two-factor authentication in the app opens nothing there, though a staff account cannot turn it off once it is on.

## Staff console
The staff console (`apps/admin`; design `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-28-staff-console-3a-design.md`) is a page on an origin of its own, `API_CONSOLE_ORIGIN` in `infra/.env`, served by Caddy's second site (port 8090 in its container), which proxies only `/api/staff/*` to the API. Empty, the console is off: every `/api/staff` path answers 404, and the page says that the console is not available at this address. Only a staff key opens it. It holds sign-in, enrolment, a home screen (every staff account's sign-ins of the last 7 days, your staff sessions, your keys), the audit log and, since sub-project 3c, the moderation cases: the queue, the case page with its decision composer, and the appeals (Moderation, below, with the commands 3c added). Keys are enrolled, listed and revoked, and the record is checked, on the server:
```bash
docker compose -f infra/compose.yml run --rm migrate node dist/staff.js enroll <email>        # a one-time link that registers one staff key
docker compose -f infra/compose.yml run --rm api node dist/staff.js keys [<email>]             # an account's staff keys, or every staff account with its keys
docker compose -f infra/compose.yml run --rm api node dist/staff.js revoke <email> <key id>    # that key and every staff session it opened
docker compose -f infra/compose.yml run --rm api node dist/staff.js revoke <email> all         # every key, staff session and unused enrolment link of the account
docker compose -f infra/compose.yml run --rm api node dist/staff.js audit-head                 # the audit log's newest place, hash and time
docker compose -f infra/compose.yml run --rm api node dist/staff.js audit-verify [<chain_seq>:<hash> ...]   # the whole chain, against the places kept
```
Each command waits at most 10 seconds for a lock. One that gives up has changed nothing and says so: an open transaction holds the audit head or the account's row, so stop the api service (`docker compose -f infra/compose.yml stop api`) before running it again.

- **Staff keys.** A staff key is a WebAuthn credential registered on the console's relying party ID (`API_CONSOLE_RP_ID`; empty means the console's hostname) whose authenticator reported user verification and no backup eligibility when it was registered, and reports user verification without the backup flags at every use. A personal passkey never opens the console and a staff key never signs in to the app; passwords, email codes, two-factor and recovery codes never give staff powers. Keys are added only through enrolment links the command line issues as the migrator, which the database enforces, and an account holds at most 5 live keys. No console route adds or revokes one: `staff.js revoke` revokes keys, grant-role revokes them on a change to `user`, an account's deletion revokes them, and a key whose signature counter goes backwards is switched off together with every staff session it opened. A key's row is never deleted, because `audit-verify` checks old confirmations against its public key; a deleted account's keys keep no name, AAGUID or transports.
- **Enrolment.** `staff.js enroll` runs in the migrate service, as the migrator, the one role the running API never holds. It prints a link to `<API_CONSOLE_ORIGIN>/enroll/<token>`, valid 30 minutes and once, for a live account that is staff, has a handle and holds fewer than 5 live keys, and refuses while the console is off. Whoever holds the link can register a key for that account, so hand it over by a channel you trust. The person opens it on the device that holds the key, names the key (the key and the console show the name, so not an email address or a real name), and chooses "Register a security key" or "Use Windows Hello on this computer"; a refused key leaves the link working until it expires. The owner is mailed every key added. A link issued before a `revoke ... all`, a role change, a deletion or a move of the console enrols nothing.
- **Sessions and confirmations.** A staff session lasts at most 12 hours and ends after 15 minutes without an action by its person (a click, a submitted form, a screen opened); the console warns two minutes before the idle end with "Stay signed in", and nothing moves the 12-hour end. It is read from the database at every request, so a revocation, a demotion, a deletion or a switched-off key ends it at its next request. Every new staff session is mailed to its owner, and every staff member's home screen lists every staff account's sign-ins of the last 7 days: a sign-in nobody recognises means someone else holds a staff key. An action that changes something asks for the session's own key again, for that action, its target and its parameters only ("Sign out that session", every decision on a case, every review of an appeal and every reveal of who sent a report), and its row in the audit log keeps the key's signature. Three things a moderator does on a case ask for no key, since none of them restricts or releases anything: saving a text (it enters the record only when a confirmed decision or reveal names its digest), taking a fresh snapshot, and opening a case on their own finding (limited per day, and counted on the home screen).
- **The audit log and its head.** The audit log is the record of every staff action: enrolment links issued and cancelled, keys added and revoked, sign-ins, sign-outs, session revocations and role changes, each written in the same transaction as its change, and since 3c every decision, every review of an appeal and every reveal, each link, unlink and change of the limits the command line makes, each read of an account's facts and each drafted access request, and each erasure of the retention job. A moderation row holds ids, kinds, times and salted digests only, never a text anyone typed. It is a hash chain: the database gives every row its place (`chain_seq`) and a hash over the previous row's hash and the row's content, so a row changed later changes every hash after it.
````
