export async function recordCarriedReceipt(q: Runner, intakeId: string, state: MailState): Promise<void> {
  await q.execute(
    sql`update intakes set receipt = ${state}::delivery_state, receipt_sent_at = case when ${state}::text = 'sent' then now() else receipt_sent_at end
         where id = ${intakeId}::uuid and receipt in ('pending', 'folded')`,
  );
}

/** A decision that holds an announced suspension or termination, as a condition on decision `d`. */
const HOLDS_ANNOUNCED = sql`exists (select 1 from decision_actions a where a.decision_id = d.id and a.kind::text in ('suspend', 'terminate') and a.announced)`;

/**
 * The receipts and the statement mails still unsent `days` days after they were due, recorded as given up; answers their
 * ids. 3e (design, section 7.14 item 3): the statement mail of a decision that holds an announced measure is left out:
 * its outcome fixes the measure's start, so each is given up alone, under its subject's profile lock (giveUpAnnouncedMail).
 */
export async function giveUpReceiptsAndAuthorMails(q: Runner, now: Date, days: number): Promise<{ receipts: string[]; authorMails: string[] }> {
  const due = sql`${at(now)} - make_interval(days => ${days}::int)`;
  const receipts = await rows<{ id: string }>(q, sql`update intakes set receipt = 'failed' where receipt in ('pending', 'folded') and received_at < ${due} returning id`);
  const authorMails = await rows<{ id: string }>(q, sql`update decisions d set author_mail = 'failed' where d.author_mail = 'pending' and d.decided_at < ${due} and not ${HOLDS_ANNOUNCED} returning d.id`);
  return { receipts: receipts.map((row) => row.id), authorMails: authorMails.map((row) => row.id) };
}

/** The statement mails of decisions that hold an announced measure, still unsent `days` days after the decision, with each decision's subject: each is given up alone. */
export async function announcedMailsDue(q: Runner, now: Date, days: number): Promise<{ decisionId: string; subjectId: string }[]> {
  const found = await rows<{ id: string; subject: string }>(
    q,
    sql`select d.id, (select a.subject_account_id from decision_actions a where a.decision_id = d.id and a.kind::text in ('suspend', 'terminate')) as subject
          from decisions d where d.author_mail = 'pending' and d.decided_at < ${at(now)} - make_interval(days => ${days}::int) and ${HOLDS_ANNOUNCED}
         order by d.decided_at, d.id`,
  );
  return found.map((row) => ({ decisionId: row.id, subjectId: row.subject }));
}

/**
 * Gives up one announced measure's statement mail, in a transaction whose caller took the subject's profile row first
 * (the lock order, item 4): the decision's row is updated only while its mail is still pending, and the database stamps
 * the time and fixes the start from it (decisions_mail_forward, decisions_mail_standing). True when this call gave it up.
 */
export async function giveUpAnnouncedMail(tx: DbTx, decisionId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  return (await rows<{ id: string }>(tx, sql`update decisions set author_mail = 'failed' where id = ${decisionId}::uuid and author_mail = 'pending' returning id`)).length > 0;
}

/** The outcome lines still unsent `days` days after their release, or after the release of their changed outcome, recorded as given up; answers their ids. */
export async function giveUpOutcomeMails(q: Runner, now: Date, days: number): Promise<string[]> {
  const found = await rows<{ id: string }>(
    q,
    sql`update intake_items set outcome_mail = 'failed'
         where outcome_mail = 'pending' and coalesce(revised_sent_at, outcome_sent_at) < ${at(now)} - make_interval(days => ${days}::int) returning id`,
  );
  return found.map((row) => row.id);
}

/** An unanswered item in the urgent lane that has waited long enough to be alerted about again, with what decides whether it still calls for someone. */
export interface UrgentItemRow {
  caseId: string;
  targetType: TargetType;
  targetId: string;
  suspect: boolean;
  /** When the item arrived, in epoch milliseconds. */
  arrivedMs: number;
  /** Whether a decision taken while deciding, a note, or a recorded choice not to seal came after the item arrived. */
  interimAfter: boolean;
  noteAfter: boolean;
  declinedAfter: boolean;
  /** When the newest recorded choice not to seal of the case was saved, in epoch milliseconds, to the millisecond. */
  newestDeclinedMs: number | null;
  /** A post case's post is not visible: withheld, removed, or deleted by its author. */
  postHidden: boolean;
}

/**
 * The unanswered items of open cases in the urgent lane that arrived before `before`, the cases that have waited longest
 * first and each case's items together. "After the item arrived" compares the item's time with the decision's or the
 * text's, as the view of measures in force does: no later than.
 */
export async function urgentItems(q: Runner, before: Date): Promise<UrgentItemRow[]> {
  const after = (kind: string) => sql.raw(`exists (select 1 from staff_texts t where t.case_id = c.id and t.kind = '${kind}' and t.created_at >= i.created_at)`);
  const found = await rows<Record<string, unknown>>(
    q,
    sql`select c.id as case_id, c.target_type, c.target_id, i.suspect,
               floor(extract(epoch from i.created_at) * 1000)::float8 as arrived_ms,
               exists (select 1 from decisions d where d.case_id = c.id and d.kind = 'interim' and d.decided_at >= i.created_at) as interim_after,
               ${after("note")} as note_after, ${after("seal_declined")} as declined_after,
               (select floor(extract(epoch from max(t.created_at)) * 1000)::float8 from staff_texts t where t.case_id = c.id and t.kind = 'seal_declined') as newest_declined_ms,
               coalesce((select p.state <> 'visible' from posts p where c.target_type = 'post' and p.id = c.target_id), false) as post_hidden
          from intake_items i join cases c on c.id = i.case_id
         where c.closed_at is null and i.lane = 0 and i.outcome is null and i.created_at < ${at(before)}
         order by c.oldest_open_at, c.id, i.seq`,
  );
  return found.map((row) => ({
    caseId: row.case_id as string,
    targetType: row.target_type as TargetType,
    targetId: row.target_id as string,
    suspect: row.suspect as boolean,
    arrivedMs: Number(row.arrived_ms),
    interimAfter: row.interim_after as boolean,
    noteAfter: row.note_after as boolean,
    declinedAfter: row.declined_after as boolean,
    newestDeclinedMs: row.newest_declined_ms === null ? null : Number(row.newest_declined_ms),
    postHidden: row.post_hidden as boolean,
  }));
}

/**
 * The cases past their lane's response time (24 hours in lanes 0 and 1, seven days in lane 2, counted from the oldest
 * unanswered item), per lane with the oldest one's time, and the open cases that have held a measure taken while
 * deciding for more than 24 hours, whatever their lane.
 */
export async function waitingCases(q: Runner, now: Date): Promise<{ lanes: { lane: Lane; count: number; oldest: Date }[]; interim: number; replies: { count: number; oldest: Date } | null }> {
  const found = await rows<{ lane: Lane; n: number; oldest: string }>(
    q,
    sql`select lane, count(*)::int as n, ${iso("min(oldest_open_at)")} as oldest from cases
         where closed_at is null and oldest_open_at < ${at(now)} - case when lane = 2 then interval '7 days' else interval '24 hours' end
         group by lane order by lane`,
  );
  const [held] = await rows<{ n: number }>(
    q,
    sql`select count(distinct m.case_id)::int as n from measures_in_force m join decisions d on d.id = m.decision_id join cases c on c.id = m.case_id
         where m.decision_kind = 'interim' and c.closed_at is null and d.decided_at < ${at(now)} - interval '24 hours'`,
  );
  // 3e (design, section 7.14): the replies to a suspension or a termination that no decision answered for longer than
  // korbat's aim, with the oldest one's time.
  const [replies] = await rows<{ n: number; oldest: string | null }>(
    q,
    sql`select count(*)::int as n, ${iso("min(r.filed_at)")} as oldest from suspension_replies r
         where r.answered_by is null and r.filed_at < ${at(now)} - make_interval(hours => ${REPLY_AIM_HOURS}::int)`,
  );
  return {
    lanes: found.map((row) => ({ lane: row.lane, count: row.n, oldest: new Date(row.oldest) })),
    interim: held!.n,
    replies: replies!.n > 0 && replies!.oldest !== null ? { count: replies!.n, oldest: new Date(replies!.oldest) } : null,
  };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- retention

/**
 * The SQL of the retention job and of the overview's late erasures (3c design, sections 6.4, 7.3 and 7.9). Every time is
 * the database's own: each erase function checks its due rule against the database's now(), so the job asks with the same
 * clock, and one clock decides what is due. The periods are the contracts' RETENTION, handed over as numbers.
 *
 * The candidates are read from the partial indexes that hold only what is left to erase, so a round's work follows what
 * is left, never every case ever closed. The freeze is read here only to keep a case that holds nothing but snapshots of
 * a frozen post out of the candidates: for every snapshot the one function that erases one decides.
 */

/** The cases that hold a row erase_case_evidence would change: an unerased snapshot that is not of a frozen post, an unerased note or draft, an appeal statement, or an unreleased hold. */
const CANDIDATE_CASES = sql`
  select s.case_id from evidence_snapshots s where s.erased_at is null and not (s.target_type = 'post' and public.post_frozen(s.target_id))
  union select t.case_id from staff_texts t where t.confirmed_at is null and t.erased_at is null
  union select d.case_id from appeals a join decisions d on d.id = a.decision_id where a.statement is not null
  union select h.case_id from media_holds h where h.released_at is null`;

/** A final decision citing R4 that is not redacted yet and one of whose R4 measures is in force, as `d`. */
const REDACTABLE = sql`d.kind = 'final' and d.rule_id = 'R4' and d.redacted_at is null
  and exists (select 1 from measures_in_force m where m.decision_id = d.id and m.kind in ('remove', 'remove_media', 'reset_bio', 'reset_display_name'))`;

/** A decision one of whose statement texts is unerased, as `d`, joined to the profile `p` of its case's subject. */
const STATEMENT_HELD = sql`from decisions d
  join cases c on c.id = d.case_id
  join profiles p on p.id = case when c.target_type = 'account' then c.target_id else (select x.author_id from posts x where x.id = c.target_id) end
  where exists (select 1 from staff_texts t where t.digest in (d.facts_digest, d.reason_digest, d.legal_reference_digest) and t.erased_at is null)`;

/** The candidate cases whose evidence is due now, in id order. */
export async function dueCases(q: Runner): Promise<string[]> {
  const found = await rows<{ id: string }>(q, sql`select k.case_id as id from (${CANDIDATE_CASES}) k where public.case_evidence_due_at(k.case_id) <= now() order by 1`);
  return found.map((row) => row.id);
}

/** The unerased intakes whose record is due now. None is due before `days` days after it was received, which the index is read by. */
export async function dueIntakes(q: Runner, days: number): Promise<string[]> {
  const found = await rows<{ id: string }>(
    q,
    sql`select n.id from intakes n where n.erased_at is null and n.received_at <= now() - make_interval(days => ${days}::int) and public.intake_due_at(n.id) <= now() order by n.received_at, n.id`,
  );
  return found.map((row) => row.id);
}

/** The R4 decisions that are final for their author and not redacted yet. The redaction itself answers false for one whose post is frozen. */
export async function dueRedactions(q: Runner): Promise<string[]> {
  const found = await rows<{ id: string }>(q, sql`select d.id from decisions d where ${REDACTABLE} and public.decision_final_at(d.id) <= now() order by d.decided_at, d.id`);
  return found.map((row) => row.id);
}

/** The decisions that still hold a statement text and whose subject's profile was deleted at least `months` months ago. */
export async function dueStatements(q: Runner, months: number): Promise<string[]> {
  const found = await rows<{ id: string }>(q, sql`select d.id ${STATEMENT_HELD} and p.deleted_at <= now() - make_interval(months => ${months}::int) order by d.decided_at, d.id`);
  return found.map((row) => row.id);
}

const changedBy = async (q: Runner, call: ReturnType<typeof sql>): Promise<number> => (await rows<{ n: number }>(q, sql`select ${call} as n`))[0]!.n;

/** Deletes the drafts nobody confirmed that are older than `hours` hours; never a note, a recorded choice not to seal or a confirmed text. */
export const sweepStaffTexts = (q: Runner, hours: number) => changedBy(q, sql`public.sweep_staff_texts(now() - make_interval(hours => ${hours}::int))`);
/** Erases a due case's snapshots (never one of a frozen post), notes, drafts and appeal statements, and releases its holds. */
export const eraseCaseEvidence = (q: Runner, caseId: string) => changedBy(q, sql`public.erase_case_evidence(${caseId}::uuid)`);
/** Erases a due intake's record: its explanation, its cited law, who sent it and its re-examinations' statements. */
export const eraseIntake = (q: Runner, intakeId: string) => changedBy(q, sql`public.erase_intake(${intakeId}::uuid)`);
/** Erases the statement texts of a decision whose subject's account has been deleted for 12 months. */
export const eraseStatementTexts = (q: Runner, decisionId: string) => changedBy(q, sql`public.erase_statement_texts(${decisionId}::uuid)`);
/** Deletes the access rows older than `months` months, erasing first the reveal reasons they name. */
export const deleteAccessLog = (q: Runner, months: number) => changedBy(q, sql`public.delete_access_log(now() - make_interval(months => ${months}::int))`);
/** Forgets that a deleted account sent its reports; 0 for an account whose auth row is not marked deleted. */
export const forgetReporter = (q: Runner, accountId: string) => changedBy(q, sql`public.forget_reporter(${accountId}::uuid)`);
/**
 * 3e: erases the text of every reply to a suspension or a termination that is answered and whose decision is final for
 * its author, keeping its digest and its row; an unanswered reply keeps its text however old. Answers how many it erased.
 */
export const eraseReplyStatements = (q: Runner) => changedBy(q, sql`public.erase_reply_statements()`);
/** 3e: deletes the marks and the tallies of reports sent on a UTC day before the frame of the reporting counts; answers how many rows. */
export const forgetReportCounts = (q: Runner) => changedBy(q, sql`public.forget_report_counts()`);

/** Makes an R4 restriction's erasure final; false when it changed nothing (its post is frozen, or another round was faster). */
export async function redactR4(q: Runner, decisionId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  return (await rows<{ done: boolean }>(q, sql`select public.redact_r4_body(${decisionId}::uuid) as done`))[0]!.done;
}

/** The overview's late erasures that this module's tables answer: what each step should have changed more than a day ago. */
export interface LateErasures {
  caseEvidence: number;
  intakeRecords: number;
  statements: number;
  redactions: number;
  drafts: number;
  accessLog: number;
}

/**
 * How much each due rule is late by more than a day. A case that holds only snapshots of a frozen post is no candidate
 * and never counted, and a redaction whose post is frozen would change nothing now, so it is not counted either: both
 * wait for an admin's answer, not for the job.
 */
export async function lateErasures(q: Runner, periods: { intakeDays: number; statementMonths: number; draftHours: number; accessLogMonths: number }): Promise<LateErasures> {
  const [row] = await rows<{ case_evidence: number; intake_records: number; statements: number; redactions: number; drafts: number; access_log: number }>(
    q,
    sql`select
      (select count(*)::int from (${CANDIDATE_CASES}) k where public.case_evidence_due_at(k.case_id) < now() - interval '1 day') as case_evidence,
      (select count(*)::int from intakes n
        where n.erased_at is null and n.received_at <= now() - make_interval(days => ${periods.intakeDays}::int) and public.intake_due_at(n.id) < now() - interval '1 day') as intake_records,
      (select count(*)::int ${STATEMENT_HELD} and p.deleted_at < now() - make_interval(months => ${periods.statementMonths}::int) - interval '1 day') as statements,
      (select count(*)::int from decisions d join cases c on c.id = d.case_id
        where ${REDACTABLE} and public.decision_final_at(d.id) < now() - interval '1 day'
          and not (c.target_type = 'post' and public.post_frozen(c.target_id))) as redactions,
      (select count(*)::int from staff_texts t
        where t.kind not in ('note', 'seal_declined') and t.confirmed_at is null and t.created_at < now() - make_interval(hours => ${periods.draftHours}::int) - interval '1 day') as drafts,
      (select count(*)::int from case_access_log l where l.at < now() - make_interval(months => ${periods.accessLogMonths}::int) - interval '1 day') as access_log`,
  );
  return { caseEvidence: row!.case_evidence, intakeRecords: row!.intake_records, statements: row!.statements, redactions: row!.redactions, drafts: row!.drafts, accessLog: row!.access_log };
}

import { IdentityRevealedParams, type RevealResponse } from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { ActiveStaffSession, StaffStepUpConfirmed } from "../auth";
import { boundLockWaits, isBoundReached, isDeadlock } from "../lib/lock-bounds";
import { secondsToUtcMidnight } from "./cases";
import { ModerationError, isModerationErrorCode, type ModerationDeps } from "./context";
import { appendConfirmedAudit, dailyLimits, handleOf, insertAccess, raisedMessage, reporterHandle, revealItem, revealReason, revealsToday, staffCaseConflict } from "./repo";

/**
 * Revealing who sent a report or a notice (3c design, section 7.3). Staff see a source only as a summary; a reporter's
 * handle, or the name a signed-out notifier gave, is shown to a moderator only through this confirmed action, with a
 * reason category and a saved reason text, written to the access log and to the audit record in one transaction, listed
 * on every staff member's home screen and mailed to every staff account. A notifier's address is never revealed.
 */

/** A reveal that committed, with what it showed; or why none did: the confirming account or key ended, or the challenge's time ran out. */
export type RevealOutcome = RevealResponse | "ended" | "late";

/** The lock waits a reveal may meet: the acting account's row, the key's row and the audit head. */
const REVEAL_WAITS = 3;

/** A transaction that met a deadlock or a lock timeout is run once more only while more than this much of the challenge is left. */
const RETRY_MARGIN_MS = 60_000;

/**
 * POST /api/staff/items/:item/reveal, once its step-up verified. Before anything is written it refuses, in this order:
 *   - not_found: the item does not exist, or has no case (its link named nothing);
 *   - staff_recused: the person is too close to the case's subject;
 *   - reveal_refused: the item's intake is on the path for child sexual abuse material or a moderator's finding, or names
 *     nobody (the reporter's link is gone, or the notifier gave no name, or the contact is lost);
 *   - text_not_found: the params' digest is not that of the person's own saved reason on the item's case, unerased,
 *     unconfirmed and named by no reveal yet;
 *   - rate_limited: the person has revealed the day's limit of sources since midnight UTC. The count is read before the
 *     transaction, so two reveals sent at once may both pass at the limit.
 * Then one transaction: every lock wait bounded by a third of what is left of the challenge; the access row; and, last,
 * the audit row through public.append_confirmed_audit, which also confirms the reason text and is what ends a reveal by
 * a staff account or a key that no longer opens anything, and a late one. Nothing else guards it: no decision's trigger
 * runs for a reveal.
 *
 * The identity is read only after the commit, so none is answered when the commit fails: the reporter's handle, or the
 * notifier's given name from the auth module. Both are null when the name was forgotten in between. Every staff account,
 * the person's own included, is then mailed, best effort and without a throttle: the day's limit bounds it, and the home
 * screen lists every reveal.
 */
export async function reveal(deps: ModerationDeps, session: ActiveStaffSession, confirmed: StaffStepUpConfirmed, ctx: { requestId: string }): Promise<RevealOutcome> {
  // A confirmation of anything else never reveals a source: that would be a wiring fault, not a refusal.
  if (confirmed.action !== "identity_revealed" || confirmed.target.type !== "intake_item" || confirmed.keyId !== session.keyId) {
    throw new Error("a reveal needs a step-up that confirmed it");
  }
  const params = IdentityRevealedParams.parse(confirmed.params);
  const itemId = confirmed.target.id;

  const item = await revealItem(deps.apiDb, itemId);
  if (!item || item.caseId === null) throw new ModerationError("not_found");
  const caseId = item.caseId;
  if (await staffCaseConflict(deps.apiDb, session.userId, caseId)) throw new ModerationError("staff_recused");
  if (item.csam || item.intakeKind === "finding") throw new ModerationError("reveal_refused");
  const signedOut = item.channel === "signed_out";
  if (signedOut) {
    const facts = item.contactId === null ? undefined : (await deps.auth.notifierFacts([item.contactId])).get(item.contactId);
    if (!facts?.named) throw new ModerationError("reveal_refused");
  } else if (item.reporterAccountId === null) {
    throw new ModerationError("reveal_refused");
  }
  const textId = await revealReason(deps.apiDb, { caseId, authorId: session.userId, digest: params.reasonDigest });
  if (textId === null) throw new ModerationError("text_not_found");
  const limits = await dailyLimits(deps.apiDb);
  if ((await revealsToday(deps.apiDb, session.userId)) >= limits.reveals) {
    throw new ModerationError("rate_limited", 429, undefined, secondsToUtcMidnight(deps.now()));
  }

  let done: { at: Date; count: number };
  for (let attempt = 1; ; attempt++) {
    try {
      const stamped = await deps.apiDb.transaction(async (tx): Promise<{ at: Date; count: number } | "late"> => {
        if (!(await boundLockWaits(tx, confirmed.expiresAt, REVEAL_WAITS))) return "late";
        const at = await insertAccess(tx, { staffId: session.userId, caseId, kind: "identity_revealed", itemId, textId });
        // The person's reveals of the day, this one included, for the mail; read before the audit row, which is last.
        const count = await revealsToday(tx, session.userId);
        await appendConfirmedAudit(tx, {
          actorId: session.userId,
          keyId: confirmed.keyId,
          action: "identity_revealed",
          targetType: "intake_item",
          targetId: itemId,
          metadata: { params: confirmed.params },
          staffSession: session.handle,
          actionHash: confirmed.actionHash,
          stepUp: confirmed.assertion,
          requestId: ctx.requestId,
          expiresAt: confirmed.expiresAt,
        });
        return { at, count };
      });
      if (stamped === "late") return "late";
      done = stamped;
      break;
    } catch (err) {
      const refusal = raisedMessage(err);
      if (refusal === "staff_confirmation_ended") return "ended";
      if (refusal === "staff_confirmation_late") return "late";
      // The reason text was swept or used between the check above and the audit function's own.
      if (refusal !== null && isModerationErrorCode(refusal)) throw new ModerationError(refusal);
      if (!isDeadlock(err) && !isBoundReached(err)) throw err;
      if (attempt > 1 || confirmed.expiresAt.getTime() - deps.now().getTime() <= RETRY_MARGIN_MS) return "late";
    }
  }

  // The reveal is on the record. Every staff account is told, whatever becomes of the read below.
  deps.background.start(async () => {
    const handle = (await handleOf(deps.apiDb, session.userId)) ?? "unknown";
    await deps.auth.mailStaff({ template: "moderation_reveal", handle, at: done.at, count: done.count, limit: limits.reveals });
  });

  if (signedOut) return { handle: null, name: item.contactId === null ? null : await deps.auth.notifierName(item.contactId) };
  return { handle: await reporterHandle(deps.apiDb, itemId), name: null };
}

import { sql, type SQL } from "drizzle-orm";
import type { DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { iso, markCounts, rows, type Runner, type SaltedText } from "./repo";

/**
 * The queries of account sanctions (3e design, sections 6.2 and 7.12): an account's standing as the views of the standing
 * ledger give it, the strike rule's answer for a post case, and the period of each standing measure. Every number comes
 * from the database's own standing_rules(), and every "now" is the database's clock, so the case answer reads what the
 * ledger's triggers would read at the same moment. Nothing here is stored: each answer is computed at the request.
 */

/** What may rest on a decision: a suspension or a termination, or (Task 5) a restriction of reporting on its warning. */
export type StandingOnKind = "suspend" | "terminate" | "restrict_reporting";

/** A UTC day of a timestamptz expression. The expression is written here, never input. */
const day = (expression: string) => sql.raw(`to_char(${expression} at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD')`);

/** An instant as JavaScript writes it, or null for an infinite one (a termination's end). */
const finite = (expression: string) => sql`case when isfinite(${sql.raw(expression)}) then ${iso(expression)} end`;

/**
 * What strike_due answers for a final restriction of this case on a korbat rule other than R2 that rests on no suspect
 * item (the rule passed is R1: strike_due asks only that it is not R2), and whether the case's post already carries a
 * strike that stands, which is the first of the two reasons it can answer false.
 */
export async function strikeDueOf(q: Runner, caseId: string): Promise<{ due: boolean; struck: boolean }> {
  const [row] = await rows<{ due: boolean; struck: boolean }>(
    q,
    sql`select public.strike_due(${caseId}::uuid, 'incompatible', 'R1', false, null) as due,
               exists (select 1 from cases c
                         join cases x on x.target_type = 'post' and x.target_id = c.target_id
                         join decisions d on d.case_id = x.id
                         join decision_actions a on a.decision_id = d.id and a.kind = 'strike'
                        where c.id = ${caseId}::uuid
                          and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions r where r.reverses_action_id = a.id)) as struck`,
  );
  return { due: row?.due ?? false, struck: row?.struck ?? false };
}

/** An active strike of an account, as the case answer lists it. */
export interface StrikeRow {
  decisionId: string;
  caseId: string;
  ruleId: string;
  decidedAt: string;
  countsUntil: string;
}

/** The facts an account's standing is built from, each read from the ledger's views at the database's clock. */
export interface StandingFacts {
  /** The active strikes, oldest first. */
  strikes: StrikeRow[];
  /** The rule of the newest active strike. */
  ladderRule: string | null;
  /** Whether a strike is newer than the newest measure of the ladder that stands, or there is none. */
  newStrikeSinceLadder: boolean;
  /** The suspensions of the ladder that stand, whose basis holds, decided in the last ladder_memory_days, and the day of the newest. */
  suspensionsInYear: number;
  lastSuspendedOn: string | null;
  /** The live standing measure (standing_live), with its kind and its period's state now; null when none. */
  live: { kind: "suspend" | "terminate"; running: boolean } | null;
  /** The account's posts of the last flood_minutes, and the interval they were counted in. */
  flood: { posts: number; from: string; to: string };
  /** The grounds of a measure at once whose facts hold now, by the rows of decision_actions_check's table. */
  threat: boolean;
  terrorist: boolean;
  threatRepeat: boolean;
  /** The day of the newest seal for good of the account's images that a protective suspension may rest on now. */
  sealOn: string | null;
  /** The time of the decision each ground of a suspension at once would rest on now, or null (Task 3); and (Task 4) the two of a termination at once. */
  basisDecidedAt: { threat: string | null; terrorist: string | null; protective: string | null; threatRepeat: { earlier: string; newer: string } | null };
}

/**
 * An account's standing: its active strikes, its ladder, its live measure, and the facts of the grounds of a measure at
 * once, read as the rows of decision_actions_check's table read them. An aid to the console: the database decides at the
 * commit, and a fact that moves between this read and the key is refused there.
 */
export async function standingFacts(q: Runner, accountId: string): Promise<StandingFacts> {
  const account = sql`${accountId}::uuid`;
  const strikes = await rows<{ decision_id: string; case_id: string; rule_id: string; decided_at: string; counts_until: string }>(
    q,
    sql`select s.decision_id, d.case_id, d.rule_id, ${iso("d.decided_at")} as decided_at, ${iso("s.ends_at")} as counts_until
          from active_strikes s join decisions d on d.id = s.decision_id
         where s.account_id = ${account} order by s.created_at, s.action_id`,
  );
  const [ladder] = await rows<{ new_strike: boolean; in_year: number; last_on: string | null }>(
    q,
    sql`select coalesce((select max(s.created_at) from active_strikes s where s.account_id = ${account})
                          > (select max(a.created_at) from decision_actions a
                              where a.subject_account_id = ${account} and a.kind in ('suspend', 'terminate') and a.basis in ('strikes', 'ladder_end')
                                and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions r where r.reverses_action_id = a.id)), true) as new_strike,
               count(y.id)::int as in_year, max(${day("y.decided_at")}) as last_on
          from (select 1) one
          left join (select a.id, d.decided_at from decision_actions a join decisions d on d.id = a.decision_id cross join standing_rules() k
                      where a.subject_account_id = ${account} and a.kind = 'suspend' and a.basis = 'strikes'
                        and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions r where r.reverses_action_id = a.id)
                        and public.standing_basis_broken_at(a.id) is null
                        and d.decided_at >= now() - make_interval(days => k.ladder_memory_days)) y on true`,
  );
  const [live] = await rows<{ kind: "suspend" | "terminate"; running: boolean }>(
    q,
    sql`select a.kind, coalesce(p.starts_at <= clock_timestamp(), false) as running
          from standing_live s join decision_actions a on a.id = s.action_id left join suspension_periods p on p.action_id = s.action_id
         where s.account_id = ${account} limit 1`,
  );
  const [grounds] = await rows<{
    posts: number;
    from_at: string;
    to_at: string;
    threat_at: string | null;
    terrorist_at: string | null;
    threat_repeat: boolean;
    seal_on: string | null;
    seal_at: string | null;
    repeat_earlier: string | null;
    repeat_newer: string | null;
  }>(
    q,
    sql`select (select count(*)::int from posts p where p.author_id = ${account} and p.created_at > now() - make_interval(mins => k.flood_minutes)) as posts,
               ${iso("(now() - make_interval(mins => k.flood_minutes))")} as from_at, ${iso("now()")} as to_at,
               (select ${iso("x.decided_at")} from decisions x join cases xc on xc.id = x.case_id and xc.target_type = 'post' join posts xp on xp.id = xc.target_id and xp.author_id = ${account}
                 where x.kind = 'final' and x.outcome = 'restricted' and x.rule_id = 'R5' and x.decided_at >= now() - make_interval(days => k.basis_age_days)
                   and exists (select 1 from measures_in_force f where f.decision_id = x.id)
                 order by x.decided_at desc, x.id desc limit 1) as threat_at,
               (select ${iso("x.decided_at")} from decisions x join cases xc on xc.id = x.case_id and xc.target_type = 'post' join posts xp on xp.id = xc.target_id and xp.author_id = ${account}
                 where x.kind = 'final' and x.outcome = 'restricted' and x.ground = 'illegal' and x.category_keyword = 'KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT'
                   and x.decided_at >= now() - make_interval(days => k.basis_age_days)
                   and exists (select 1 from measures_in_force f where f.decision_id = x.id)
                 order by x.decided_at desc, x.id desc limit 1) as terrorist_at,
               exists (select 1 from decision_actions a join decisions ad on ad.id = a.decision_id
                         join posts xp on xp.author_id = ${account} and xp.created_at > ad.informed_at
                         join cases xc on xc.target_type = 'post' and xc.target_id = xp.id
                         join decisions x on x.case_id = xc.id
                        where a.subject_account_id = ${account} and a.kind = 'suspend' and a.basis = 'threat'
                          and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions r where r.reverses_action_id = a.id)
                          and public.standing_basis_broken_at(a.id) is null
                          and ad.decided_at >= now() - make_interval(days => k.ladder_memory_days)
                          and x.kind = 'final' and x.outcome = 'restricted' and x.rule_id = 'R5' and x.decided_at >= now() - make_interval(days => k.basis_age_days)
                          and exists (select 1 from measures_in_force f where f.decision_id = x.id)) as threat_repeat,
               -- Task 4: the two decisions a termination at once would rest on now, for the console's preview.
               t.earlier as repeat_earlier, t.newer as repeat_newer,
               (select ${day("x.decided_at")} from measures_in_force m join decisions x on x.id = m.decision_id
                 where m.kind = 'seal_media' and m.decision_kind = 'final' and m.subject_account_id = ${account}
                   and x.decided_at >= now() - make_interval(days => k.basis_age_days)
                   and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions p where p.kind = 'suspend' and p.basis = 'protective' and m.decision_id = any(p.rests_on))
                 order by x.decided_at desc, x.id desc limit 1) as seal_on,
               (select ${iso("x.decided_at")} from measures_in_force m join decisions x on x.id = m.decision_id
                 where m.kind = 'seal_media' and m.decision_kind = 'final' and m.subject_account_id = ${account}
                   and x.decided_at >= now() - make_interval(days => k.basis_age_days)
                   and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions p where p.kind = 'suspend' and p.basis = 'protective' and m.decision_id = any(p.rests_on))
                 order by x.decided_at desc, x.id desc limit 1) as seal_at
          from standing_rules() k
          left join lateral (
            select ${iso("rd.decided_at")} as earlier, ${iso("x.decided_at")} as newer
              from decision_actions a join decisions ad on ad.id = a.decision_id
              join decisions rd on rd.id = a.rests_on[1]
              join posts xp on xp.author_id = ${account} and xp.created_at > ad.informed_at
              join cases xc on xc.target_type = 'post' and xc.target_id = xp.id
              join decisions x on x.case_id = xc.id
             where a.subject_account_id = ${account} and a.kind = 'suspend' and a.basis = 'threat'

             order by x.decided_at desc, x.id desc limit 1
          ) t on true`
  );
  return {
    strikes: strikes.map((row) => ({ decisionId: row.decision_id, caseId: row.case_id, ruleId: row.rule_id, decidedAt: row.decided_at, countsUntil: row.counts_until })),
    ladderRule: strikes.at(-1)?.rule_id ?? null,
    newStrikeSinceLadder: ladder!.new_strike,
    suspensionsInYear: ladder!.in_year,
    lastSuspendedOn: ladder!.last_on,
    live: live ? { kind: live.kind, running: live.running } : null,
    flood: { posts: grounds!.posts, from: grounds!.from_at, to: grounds!.to_at },
    threat: grounds!.threat_at !== null,
    terrorist: grounds!.terrorist_at !== null,
    threatRepeat: grounds!.threat_repeat,
    sealOn: grounds!.seal_on,
    basisDecidedAt: {
      threat: grounds!.threat_at,
      terrorist: grounds!.terrorist_at,
      protective: grounds!.seal_at,
      threatRepeat: grounds!.repeat_earlier !== null && grounds!.repeat_newer !== null ? { earlier: grounds!.repeat_earlier, newer: grounds!.repeat_newer } : null,
