```ts
/** A decision's measures and reversals, in the ledger's order of kinds. */
export async function statementActions(q: Runner, decisionId: string): Promise<StatementActionRow[]> {
  const found = await rows<Record<string, unknown>>(
    q,
    sql`select a.kind, a.media_id, a.no_effect, l.decision_id as lifted_decision, ld.rule_id as lifted_rule, l.no_effect as lifted_no_effect,
               (ls.erased_at is null or ls.erased_at > d.decided_at) as lifted_snapshot_kept,
               (select count(*)::int from seal_posts s where s.action_id = a.id) as sealed_posts,
               (select coalesce(sum(s.images), 0)::int from seal_posts s where s.action_id = a.id) as sealed_images,
               (select coalesce(sum(s.images), 0)::int from seal_posts s join posts p on p.id = s.post_id
                 where s.action_id = a.id and p.state = 'deleted_by_author' and p.deleted_at <= a.created_at) as sealed_deleted,
               case when a.kind in ('strike', 'warn_reporting') then ${iso("a.ends_at")}
                    when a.kind = 'suspend' and a.announced is false then ${iso("(a.created_at + make_interval(days => a.days))")}
                    when a.kind = 'restrict_reporting' then ${iso("(a.starts_at + make_interval(days => a.days))")} end as ends_at,
               case when a.kind in ('suspend', 'terminate', 'restrict_reporting') then a.days end as days,
               case when a.kind in ('suspend', 'terminate', 'warn_reporting', 'restrict_reporting') then a.basis end as basis,
               -- 3e Task 5: the warning a restriction of reporting follows, by its decision's time (the one entry of rests_on).
               case when a.kind = 'restrict_reporting' then (select ${iso("x.decided_at")} from decisions x where x.id = a.rests_on[1]) end as warned_at,
               case when a.kind in ('suspend', 'terminate') then ${iso("a.starts_at")} end as earliest_start,
               -- The decisions a standing measure rests on, in the ledger's order: what korbat fixed for good about each.
               case when a.kind in ('suspend', 'terminate') and a.rests_on is not null then (
                 select json_agg(json_build_object('decidedAt', ${iso("x.decided_at")},
                                                   'ruleId', case when a.basis = 'protective' then null else x.rule_id end,
                                                   'postCreatedAt', case when a.basis = 'protective' then null else ${iso("xp.created_at")} end) order by u.ord)
                   from unnest(a.rests_on) with ordinality as u(id, ord)
                   join decisions x on x.id = u.id
                   join cases xc on xc.id = x.case_id
                   left join posts xp on xc.target_type = 'post' and xp.id = xc.target_id) end as rests_on,
               case when a.kind in ('lift_suspension', 'lift_reporting') then l.kind::text end as lifted_kind,
               case when a.kind in ('lift_suspension', 'lift_reporting') then ${iso("ld.decided_at")} end as lifted_decided_at,
               case when a.kind = 'lift_suspension' then a.replaced end as replaced,
               -- Whether the person had replied to the lifted measure before this lift: a withdrawal then says it is no answer to it.
               case when a.kind = 'lift_suspension' then (select ${iso("r.filed_at")} from suspension_replies r where r.action_id = l.id and r.filed_at <= a.created_at) end as reply_filed_at,
               -- Where the lifted measure's period stood at this lift's time: the lift cuts its end to that time, so a period
               -- that ends before it had already ended, and one with no start, or a start not before it, never started.
               ${iso("lp.starts_at")} as lifted_started_at, ${finite("lp.ends_at")} as lifted_ended_at,
               case when a.kind = 'lift_reporting' and l.kind = 'restrict_reporting'
                      then case when l.starts_at + make_interval(days => l.days) <= a.created_at then 'ended' else 'running' end
                    when a.kind <> 'lift_suspension' then null
                    when lp.starts_at is null or lp.starts_at >= a.created_at then 'not_started'
                    when lp.ends_at < a.created_at then 'ended' else 'running' end as lifted_state,
               -- 3e Task 5: a lifted restriction of reporting started with its decision and ran its days, unless lifted first.
               ${iso("l.starts_at")} as lifted_restriction_started_at, ${iso("(l.starts_at + make_interval(days => l.days))")} as lifted_restriction_ends_at,
               -- What the ledger held at the decision's time, never later: a strike that counted then, and was not overruled by then.
               case when a.kind = 'strike' then (select count(*)::int from decision_actions s
                     where s.subject_account_id = a.subject_account_id and s.kind = 'strike' and s.created_at <= a.created_at and s.ends_at > a.created_at
                       and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions r where r.reverses_action_id = s.id and r.created_at <= a.created_at)) end as active_then,
               case when a.kind in ('suspend', 'terminate') then a.announced end as announced,
               case when a.kind = 'retire_handle' then (select lower(s.handle) from evidence_snapshots s where s.id = d.snapshot_id)
                    when a.kind = 'unretire_handle' then lower(ls.handle) end as handle,
               -- The placeholder exactly as decision_actions_apply computes it, for a retirement that wrote it.
               case when a.kind = 'retire_handle' and a.no_effect is null
                    then 'retired_' || substr(encode(sha256(convert_to(a.id::text, 'UTF8')), 'hex'), 1, 12) end as placeholder
          from decision_actions a join decisions d on d.id = a.decision_id
          left join decision_actions l on l.id = a.reverses_action_id
          left join decisions ld on ld.id = l.decision_id
          left join evidence_snapshots ls on ls.id = ld.snapshot_id
          left join suspension_periods lp on a.kind = 'lift_suspension' and lp.action_id = l.id
         where a.decision_id = ${decisionId}::uuid order by a.kind, a.media_id`,
  );
  return found.map((row) => ({
    kind: row.kind as ActionKind,
    mediaId: row.media_id as string | null,
    noEffect: row.no_effect as StatementActionRow["noEffect"],
    lifted: row.lifted_decision === null ? null : { decisionId: row.lifted_decision as string, ruleId: row.lifted_rule as string | null, noEffect: row.lifted_no_effect as string | null, snapshotKept: row.lifted_snapshot_kept as boolean },
    sealedPosts: row.sealed_posts as number,
    sealedImages: row.sealed_images as number,
    sealedDeletedImages: row.sealed_deleted as number,
    endsAt: row.ends_at as string | null,
    activeThen: row.active_then as number | null,
    announced: row.announced as boolean | null,
    handle: row.handle as string | null,
    placeholder: row.placeholder as string | null,
    days: row.days as number | null,
    basis: row.basis as string | null,
    earliestStart: row.earliest_start as string | null,
    restsOn: row.rests_on as StatementActionRow["restsOn"],
    liftedKind: row.lifted_kind as StatementActionRow["liftedKind"],
    liftedDecidedAt: row.lifted_decided_at as string | null,
    periodThen:
      row.lifted_state === null
        ? null
        : row.kind === "lift_reporting"
          ? {
              // A restriction of reporting starts with its decision: it ran, or had run its days, when it was lifted.
              state: row.lifted_state as "running" | "ended",
              startedAt: row.lifted_restriction_started_at as string | null,
              endedAt: row.lifted_state === "ended" ? (row.lifted_restriction_ends_at as string | null) : null,
            }
          : {
              state: row.lifted_state as "not_started" | "running" | "ended",
              startedAt: row.lifted_state === "not_started" ? null : (row.lifted_started_at as string | null),
              endedAt: row.lifted_state === "ended" ? (row.lifted_ended_at as string | null) : null,
            },
    replaced: row.replaced as boolean | null,
    replyFiledAt: row.reply_filed_at as string | null,
    warnedAt: row.warned_at as string | null,
  }));
}

/** A measure taken while deciding that ended with a final decision, without a reversal. */
export interface EndedMeasureRow {
  kind: ActionKind;
  mediaId: string | null;
  decisionId: string;
  ruleId: string | null;
  noEffect: string | null;
  snapshotKept: boolean;
}

/**
 * The measures taken while deciding that ended with this final decision, of those their author was told of: every one
 * that was still in force when the decision closed its case, and a seal taken while deciding whose suspect items the
 * decision answered, unless the decision itself seals (the images then stay sealed). It reads only what stood when the
 * decision was made: a reversal recorded later, or an item that arrived later, changes nothing here.
 */
export async function endedMeasures(q: Runner, decisionId: string): Promise<EndedMeasureRow[]> {
  const found = await rows<Record<string, unknown>>(
    q,
    sql`select a.kind, a.media_id, i.id as decision_id, i.rule_id, a.no_effect, (s.erased_at is null or s.erased_at > d.decided_at) as snapshot_kept
          from decisions d
          join cases c on c.id = d.case_id
          join decisions i on i.case_id = d.case_id and i.kind = 'interim' and i.decided_at < d.decided_at and i.author_mail <> 'none'
          join decision_actions a on a.decision_id = i.id
          join evidence_snapshots s on s.id = i.snapshot_id
         where d.id = ${decisionId}::uuid and d.kind = 'final'
           and a.kind in ('withhold', 'seal_media', 'withhold_media', 'reset_display_name', 'reset_bio')
           and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions r where r.reverses_action_id = a.id and r.created_at <= d.decided_at)
           and case when a.kind = 'seal_media'
                 then exists (select 1 from intake_items x where x.case_id = d.case_id and x.suspect and x.answered_by = d.id and x.created_at <= i.decided_at)
                      and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions own where own.decision_id = d.id and own.kind = 'seal_media')
                 else c.closed_at = d.decided_at end
         order by i.decided_at, a.kind, a.media_id`,
  );
  return found.map((row) => ({ kind: row.kind as ActionKind, mediaId: row.media_id as string | null, decisionId: row.decision_id as string, ruleId: row.rule_id as string | null, noEffect: row.no_effect as string | null, snapshotKept: row.snapshot_kept as boolean }));
}

/** A standing measure, or a restriction of reporting, whose basis a reversal of a decision broke (3e design, sections 6.2 and 10.2). */
export interface EndedStandingRow {
  kind: "suspend" | "terminate" | "restrict_reporting";
  decidedAt: string;
  periodThen: { state: "not_started" | "running" | "ended"; startedAt: string | null; endedAt: string | null };
  seal: boolean;
  replyFiledAt: string | null;
}

/**
 * The suspensions and terminations whose basis this review or correction broke: those that name the reviewed decision in
 * rests_on and whose basis broke at this decision's time (standing_basis_broken_at answers the time of the reversal that
 * broke it, which is this decision's own). For each, where its period stood at this decision's time (the break cut its
 * end to that time), whether the basis was a seal, and the time of its reply when this decision answered it. Task 5:
 * the restrictions of reporting whose warning this decision lifted, unless a lift of their own came first; a restriction
 * starts with its decision, so it was running, or had run its days (ended), at this decision's time.
 */
export async function endedStanding(q: Runner, decisionId: string): Promise<EndedStandingRow[]> {
  const found = await rows<{ kind: EndedStandingRow["kind"]; decided_at: string; state: "not_started" | "running" | "ended"; started_at: string | null; ended_at: string | null; seal: boolean; reply_filed_at: string | null }>(
    q,
    sql`select m.kind::text as kind, ${iso("md.decided_at")} as decided_at, t.state,
               ${iso("t.started_at")} as started_at, ${finite("t.ended_at")} as ended_at,
               m.basis = 'protective' as seal,
               (select ${iso("r.filed_at")} from suspension_replies r where r.action_id = m.id and r.answered_by = d.id) as reply_filed_at
          from decisions d
          join decision_actions m on m.kind in ('suspend', 'terminate', 'restrict_reporting') and d.reviews_decision_id = any(m.rests_on)
          join decisions md on md.id = m.decision_id
          left join suspension_periods p on p.action_id = m.id
          cross join lateral (
            select case when m.kind = 'restrict_reporting'
                        then case when m.starts_at + make_interval(days => m.days) <= d.decided_at then 'ended' else 'running' end
                        when p.starts_at is null or p.starts_at >= d.decided_at then 'not_started'
                        when p.ends_at < d.decided_at then 'ended' else 'running' end as state,
                   case when m.kind = 'restrict_reporting' then m.starts_at else p.starts_at end as started_at,
                   case when m.kind = 'restrict_reporting' then m.starts_at + make_interval(days => m.days) else p.ends_at end as ended_at
          ) t
         where d.id = ${decisionId}::uuid and d.kind in ('review', 'correction')
           and public.standing_basis_broken_at(m.id) = d.decided_at
           and (m.kind <> 'restrict_reporting' or not exists (select 1 from decision_actions x where x.reverses_action_id = m.id and x.created_at < d.decided_at))
         order by md.decided_at, m.id`,
  );
  return found.map((row) => ({
    kind: row.kind,
    decidedAt: row.decided_at,
    periodThen: { state: row.state, startedAt: row.state === "not_started" ? null : row.started_at, endedAt: row.state === "ended" ? row.ended_at : null },
    seal: row.seal,
    replyFiledAt: row.reply_filed_at,
  }));
}

/** The reply a correction or a review answered by keeping or reversing its measure (3e design, section 10.2). */
export interface RepliedToRow {
  filedAt: string;
  onTime: boolean;
  kind: "suspend" | "terminate";
  days: number | null;
  periodThen: { state: "not_started" | "running" | "ended"; startedAt: string | null; endedAt: string | null };
  startsAt: string | null;
  endsAt: string | null;
  appealUntil: string;
}

/**
 * The reply this correction or review answered by keeping or reversing the measure of the decision it is about: a reply
 * to a suspension or a termination of that decision whose answering decision is this one. Never a withdrawal signed
 * `replaced` (it is no answer on the reply's merits), and never the end of a broken basis (that measure is not the
 * reviewed decision's: its reply is the reversal's endedStanding). Null when there is none.
 *
 * Each member is what the ledger fixed by this answer's time, so the statement reads as it was sent. The start: after a
 * kept answer to a reply before the start, the later of the answer and the earliest start, which nothing later moves; for
 * any other answer the period's own start, already fixed before the reply (a late reply) or never (a reversed one before
 * the start, which has no row). The end: a kept suspension's start plus its days; a reversed one's period end, which this
 * lift cut; null for a termination and for a measure that never starts. Where the period stood at this answer's time, by
 * those two. And the last moment of the announcing decision's appeal after this answer (appeal_informed_at).
 */
export async function repliedTo(q: Runner, decisionId: string): Promise<RepliedToRow | null> {
  const [row] = await rows<{
    filed_at: string;
    on_time: boolean;
    kind: "suspend" | "terminate";
    days: number | null;
    kept: boolean;
    starts_at: string | null;
    ends_at: string | null;
    started: boolean;
    ended: boolean;
    appeal_until: string;
  }>(
    q,
    sql`select ${iso("r.filed_at")} as filed_at, r.on_time, m.kind::text as kind, m.days, t.kept,
               ${iso("t.starts_at")} as starts_at, ${finite("t.ends_at")} as ends_at,
               coalesce(t.starts_at <= d.decided_at, false) as started, coalesce(t.ends_at <= d.decided_at, false) as ended,
               ${iso("public.appeal_deadline(public.appeal_informed_at(m.decision_id))")} as appeal_until
          from decisions d
          join decision_actions m on m.decision_id = d.reviews_decision_id and m.kind::text in ('suspend', 'terminate')
          join suspension_replies r on r.action_id = m.id and r.answered_by = d.id
          left join suspension_periods p on p.action_id = m.id
          cross join lateral (
            select x.kept,
                   case when x.kept and r.on_time then greatest(m.starts_at, r.answered_at) else p.starts_at end as starts_at,
                   case when m.kind::text = 'terminate' then null
                        when x.kept and r.on_time then greatest(m.starts_at, r.answered_at) + make_interval(days => m.days)
                        when x.kept then p.starts_at + make_interval(days => m.days)
                        else p.ends_at end as ends_at
              from (select not exists (select 1 from decision_actions l where l.decision_id = d.id and l.reverses_action_id = m.id) as kept) x
          ) t
         where d.id = ${decisionId}::uuid and d.kind in ('review', 'correction')
           and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions w where w.decision_id = d.id and w.kind = 'lift_suspension' and w.replaced)`,
  );
  if (!row) return null;
  const state: RepliedToRow["periodThen"]["state"] = !row.started ? "not_started" : row.ended ? "ended" : "running";
  return {
    filedAt: row.filed_at,
    onTime: row.on_time,
    kind: row.kind,
    days: row.kind === "terminate" ? null : row.days,
    periodThen: { state, startedAt: state === "not_started" ? null : row.starts_at, endedAt: state === "ended" ? row.ends_at : null },
    startsAt: row.starts_at,
    endsAt: row.ends_at,
    appealUntil: row.appeal_until,
  };
}
```

### Replace `apps/api/src/moderation/statement.ts` (whole file)

```ts
import { MEASURES, type DecisionStatement, type MeasureKind, type ReversalKind, type RuleId, type StandingBasis } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { statementParagraphs } from "@korbat/rules";
import type { DecisionMessage } from "../auth";
import type { ModerationDeps } from "./context";
import { beginMailRecord, lockPendingAuthorMail, recordAuthorMail, standingWithdrawn, type MailState } from "./repo";
import { endedMeasures, endedStanding, repliedTo, statementActions, statementDecision, type StatementDecisionRow } from "./statement-repo";

/**
 * The data a statement of reasons and its mail are rendered from (3c design, sections 7.5 and 10). A decision is the
 * statement: every element is a column, a ledger row or a saved text, read here into the one shape that @korbat/rules
 * renders for the mail, the author's screen and the console's preview. Nothing read here is changed by a later event, so
 * a statement reads as it was sent whenever it is rendered.
 */

/** A decision's statement with what mailing it needs: whom it is about, and whether its mail is still owed. */
export interface StatementFound {
  statement: DecisionStatement;
  decision: StatementDecisionRow;
}

/** Whether a field reset's old value was still kept when the decision that ends or lifts it was made, and where it can be read. */
function resetFacts(kind: MeasureKind | ReversalKind, held: { decisionId: string; ruleId: string | null; noEffect: string | null; snapshotKept: boolean }) {
  const target = MEASURES[kind].target;
  if (target !== "display_name" && target !== "bio") return { resetDecisionId: null, oldValueKept: false, resetRuleId: null };
  // The reset's own snapshot holds the old value, by its compare-and-set; a reset that changed nothing removed none.
  return { resetDecisionId: held.decisionId, oldValueKept: held.noEffect === null && held.snapshotKept, resetRuleId: held.ruleId as RuleId | null };
}

/** The statement's data of one decision, or null when no decision has the id. */
export async function decisionStatement(q: ModerationDeps["apiDb"], decisionId: string): Promise<StatementFound | null> {
  const decision = await statementDecision(q, decisionId);
  if (!decision) return null;
  const actions = await statementActions(q, decisionId);
  const ended = decision.kind === "final" ? await endedMeasures(q, decisionId) : [];
  // 3e: the standing measures whose basis a reversal of this decision broke; absent from a statement that holds none.
  const brokenBasis = decision.kind === "review" || decision.kind === "correction" ? await endedStanding(q, decisionId) : [];
  // 3e Task 4: the reply this correction or review answered by keeping or reversing its measure; absent when none.
  const replied = decision.kind === "review" || decision.kind === "correction" ? await repliedTo(q, decisionId) : null;
  // The facts and the reason are told with a decision that restricts (it holds a measure), with a correction and with a
  // review. Those of a decision without a measure are the case's record, for staff: such a decision tells its author at
  // most that what korbat did while deciding has ended, so the statement's data holds neither, and no mail, screen or
  // export that is rendered from it can carry them.
  const told = decision.kind === "correction" || decision.kind === "review" || actions.some((action) => MEASURES[action.kind].lifts === null);
  const statement: DecisionStatement = {
    kind: decision.kind,
    outcome: decision.outcome as DecisionStatement["outcome"],
    ground: decision.ground as DecisionStatement["ground"],
    ruleId: decision.ruleId as RuleId | null,
    rulesVersion: decision.rulesVersion,
    redressVersion: decision.redressVersion,
    legalReference: decision.legalReference,
    facts: told ? decision.facts : null,
    reason: told ? decision.reason : null,
    source: decision.source as DecisionStatement["source"],
    decidedAt: decision.decidedAt,
    post: decision.targetType === "post" && decision.postCreatedAt !== null ? { id: decision.targetId, createdAt: decision.postCreatedAt } : null,
    measures: actions
      .filter((action) => MEASURES[action.kind].lifts === null)
      .map((action) => ({
        kind: action.kind as MeasureKind,
        mediaId: action.mediaId,
        noEffect: action.noEffect,
        sealed: action.kind === "seal_media" ? { posts: action.sealedPosts, images: action.sealedImages, deletedImages: action.sealedDeletedImages } : null,
        // 3e: what the ledger fixed for good about a strike, a standing measure and a retirement, so its statement reads as
        // it was sent (a retirement's sentence reads its end from whether the decision suspends or terminates at once).
        ...(action.kind === "strike" ? { endsAt: action.endsAt, activeThen: action.activeThen } : {}),
        ...(action.kind === "suspend" || action.kind === "terminate"
          ? {
              announced: action.announced,
              days: action.days,
              basis: action.basis as StandingBasis | null,
              earliestStart: action.earliestStart,
              endsAt: action.endsAt,
              restsOn: action.restsOn === null ? null : action.restsOn.map((entry) => ({ ...entry, ruleId: entry.ruleId as RuleId | null })),
            }
          : {}),
        ...(action.kind === "retire_handle" ? { handle: action.handle, placeholder: action.placeholder } : {}),
        // 3e Task 5: a warning's end of counting; a restriction's days, its end and the warning it follows.
        ...(action.kind === "warn_reporting" ? { basis: action.basis as StandingBasis | null, endsAt: action.endsAt } : {}),
        ...(action.kind === "restrict_reporting" ? { basis: action.basis as StandingBasis | null, days: action.days, endsAt: action.endsAt, warnedAt: action.warnedAt } : {}),
      })),
    reversals: actions
      .filter((action) => MEASURES[action.kind].lifts !== null)
      .map((action) => ({
        kind: action.kind as ReversalKind,
        mediaId: action.mediaId,
        ...(action.lifted === null ? { resetDecisionId: null, oldValueKept: false, resetRuleId: null } : resetFacts(action.kind, action.lifted)),
        // 3e: the handle a reversal of a retirement gives back.
        ...(action.kind === "unretire_handle" ? { handle: action.handle } : {}),
        // 3e: what a lift of a suspension lifted, where its period stood then, and whether it was a withdrawal for another measure.
        ...(action.kind === "lift_suspension"
          ? { liftedKind: action.liftedKind, liftedDecidedAt: action.liftedDecidedAt, periodThen: action.periodThen, replaced: action.replaced, replyFiledAt: action.replyFiledAt }
          : {}),
        // 3e Task 5: what a lift of a reporting measure lifted, and for a restriction whether its days still ran.
        ...(action.kind === "lift_reporting" ? { liftedKind: action.liftedKind, liftedDecidedAt: action.liftedDecidedAt, periodThen: action.periodThen } : {}),
      })),
    endedMeasures: ended.map((measure) => ({ kind: measure.kind as MeasureKind, mediaId: measure.mediaId, ...resetFacts(measure.kind, measure) })),
    ...(brokenBasis.length > 0 ? { endedStanding: brokenBasis } : {}),
    ...(replied !== null ? { repliedTo: replied } : {}),
    reviewed:
      decision.reviewed === null
        ? null
        : {
            kind: decision.reviewed.kind,
            ground: decision.reviewed.ground as DecisionStatement["ground"],
            ruleId: decision.reviewed.ruleId as RuleId | null,
            // The reviewed decision's own rulebook version: its rule is rendered as it was worded when that decision was made.
            rulesVersion: decision.reviewed.rulesVersion,
            legalReference: decision.reviewed.legalReference,
            decidedAt: decision.reviewed.decidedAt,
            // 3e's review (people1): a measure on the terms is answered on the terms, never on the rule its decision cited.
            basis: decision.reviewed.basis as StandingBasis | null,
          },
  };
  return { statement, decision };
}

/**
 * The subject of the statement's mail, by the decision's kind and outcome (3c design, section 7.15), as a key of the mail
 * template's own table: a seal first, whatever else the decision holds; then a decision taken while deciding, on a post
 * or on an account; a final restriction; a final decision that restricts nothing but ends or lifts what was done while
 * deciding, and a correction of a decision taken while deciding; a reversal of a final decision; and a kept appeal.
 */
export function mailSubjectOf(statement: DecisionStatement): Extract<DecisionMessage, { template: "moderation_decision" }>["subject"] {
  const seals = statement.measures.some((measure) => measure.kind === "seal_media");
  const post = statement.post !== null;
  if (statement.kind === "interim") return seals ? "seal_deciding" : post ? "post_deciding" : "profile_deciding";
  if (statement.kind === "final") {
    if (seals) return "seal_final";
    if (statement.outcome === "restricted") return post ? "post_restricted" : "profile_restricted";
    return "lifted_deciding";
  }
  if (statement.kind === "correction") return statement.reviewed?.kind === "interim" ? "lifted_deciding" : "reversed";
  return statement.outcome === "kept" ? "appeal_kept" : "reversed";
}

/**
 * The template a decision's statement is mailed under (3e design, sections 7.15 and 18, W.6): the first row of 7.15's
 * table that fits, and moderation_decision otherwise, so that a strike, a retirement and their reversals ride on 3c's
 * mail. In order: an announced suspension or termination; one taken at once; the answer to a reply (a statement with
 * `repliedTo`); a lift of one (a withdrawal signed `replaced` under its own lead), or a decision whose reversal ended one by
 * breaking its basis; a final warning about reporting; a final restriction of reporting. A lift of a reporting measure,
 * also one that ends a restriction with its warning, rides on moderation_decision.
 */
export function mailTemplateOf(statement: DecisionStatement, paragraphs: readonly string[]): DecisionMessage {
  const standing = statement.measures.find((measure) => measure.kind === "suspend" || measure.kind === "terminate");
  if (statement.kind === "final" && standing !== undefined && standing.announced === true) {
    const measure = standing.kind === "terminate" ? "terminate" : "suspend";
    if (standing.earliestStart === undefined || standing.earliestStart === null) throw new Error("an announced measure's mail names its earliest start: the statement's data holds none");
    // The window is the row's own: its earliest start less its decision's time, in hours.
    const window = Math.round((Date.parse(standing.earliestStart) - Date.parse(statement.decidedAt)) / 3_600_000);
    return { template: "suspension_announced", measure, days: measure === "terminate" ? null : (standing.days ?? null), window, earliestStart: standing.earliestStart, paragraphs };
  }
  if (statement.kind === "final" && standing !== undefined && standing.announced === false) {
    const measure = standing.kind === "terminate" ? "terminate" : "suspend";
    return { template: "suspension_started_at_once", measure, days: standing.days ?? null, endsAt: standing.endsAt ?? null, paragraphs };
  }
  const lift = statement.reversals.find((reversal) => reversal.kind === "lift_suspension");
  if (statement.repliedTo !== undefined) {
    // A review that reverses part but leaves the measure in force answers the reply as a kept answer does.
    const lifted = lift !== undefined && lift.replaced !== true;
    return { template: "reply_answered", outcome: lifted ? "reversed" : "kept", paragraphs };
  }
  if ((statement.kind === "review" || statement.kind === "correction") && lift !== undefined && lift.replaced === true && lift.liftedDecidedAt) {
    return {
      template: "suspension_lifted",
      measure: lift.liftedKind === "terminate" ? "terminate" : "suspend",
      why: "replaced",
      decidedAt: lift.liftedDecidedAt,
      replied: lift.replyFiledAt !== undefined && lift.replyFiledAt !== null,
      paragraphs,
    };
  }
  if ((statement.kind === "review" || statement.kind === "correction") && lift !== undefined && lift.periodThen) {
    return { template: "suspension_lifted", measure: lift.liftedKind === "terminate" ? "terminate" : "suspend", why: "lifted", period: lift.periodThen.state, paragraphs };
  }
  const broken = (statement.endedStanding ?? []).find((entry) => entry.kind === "suspend" || entry.kind === "terminate");
  if (broken !== undefined) return { template: "suspension_lifted", measure: broken.kind === "terminate" ? "terminate" : "suspend", why: "basis", period: broken.periodThen.state, paragraphs };
  if (statement.kind === "final" && statement.measures.some((measure) => measure.kind === "warn_reporting")) return { template: "reporting_warned", paragraphs };
  const restriction = statement.measures.find((measure) => measure.kind === "restrict_reporting");
  if (statement.kind === "final" && restriction !== undefined) {
    if (typeof restriction.days !== "number" || typeof restriction.endsAt !== "string") throw new Error("a restriction of reporting's mail names its days and its end: the statement's data holds neither");
    return { template: "reporting_restricted", days: restriction.days, endsAt: restriction.endsAt, paragraphs };
  }
  return { template: "moderation_decision", subject: mailSubjectOf(statement), paragraphs };
}

/**
 * Mails a decision's statement to its author when that mail is still owed, and records what became of it: `sent`,
 * `no_address` for an account that is gone, `failed` when the relay refused the address for good. A failure of the relay
 * is thrown, and the mail stays pending for the dispatch job. Answers what was recorded, or "none" when nothing was owed.
 *
 * The decision's row is taken before the mail is sent, in the transaction that records the result (beginMailRecord): a
 * database that cannot write refuses that, and nothing is sent, so a mail is never sent again and again for want of a
 * record. Two senders of one statement (the decision's own request and the dispatch job) then send it once: the second
 * waits for the row and finds the mail recorded.
 *
 * 3e (design, section 5, the lock order, item 4): for a decision that holds an announced suspension or termination, the
 * outcome fixes the measure's start (the database's decisions_mail_standing derives the profile's columns), so the
 * transaction takes the subject's profile FOR NO KEY UPDATE before it records the outcome. It takes it right before the
 * record and after the send (3e's review, database3): a profile held across a relay that stalls would hold every write of
 * the account and every follow of it, and the decisions about it, for as long as the relay. The decision's row comes first
 * then, which no deciding transaction waits for: a decision about the account takes the decisions it answers FOR KEY SHARE
 * only, through its foreign key, and the take-down, the only transaction that takes a profile and then a decision's row
 * FOR UPDATE, takes only a termination whose period has started, which a notice still owed never gives.
 *
 * A statement whose suspension or termination a later decision has lifted, or whose basis a reversal has broken, while
 * its mail was owed (3e's review, proofs1) is recorded failed and never sent: it would name a start and invite a reply
 * that no longer exist. The check is a statement of its own after the decision's row is held, so it sees every lift that
 * committed before; the measure, lifted, fixes no start whatever is recorded.
 */
export async function sendStatement(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb" | "auth" | "social">, decisionId: string): Promise<MailState | "none"> {
  const found = await decisionStatement(deps.apiDb, decisionId);
  if (!found || found.decision.authorMail !== "pending") return "none";
  const subject = found.decision.subjectId;
  // The statement is rendered before anything is sent: one that cannot be rendered is no mail, and stays pending.
  const message = mailTemplateOf(found.statement, statementParagraphs(found.statement));
  const standing = found.statement.kind === "final" && found.statement.measures.some((measure) => measure.kind === "suspend" || measure.kind === "terminate");
  const announced = standing && found.statement.measures.some((measure) => (measure.kind === "suspend" || measure.kind === "terminate") && measure.announced === true);
  return deps.apiDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
    await beginMailRecord(tx);
    if (!(await lockPendingAuthorMail(tx, decisionId))) return "none";
    let state: MailState;
    if (standing && (await standingWithdrawn(tx, decisionId))) state = "failed";
    else {
      const result = subject === null ? "no_address" : await deps.auth.mailAccount(subject, message);
      // A stop of the address never holds a statement back, so "suppressed" is never answered for it.
      state = result === "sent" ? "sent" : result === "refused" ? "failed" : "no_address";
    }
    if (announced && subject !== null) await deps.social.lockAccounts(tx, [subject], "no key update");
    await recordAuthorMail(tx, decisionId, state);
    return state;
  });
}
```

```ts
import { and, eq, isNotNull, sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { handleHistory, profiles, type Db } from "@korbat/db";
import { handleRefusal, isUniqueViolation, type ProfileStore } from "../auth";
import { WRITE_CLOCK, liveNotSuspended } from "../lib/standing";

/**
 * Public profiles through the korbat_api pool. Onboarding writes the profile and the reservation of
 * its handle in one transaction; the unique index on lower(handle) and the primary key of
 * handle_history decide races and refuse a handle another profile holds or ever held. A handle korbat retired (3e) is
 * refused first, in the same transaction, with its own answer; the database's guard of handles refuses the same, and a
 * placeholder's form, under a race or to a caller that skipped the handle rule, and is answered alike.
 */
export function createProfileStore(apiDb: Db): ProfileStore {
  const columns = { id: profiles.id, handle: profiles.handle, displayName: profiles.displayName };
  return {
    async create({ id, handle, displayName }) {
      try {
        const profile = await apiDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
          // 3e: a retired handle is nobody's, so it is refused before the unique index would call it taken.
          const [retired] = await tx
            .select({ handle: handleHistory.handleLower })
            .from(handleHistory)
            .where(and(eq(handleHistory.handleLower, handle.toLowerCase()), isNotNull(handleHistory.retiredAt)))
            .limit(1);
          if (retired) return null;
          const [created] = await tx.insert(profiles).values({ id, handle, displayName }).returning(columns);
          // The handle chosen at onboarding is reserved like every later one (1b design, section 6); a row for it under another profile ends the transaction.
          await tx.insert(handleHistory).values({ handleLower: handle.toLowerCase(), profileId: id });
          return created!;
        });
        return profile === null ? { ok: false, reason: "handle_retired" } : { ok: true, profile };
      } catch (err) {
        const guarded = handleRefusal(err);
        if (guarded !== null) return { ok: false, reason: guarded };
        if (isUniqueViolation(err)) return { ok: false, reason: "handle_taken" };
        throw err;
      }
    },
    async find(id) {
      const [profile] = await apiDb
        .select({ ...columns, handleChangedAt: profiles.handleChangedAt, verifiedAt: profiles.verifiedAt, showInExplore: profiles.showInExplore })
        .from(profiles)
        .where(eq(profiles.id, id))
        .limit(1);
      if (!profile) return null;
      const { handleChangedAt, verifiedAt, showInExplore, ...pub } = profile;
      // The badge is a fact of the profile row (verified_at), read here so the account screen sees it on /me; so is the
      // author's Explore switch, which the privacy screen shows and the public profile never carries.
      return { ...pub, handleChangedAt: handleChangedAt?.toISOString() ?? null, verified: verifiedAt !== null, showInExplore };
    },
    /**
     * The badge, profiles.verified_at, which the auth module decides and cannot write. 3e (design, section 7.2): setting it
     * is a write of the account, so the one predicate joins the update's WHERE and the answer says whether a row changed;
     * removing it is open to everyone, and answers true. Setting it locks the row first, in a statement of its own, so the
     * UPDATE that judges comes once the row is held: an UPDATE that waited for a holder that only locked the row would
     * keep the judgment it made before the wait. It is the write's last statement, and so its closing judgment (3e's review).
     */
    async setVerified(id, at) {
      if (at === null) {
        await apiDb.update(profiles).set({ verifiedAt: null }).where(eq(profiles.id, id));
        return true;
      }
      return apiDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
        await tx.execute(sql`select 1 from profiles where id = ${id}::uuid for no key update`);
        const updated = await tx.update(profiles).set({ verifiedAt: at }).where(and(eq(profiles.id, id), liveNotSuspended("profiles", WRITE_CLOCK))).returning({ id: profiles.id });
        return updated.length === 1;
      });
    },
    /** A plain read of the same fact, which startBadge asks first as a courtesy, so that no code is sent to a suspended account; the write decides. */
    async suspended(id) {
      const [row] = (await apiDb.execute(sql`select not ${liveNotSuspended("p", WRITE_CLOCK)} as suspended from profiles p where p.id = ${id}::uuid and p.deleted_at is null`)) as unknown as { suspended: boolean }[];
      return row?.suspended ?? false;
    },
  };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Every SQL statement of the social module, through the korbat_api pool.
 *
 * Two rules keep the counters and the pagination exact:
 * - every counter changes in the same transaction as the action, by the number of rows the action

 *   default, so a keyset cursor built from a row round-trips exactly.

 * only visible posts, the author also sees their own withheld and removed posts, a block in either
 * direction hides an author entirely, and mutes apply to timelines only.

/** A timestamptz expression as ISO text with milliseconds, in UTC. The expression is a column reference written here, never input. */
const iso = (column: string): SQL => sql.raw(`to_char(${column} at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"')`);

/** The same with the microseconds a timestamp column holds, for the export's page keys, which must round-trip exactly. */
const isoMicro = (column: string): SQL => sql.raw(`to_char(${column} at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"')`);

/** Rows after `after` in (created_at, id) order: the keyset condition of an export page. Always true for the first page. */
const exportAfter = (after: ExportKey | null, at: SQL, id: SQL): SQL => (after ? sql`(${at}, ${id}) > (${after.at}::timestamptz, ${after.id}::uuid)` : sql`true`);

/** The page a query answered, with its next key when the page is full (a full page may be followed by more). */
function exportPage<R extends { key_at: string; key_id: string }, T>(raw: R[], limit: number, map: (row: R) => T): ExportPage<T> {
  const last = raw.at(-1);
  return { rows: raw.map(map), next: raw.length === limit && last ? { at: last.key_at, id: last.key_id } : null };
}

  replyToHandle: r.reply_to_handle,

const toListRow = (r: RawListRow): ListRow => ({ postId: r.post_id, sortAt: new Date(r.sort_at), reposterId: r.reposter_id });

/** `p` is the posts alias in every read below. */
const visibleTo = (viewer: string | null): SQL =>
  viewer === null
    ? sql`p.state = 'visible'`
    : sql`(p.state = 'visible' or (p.author_id = ${viewer}::uuid and p.state in ('withheld', 'removed')))`;

/** No block in either direction between the viewer and the author of `p`. */
const authorNotBlocked = (viewer: string | null): SQL =>
  viewer === null
    ? sql`true`
    : sql`not exists (select 1 from blocks b where (b.blocker_id = ${viewer}::uuid and b.blocked_id = p.author_id) or (b.blocked_id = ${viewer}::uuid and b.blocker_id = p.author_id))`;

/** No block in either direction with the author or the reposter of a timeline item `i`. */
const itemNotBlocked = (viewer: string | null): SQL =>
  viewer === null
    ? sql`true`
    : sql`not exists (select 1 from blocks b where (b.blocker_id = ${viewer}::uuid and b.blocked_id in (i.author_id, i.reposter_id)) or (b.blocked_id = ${viewer}::uuid and b.blocker_id in (i.author_id, i.reposter_id)))`;

const itemNotMuted = (viewer: string | null): SQL =>
  viewer === null ? sql`true` : sql`not exists (select 1 from mutes m where m.muter_id = ${viewer}::uuid and m.muted_id in (i.author_id, i.reposter_id))`;

/** Raw queries take timestamps as ISO text, never as Date objects. */
const at = (cursor: Cursor): string => new Date(cursor.t).toISOString();

const before = (cursor: Cursor | undefined, sortAt: SQL, id: SQL): SQL =>
  cursor ? sql`(${sortAt}, ${id}) < (${at(cursor)}::timestamptz, ${cursor.id}::uuid)` : sql`true`;

const after = (cursor: Cursor | undefined, sortAt: SQL, id: SQL): SQL =>
  cursor ? sql`(${sortAt}, ${id}) > (${at(cursor)}::timestamptz, ${cursor.id}::uuid)` : sql`true`;

const beforeItem = (cursor: Cursor | undefined): SQL =>
  cursor
    ? sql`(i.sort_at, i.post_id, coalesce(i.reposter_id, ${NO_REPOSTER}::uuid)) < (${at(cursor)}::timestamptz, ${cursor.id}::uuid, ${cursor.r ?? NO_REPOSTER}::uuid)`
    : sql`true`;

const POST_COLUMNS = sql`p.id, p.author_id, p.body, p.reply_to_id, p.quote_of_id, p.state, p.like_count, p.repost_count, p.reply_count, p.quote_count,
  ${iso("p.created_at")} as created_at, ${iso("p.deleted_at")} as deleted_at,
  a.handle as author_handle, a.display_name as author_display_name, (a.verified_at is not null) as author_verified,
  rp.handle as reply_to_handle, pp.author_id as reply_to_author_id, pp.state as reply_to_state`;
const POST_JOINS = sql`from posts p join profiles a on a.id = p.author_id left join posts pp on pp.id = p.reply_to_id left join profiles rp on rp.id = pp.author_id`;
const PROFILE_COLUMNS = sql`id, handle, display_name, bio, (verified_at is not null) as verified, follower_count, following_count, post_count, ${iso("created_at")} as created_at, ${iso("handle_changed_at")} as handle_changed_at`;
const PROFILE_SELECT = sql`select ${PROFILE_COLUMNS} from profiles`;

/** No block in either direction between the viewer and the account `other` names (a column reference). */
const otherNotBlocked = (viewer: string | null, other: SQL): SQL =>
  viewer === null
    ? sql`true`
    : sql`not exists (select 1 from blocks b where (b.blocker_id = ${viewer}::uuid and b.blocked_id = ${other}) or (b.blocked_id = ${viewer}::uuid and b.blocker_id = ${other}))`;

/** The viewer neither blocks, is blocked by, nor mutes the account `other` names. */
const otherWelcome = (viewer: string, other: SQL): SQL =>
  sql`${otherNotBlocked(viewer, other)} and not exists (select 1 from mutes m where m.muter_id = ${viewer}::uuid and m.muted_id = ${other})`;

/** A keyset bound on the three sort columns of a timeline branch. */
const beforeTriple = (cursor: Cursor | undefined, sortAt: SQL, id: SQL, reposter: SQL): SQL =>
  cursor ? sql`(${sortAt}, ${id}, ${reposter}) < (${at(cursor)}::timestamptz, ${cursor.id}::uuid, ${cursor.r ?? NO_REPOSTER}::uuid)` : sql`true`;

/** The outer select of a list query whose inner query `i` carries post_id, sort_at and reposter_id. */
const LIST_COLUMNS = sql`i.post_id, ${iso("i.sort_at")} as sort_at, i.reposter_id`;

/** Durations built in SQL from the formula's numbers, so each number travels as a parameter. */
const hours = (n: number): SQL => sql`(${n}::float8 * interval '1 hour')`;
const minutes = (n: number): SQL => sql`(${n}::float8 * interval '1 minute')`;

/** The one version of the Explore formula whose rules exploreRules writes (3e design, section 7.13). */
const EXPLORE_RULES_VERSION = 2;

/**
 * The time Explore's reads (the page, the chip and the author's status) judge an author's suspension by (3e design,
 * section 7.13 item 6): the database's clock when the statement reads, the same clock a write is judged by. A round
 * judges by its own time instead (exploreRules).
 */
const READ_CLOCK = WRITE_CLOCK;

/**
 * The rules of one Explore formula as of one time (2c design, section 7; 3e design, section 7.13: version 2), as SQL
 * fragments. The refresh ranks with them and the author's status judges one post with them, so the two cannot disagree;
 * the time and every number of the formula travel as parameters. `post` narrows the candidates and the engagement to one
 * post, which the status reads through that post's own indexes; the rules are the same either way. A formula of any
 * other version throws here, before any SQL, so no ranking is stored under a version whose rules were not applied.
 *
 * Version 2's two rules: an account suspended at the time `asOf` (the round's own time, never the clock) is neither a
 * candidate's author nor an engager, by the one predicate of lib/standing.ts applied to rows the round only reads; and a
 * post's window and age count from coalesce(explore_from, created_at), its `starts_at`, where explore_from is created_at
 * plus every span moderation kept the post hidden, which the database's moderation_apply alone writes.
 */
function exploreRules(asOf: Date, formula: ExploreFormula) {
  if (formula.version !== EXPLORE_RULES_VERSION) {
    throw new Error(`Explore's round applies the rules of formula version ${EXPLORE_RULES_VERSION} only, not version ${formula.version}`);
  }
  const at = sql`${asOf.toISOString()}::timestamptz`;
  // A candidate is younger than the window, and only engagement inside the window counts.
  const since = sql`${at} - ${hours(formula.windowHours)}`;
  // Engagement counts once it has stood this long, so a like made just before a round and undone after it never counts.
  const settled = sql`${at} - ${minutes(formula.standingMinutes)}`;
  const onePost = (column: SQL, post?: string): SQL => (post ? sql` and ${column} = ${post}::uuid` : sql.empty());
  /**
   * The one candidate predicate: visible top-level posts that are not quotes, by authors who are live and not suspended
   * at the time and have not switched Explore off, whose starts_at lies in the window up to the time. The window test is
   * written in two arms so that each uses its own index: a post never given back its time by its created_at, a restored
   * one by its explore_from (a partial index holds only those). Later rules about imports belong here.
   */
  const candidates = (post?: string): SQL => sql`
    select p.id, p.author_id, coalesce(p.explore_from, p.created_at) as starts_at from posts p join profiles a on a.id = p.author_id
    where p.reply_to_id is null and p.quote_of_id is null and p.state = 'visible'
      and ((p.explore_from is null and p.created_at > ${since} and p.created_at <= ${at}) or (p.explore_from > ${since} and p.explore_from <= ${at}))
      and ${liveNotSuspended("a", at)} and a.show_in_explore${onePost(sql`p.id`, post)}`;
  /**
   * The engagement that counts, read from the candidates `c`: likes and reposts in the window that have stood long enough,
   * by accounts other than the author that are live and not suspended at the time and were old enough when they engaged.
   * The engager is judged at the round, never at the time of the like: a ring's earlier likes stop counting at once.
   */
  const engagement = (post?: string): SQL => sql`
    select x.post_id, x.user_id from (
      select post_id, user_id, created_at from likes where created_at > ${since} and created_at <= ${settled}${onePost(sql`post_id`, post)}
      union all
      select post_id, user_id, created_at from reposts where created_at > ${since} and created_at <= ${settled}${onePost(sql`post_id`, post)}
    ) x
    join c on c.id = x.post_id
    join profiles u on u.id = x.user_id
    where x.user_id <> c.author_id and ${liveNotSuspended("u", at)} and u.created_at <= x.created_at - ${hours(formula.engagerMinAgeHours)}`;
  /** The approving accounts per post, read from the engagement `e`: each counted once however it engaged, for the posts that reach the threshold. */
  const approvers = sql`select post_id, count(distinct user_id)::int as approvers from e group by post_id having count(distinct user_id) >= ${formula.threshold}`;
  return {
    at,
    since,
    candidates,
    engagement,
    approvers,
    /**
     * Whether `post` is a candidate that reaches the threshold: the three fragments as the CTEs c, e and ap of a subquery
     * of their own, so one statement can ask at two times.
     */
    met: (post: string): SQL => sql`exists (with c as (${candidates(post)}), e as (${engagement(post)}), ap as (${approvers}) select 1 from ap)`,
  };
}

export function createSocialRepo(db: Db) {
  const rows = async <T>(query: SQL): Promise<T[]> => (await db.execute(query)) as unknown as T[];

  const bump = (column: SQLWrapper, delta: 1 | -1): SQL => (delta === 1 ? sql`${column} + 1` : sql`greatest(0, ${column} - 1)`);

  const profileList = async (query: SQL): Promise<ProfileListRow[]> => (await rows<RawProfileListRow>(query)).map(toProfileListRow);

  return {
    // ------------------------------------------------------------ posts

    /**
     * `within` runs in the same transaction once the post exists, which is how its images are attached.
     * `lockWith` names the author of the post replied to or quoted: the pair is locked and a block
     * between them refused inside the transaction, so a reply cannot land across a concurrent block.
     * The author's profile row is locked and a deleted one refused (not_found), and so is the row of the
     * author of the post replied to or quoted (post_unavailable, as for a post that is gone), so no post
     * lands behind a concurrent purge of either account (lockLive). 3e (design, section 5, the lock order, item 2): the
     * author's row is taken in its own statement, FOR NO KEY UPDATE when its post counter will change (a post or a quote)
     * and FOR KEY SHARE for a reply, with the one predicate on it (account_suspended); the other author's row FOR KEY
     * SHARE: those two modes never wait for each other. A post that both replies and quotes writes two
     * other posts' counters: their rows are taken first, in id order, the order in which a report takes the posts it
     * copies (3c design, section 2, Lock order), so the new post never holds one of them while it waits for the other.
     * The transaction ends with the closing judgment of the author (judgeActing), after `within`: a post that waited at
     * the other author's row, the parent's counter or a foreign key commits only if the author's suspension still has not
     * started.
     */
    async createPost(input: {
      authorId: string;
      body: string;
      replyToId: string | null;
      quoteOfId: string | null;
      now: Date;
      lockWith?: string | null;
      within?: (tx: DbTx, postId: string) => Promise<void>;
    }): Promise<string> {
      return db.transaction(async (tx) => {
        if (input.lockWith) await guardPair(tx, input.authorId, input.lockWith, "post_unavailable");
        await lockActing(tx, input.authorId, input.replyToId ? "key share" : "no key update");
        if (input.replyToId || input.quoteOfId) {
          await lockLive(tx, sql`id in (select author_id from posts where id in (${input.replyToId}::uuid, ${input.quoteOfId}::uuid))`, "post_unavailable");
        }
        if (input.replyToId && input.quoteOfId) await lockPostsInOrder(tx, [input.replyToId, input.quoteOfId]);
        const [row] = await tx
          .insert(posts)
          .values({ authorId: input.authorId, body: input.body, replyToId: input.replyToId, quoteOfId: input.quoteOfId, createdAt: input.now })
          .returning({ id: posts.id });
        if (input.replyToId) {
          await tx.update(posts).set({ replyCount: bump(posts.replyCount, 1) }).where(eq(posts.id, input.replyToId));
        } else {
          await tx.update(profiles).set({ postCount: bump(profiles.postCount, 1) }).where(eq(profiles.id, input.authorId));
        }
        if (input.quoteOfId) await tx.update(posts).set({ quoteCount: bump(posts.quoteCount, 1) }).where(eq(posts.id, input.quoteOfId));
        await input.within?.(tx, row!.id);
        await judgeActing(tx, input.authorId);
        return row!.id;
      });
    },

    /**
     * Blanks the body and marks the post deleted; adjusts the counters it contributed to. False when there was nothing to
     * delete. `within` runs in the same transaction. The author's profile row is taken first, in the mode the counter
     * update below needs: a decision about the author holds that row before it takes the post, so a deletion that took
     * the post first and the profile second would deadlock with it, and one that takes the profile first waits its turn.
     * Then every post this transaction writes is taken, in id order, before any is written: the post itself and the post
     * it replies to or quotes, whose counter goes down. A report takes the posts it copies for share in that order (3c
     * design, section 2, Lock order), and one of child sexual abuse material about a quoting post reaches the quoted post
     * by itself: a deletion that wrote its own post first and then asked for a quoted post with a lower id would hold
     * what that report asks for next while it waits for what the report holds. The two ids never change, so a plain read
     * names the right rows; only the author's own post is read, so nobody else's request locks anything here.
     */
    async deletePost(id: string, authorId: string, now: Date, within?: (tx: DbTx) => Promise<void>): Promise<boolean> {
      return db.transaction(async (tx) => {
        await tx.execute(sql`select 1 from profiles where id = ${authorId}::uuid for no key update`);
        const [own] = (await tx.execute(sql`select reply_to_id, quote_of_id from posts where id = ${id}::uuid and author_id = ${authorId}::uuid`)) as unknown as {
          reply_to_id: string | null;
          quote_of_id: string | null;
        }[];
        if (!own) return false;
        await lockPostsInOrder(tx, [id, own.reply_to_id, own.quote_of_id]);
        const [old] = await tx
          .update(posts)
          .set({ state: "deleted_by_author", deletedAt: now, body: "" })
          .where(and(eq(posts.id, id), eq(posts.authorId, authorId), ne(posts.state, "deleted_by_author")))
          .returning({ replyToId: posts.replyToId, quoteOfId: posts.quoteOfId });
        if (!old) return false;
        if (old.replyToId) {
          await tx.update(posts).set({ replyCount: bump(posts.replyCount, -1) }).where(eq(posts.id, old.replyToId));
        } else {
          await tx.update(profiles).set({ postCount: bump(profiles.postCount, -1) }).where(eq(profiles.id, authorId));
        }
        if (old.quoteOfId) await tx.update(posts).set({ quoteCount: bump(posts.quoteCount, -1) }).where(eq(posts.id, old.quoteOfId));
        await within?.(tx);
        return true;
      });
    },

    /** Posts by id with their author and the handle they reply to, in no particular order. Includes deleted and hidden posts; callers apply visibility. */
    async findPosts(ids: string[]): Promise<Map<string, PostRow>> {
      if (ids.length === 0) return new Map();
      const raw = await rows<RawPost>(sql`select ${POST_COLUMNS} ${POST_JOINS} where p.id = any(${uuidArray(ids)})`);
      return new Map(raw.map((r) => [r.id, toPost(r)]));
    },

    /** Ids of the reply chain above a post, root first, at most MAX_ANCESTORS long. */
    async ancestorIds(postId: string): Promise<string[]> {
      const raw = await rows<{ id: string }>(sql`
        with recursive chain as (
          select p.id, p.reply_to_id, 1 as depth from posts p where p.id = (select reply_to_id from posts where id = ${postId}::uuid)
          union all
          select p.id, p.reply_to_id, c.depth + 1 from posts p join chain c on p.id = c.reply_to_id where c.depth < ${MAX_ANCESTORS}
        )
        select id from chain order by depth desc`);
      return raw.map((r) => r.id);
    },

    /** Direct replies visible to the viewer, oldest first. */
    async replies(postId: string, viewer: string | null, cursor: Cursor | undefined, limit: number): Promise<ListRow[]> {
      const raw = await rows<RawListRow>(sql`
        select p.id as post_id, ${iso("p.created_at")} as sort_at, null::uuid as reposter_id from posts p
        where p.reply_to_id = ${postId}::uuid and ${visibleTo(viewer)} and ${authorNotBlocked(viewer)} and ${after(cursor, sql`p.created_at`, sql`p.id`)}
        order by p.created_at asc, p.id asc limit ${limit}`);
      return raw.map(toListRow);
    },

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ engagement

    /**
     * `other` is the post's author when that is someone else: the pair is locked and a block refused inside the
     * transaction. The liker's and the author's profile rows are locked too and a deleted one refused, so a like
     * cannot land on an account a concurrent purge is removing (lockLive); the same goes for reposts and bookmarks.
     * 3e: the liker is the acting account, refused account_suspended while its suspension runs; the author need only be live.
     * Like a repost and a bookmark, it ends with the closing judgment of the acting account (judgeActing), after its
     * counter: the post's row may have kept it waiting past a start.
     */
    async like(userId: string, postId: string, now: Date, other?: string): Promise<boolean> {
      return db.transaction(async (tx) => {
        if (other) await guardPair(tx, userId, other, "not_found");
        await lockLive(tx, actorAndAuthor(userId, postId), "not_found", userId);
        const inserted = await tx.insert(likes).values({ userId, postId, createdAt: now }).onConflictDoNothing().returning({ postId: likes.postId });
        if (inserted.length > 0) await tx.update(posts).set({ likeCount: bump(posts.likeCount, 1) }).where(eq(posts.id, postId));
        await judgeActing(tx, userId);
        return inserted.length > 0;
      });
    },
    async unlike(userId: string, postId: string): Promise<boolean> {
      return db.transaction(async (tx) => {
        const deleted = await tx.delete(likes).where(and(eq(likes.userId, userId), eq(likes.postId, postId))).returning({ postId: likes.postId });
        if (deleted.length > 0) await tx.update(posts).set({ likeCount: bump(posts.likeCount, -1) }).where(eq(posts.id, postId));
        return deleted.length > 0;
      });
    },
    async repost(userId: string, postId: string, now: Date, other?: string): Promise<boolean> {
      return db.transaction(async (tx) => {
        if (other) await guardPair(tx, userId, other, "not_found");
        await lockLive(tx, actorAndAuthor(userId, postId), "not_found", userId);
        const inserted = await tx.insert(reposts).values({ userId, postId, createdAt: now }).onConflictDoNothing().returning({ postId: reposts.postId });
        if (inserted.length > 0) await tx.update(posts).set({ repostCount: bump(posts.repostCount, 1) }).where(eq(posts.id, postId));
        await judgeActing(tx, userId);
        return inserted.length > 0;
      });
    },
    async unrepost(userId: string, postId: string): Promise<boolean> {
      return db.transaction(async (tx) => {
        const deleted = await tx.delete(reposts).where(and(eq(reposts.userId, userId), eq(reposts.postId, postId))).returning({ postId: reposts.postId });
        if (deleted.length > 0) await tx.update(posts).set({ repostCount: bump(posts.repostCount, -1) }).where(eq(posts.id, postId));
        return deleted.length > 0;
      });
    },
    async bookmark(userId: string, postId: string, now: Date): Promise<boolean> {
      // A transaction of its own only for the lock: a bookmark counts nothing, but it must not outlive a purge of either account.
      return db.transaction(async (tx) => {
        await lockLive(tx, actorAndAuthor(userId, postId), "not_found", userId);
        const inserted = await tx.insert(bookmarks).values({ userId, postId, createdAt: now }).onConflictDoNothing().returning({ postId: bookmarks.postId });
        await judgeActing(tx, userId);
        return inserted.length > 0;
      });
    },
    async unbookmark(userId: string, postId: string): Promise<boolean> {
      const deleted = await db.delete(bookmarks).where(and(eq(bookmarks.userId, userId), eq(bookmarks.postId, postId))).returning({ postId: bookmarks.postId });
      return deleted.length > 0;
    },

    /** Whether the viewer liked, reposted or bookmarked each post. Missing ids are all false. */
    async viewerPostStates(viewer: string, postIds: string[]): Promise<Map<string, ViewerPostRow>> {
      const states = new Map(postIds.map((id) => [id, { liked: false, reposted: false, bookmarked: false }]));
      if (postIds.length === 0) return states;
      const raw = await rows<{ post_id: string; kind: "l" | "r" | "b" }>(sql`
        select post_id, 'l' as kind from likes where user_id = ${viewer}::uuid and post_id = any(${uuidArray(postIds)})
        union all select post_id, 'r' from reposts where user_id = ${viewer}::uuid and post_id = any(${uuidArray(postIds)})
        union all select post_id, 'b' from bookmarks where user_id = ${viewer}::uuid and post_id = any(${uuidArray(postIds)})`);
      for (const r of raw) {
        const state = states.get(r.post_id)!;
        if (r.kind === "l") state.liked = true;
        else if (r.kind === "r") state.reposted = true;
        else state.bookmarked = true;
      }
      return states;
    },

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ graph

    /**
     * With `guard`, the pair is locked and a block refused inside the transaction, so a follow cannot land across a
     * concurrent block. Both profile rows are locked and a deleted one refused either way, so a follow cannot land
     * on an account a concurrent purge is removing and stay behind it. 3e (design, section 5, the lock order, item 2):
     * both rows are taken FOR NO KEY UPDATE, the mode the counter updates need, in one statement ordered by id, before
     * the insert; the follower is the acting account and is refused account_suspended while its suspension runs. The one
     * statement projects both rows before it locks either, so a wait for the followee's row leaves the follower's
     * judgment as it was before it: the transaction ends with the closing judgment of the follower (judgeActing).
     */
    async follow(followerId: string, followeeId: string, now: Date, guard = false): Promise<boolean> {
      return db.transaction(async (tx) => {
        if (guard) await guardPair(tx, followerId, followeeId, "not_found");
        await lockPair(tx, followerId, followeeId, followerId);
        const inserted = await tx.insert(follows).values({ fromId: followerId, toId: followeeId, createdAt: now }).onConflictDoNothing().returning({ toId: follows.toId });
        if (inserted.length > 0) {
          await tx.update(profiles).set({ followerCount: bump(profiles.followerCount, 1) }).where(eq(profiles.id, followeeId));
          await tx.update(profiles).set({ followingCount: bump(profiles.followingCount, 1) }).where(eq(profiles.id, followerId));
        }
        await judgeActing(tx, followerId);
        return inserted.length > 0;
      });
    },
    /**
     * 3e (design, section 5, the lock order, item 2): both profile rows FOR NO KEY UPDATE in one statement ordered by id,
     * as a follow takes them, before the delete writes their counters. Withdrawing a follow is open to a suspended account.
     */
    async unfollow(followerId: string, followeeId: string): Promise<boolean> {
      return db.transaction(async (tx) => {
        await lockPair(tx, followerId, followeeId, null);
        return removeFollow(tx, followerId, followeeId);
      });
    },

    /**
     * Blocks and, in the same transaction, removes follows, reposts and likes in both directions, so
     * neither account keeps amplifying or counting on the other. False when the block already existed.
     * Both profile rows are locked and a deleted one refused, so a block cannot land behind a concurrent
     * purge of either account (lockLive).
     */
    async block(blockerId: string, blockedId: string, now: Date): Promise<boolean> {
      return db.transaction(async (tx) => {
        await pairLock(tx, blockerId, blockedId);
        await lockLive(tx, sql`id in (${blockerId}::uuid, ${blockedId}::uuid)`);
        const inserted = await tx.insert(blocks).values({ fromId: blockerId, toId: blockedId, createdAt: now }).onConflictDoNothing().returning({ toId: blocks.toId });
        await removeFollow(tx, blockerId, blockedId);
        await removeFollow(tx, blockedId, blockerId);
        await retractEngagement(tx, blockedId, blockerId);
        await retractEngagement(tx, blockerId, blockedId);
        return inserted.length > 0;
      });
    },
    async unblock(blockerId: string, blockedId: string): Promise<boolean> {
      const deleted = await db.delete(blocks).where(and(eq(blocks.fromId, blockerId), eq(blocks.toId, blockedId))).returning({ toId: blocks.toId });
      return deleted.length > 0;
    },
    /** A transaction of its own only for the lock: a mute counts nothing, but it must not outlive a purge of either account (lockLive). */
    async mute(muterId: string, mutedId: string, now: Date): Promise<boolean> {
      return db.transaction(async (tx) => {
        await lockLive(tx, sql`id in (${muterId}::uuid, ${mutedId}::uuid)`);
        const inserted = await tx.insert(mutes).values({ fromId: muterId, toId: mutedId, createdAt: now }).onConflictDoNothing().returning({ toId: mutes.toId });
        return inserted.length > 0;
      });
    },
    async unmute(muterId: string, mutedId: string): Promise<boolean> {
      const deleted = await db.delete(mutes).where(and(eq(mutes.fromId, muterId), eq(mutes.toId, mutedId))).returning({ toId: mutes.toId });
      return deleted.length > 0;
    },

    async relation(viewer: string, other: string): Promise<Relation> {
      const [r] = await rows<Relation>(sql`select
        exists(select 1 from follows where follower_id = ${viewer}::uuid and followee_id = ${other}::uuid) as "following",
        exists(select 1 from follows where follower_id = ${other}::uuid and followee_id = ${viewer}::uuid) as "followedBy",
        exists(select 1 from blocks where blocker_id = ${viewer}::uuid and blocked_id = ${other}::uuid) as "blocked",
        exists(select 1 from blocks where blocker_id = ${other}::uuid and blocked_id = ${viewer}::uuid) as "blockedBy",
        exists(select 1 from mutes where muter_id = ${viewer}::uuid and muted_id = ${other}::uuid) as "muted"`);
      return r!;
    },

    /** Of the given accounts, those with a block in either direction with the viewer. */
    async blockedEitherWay(viewer: string, otherIds: string[]): Promise<Set<string>> {
      if (otherIds.length === 0) return new Set();
      const raw = await rows<{ other: string }>(sql`
        select blocked_id as other from blocks where blocker_id = ${viewer}::uuid and blocked_id = any(${uuidArray(otherIds)})
        union select blocker_id from blocks where blocked_id = ${viewer}::uuid and blocker_id = any(${uuidArray(otherIds)})`);
      return new Set(raw.map((r) => r.other));
    },

    /** Accounts with a block in either direction with the viewer are left out before the page is cut, so pages stay full. */
    followers(profileId: string, viewer: string | null, cursor: Cursor | undefined, limit: number): Promise<ProfileListRow[]> {
      return profileList(sql`
        select f.follower_id as profile_id, ${iso("f.created_at")} as sort_at from follows f
        where f.followee_id = ${profileId}::uuid and ${otherNotBlocked(viewer, sql`f.follower_id`)} and ${before(cursor, sql`f.created_at`, sql`f.follower_id`)}
        order by f.created_at desc, f.follower_id desc limit ${limit}`);
    },
    following(profileId: string, viewer: string | null, cursor: Cursor | undefined, limit: number): Promise<ProfileListRow[]> {
      return profileList(sql`
        select f.followee_id as profile_id, ${iso("f.created_at")} as sort_at from follows f
        where f.follower_id = ${profileId}::uuid and ${otherNotBlocked(viewer, sql`f.followee_id`)} and ${before(cursor, sql`f.created_at`, sql`f.followee_id`)}
        order by f.created_at desc, f.followee_id desc limit ${limit}`);
    },
    blockedList(userId: string, cursor: Cursor | undefined, limit: number): Promise<ProfileListRow[]> {
      return profileList(sql`
        select b.blocked_id as profile_id, ${iso("b.created_at")} as sort_at from blocks b
        where b.blocker_id = ${userId}::uuid and ${before(cursor, sql`b.created_at`, sql`b.blocked_id`)}
        order by b.created_at desc, b.blocked_id desc limit ${limit}`);
    },
    mutedList(userId: string, cursor: Cursor | undefined, limit: number): Promise<ProfileListRow[]> {
      return profileList(sql`
        select m.muted_id as profile_id, ${iso("m.created_at")} as sort_at from mutes m
        where m.muter_id = ${userId}::uuid and ${before(cursor, sql`m.created_at`, sql`m.muted_id`)}
        order by m.created_at desc, m.muted_id desc limit ${limit}`);
    },
    /** Of the given accounts, those the viewer follows. */
    async followedBy(viewer: string, ids: string[]): Promise<Set<string>> {
      if (ids.length === 0) return new Set();
      const raw = await rows<{ id: string }>(sql`select followee_id as id from follows where follower_id = ${viewer}::uuid and followee_id = any(${uuidArray(ids)})`);
      return new Set(raw.map((r) => r.id));
    },

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ timelines and lists

    /**
     * Top-level posts and quotes by followed accounts and the viewer, plus their reposts; blocks and mutes
     * apply to author and reposter. Each branch applies the cursor, the filters and the limit itself, so
     * only two small sorted sets meet in the union instead of everything the followed accounts ever wrote.
     */
    async followingTimeline(viewer: string, cursor: Cursor | undefined, limit: number): Promise<ListRow[]> {
      const raw = await rows<RawListRow>(sql`
        with f as (select followee_id as id from follows where follower_id = ${viewer}::uuid union select ${viewer}::uuid),
        own as (
          select p.id as post_id, p.created_at as sort_at, null::uuid as reposter_id, p.author_id
          from posts p where p.author_id in (select id from f) and p.reply_to_id is null and ${visibleTo(viewer)}
            and ${otherWelcome(viewer, sql`p.author_id`)} and ${beforeTriple(cursor, sql`p.created_at`, sql`p.id`, sql`${NO_REPOSTER}::uuid`)}
          order by p.created_at desc, p.id desc limit ${limit}
        ),
        shared as (
          select r.post_id, r.created_at as sort_at, r.user_id as reposter_id, p.author_id
          from reposts r join posts p on p.id = r.post_id where r.user_id in (select id from f) and p.state = 'visible'
            and ${otherWelcome(viewer, sql`p.author_id`)} and ${otherWelcome(viewer, sql`r.user_id`)}
            and ${beforeTriple(cursor, sql`r.created_at`, sql`r.post_id`, sql`r.user_id`)}
          order by r.created_at desc, r.post_id desc, r.user_id desc limit ${limit}
        ),
        i as (select * from own union all select * from shared)
        select ${LIST_COLUMNS} from i
        order by i.sort_at desc, i.post_id desc, coalesce(i.reposter_id, ${NO_REPOSTER}::uuid) desc limit ${limit}`);
      return raw.map(toListRow);
    },

    /** Every visible top-level post and quote, newest first; a signed-in viewer's blocks and mutes apply. */
    async latestTimeline(viewer: string | null, cursor: Cursor | undefined, limit: number): Promise<ListRow[]> {
      const raw = await rows<RawListRow>(sql`
        select ${LIST_COLUMNS} from (
          select p.id as post_id, p.created_at as sort_at, null::uuid as reposter_id, p.author_id
          from posts p where p.reply_to_id is null and ${visibleTo(viewer)}
        ) i
        where ${itemNotBlocked(viewer)} and ${itemNotMuted(viewer)} and ${beforeItem(cursor)}
        order by i.sort_at desc, i.post_id desc limit ${limit}`);
      return raw.map(toListRow);
    },

    /** An account's top-level posts, quotes and reposts. The caller has already checked the viewer may see the account. */
    async profilePosts(profileId: string, viewer: string | null, cursor: Cursor | undefined, limit: number): Promise<ListRow[]> {
      const raw = await rows<RawListRow>(sql`
        with i as (
          select p.id as post_id, p.created_at as sort_at, null::uuid as reposter_id, p.author_id
          from posts p where p.author_id = ${profileId}::uuid and p.reply_to_id is null and ${visibleTo(viewer)}
          union all
          select r.post_id, r.created_at, r.user_id, p.author_id
          from reposts r join posts p on p.id = r.post_id where r.user_id = ${profileId}::uuid and p.state = 'visible'
        )
        select ${LIST_COLUMNS} from i
        where ${itemNotBlocked(viewer)} and ${beforeItem(cursor)}
        order by i.sort_at desc, i.post_id desc, coalesce(i.reposter_id, ${NO_REPOSTER}::uuid) desc limit ${limit}`);
      return raw.map(toListRow);
    },

    async profileReplies(profileId: string, viewer: string | null, cursor: Cursor | undefined, limit: number): Promise<ListRow[]> {
      const raw = await rows<RawListRow>(sql`
        select p.id as post_id, ${iso("p.created_at")} as sort_at, null::uuid as reposter_id from posts p
        where p.author_id = ${profileId}::uuid and p.reply_to_id is not null and ${visibleTo(viewer)} and ${before(cursor, sql`p.created_at`, sql`p.id`)}
        order by p.created_at desc, p.id desc limit ${limit}`);
      return raw.map(toListRow);
    },

    /** The viewer's likes, newest like first; posts they may no longer see are omitted. */
    async likedPosts(viewer: string, cursor: Cursor | undefined, limit: number): Promise<ListRow[]> {
      const raw = await rows<RawListRow>(sql`
        select p.id as post_id, ${iso("l.created_at")} as sort_at, null::uuid as reposter_id from likes l join posts p on p.id = l.post_id
        where l.user_id = ${viewer}::uuid and ${visibleTo(viewer)} and ${authorNotBlocked(viewer)} and ${before(cursor, sql`l.created_at`, sql`p.id`)}
        order by l.created_at desc, p.id desc limit ${limit}`);
      return raw.map(toListRow);
    },
    async bookmarkedPosts(viewer: string, cursor: Cursor | undefined, limit: number): Promise<ListRow[]> {
      const raw = await rows<RawListRow>(sql`
        select p.id as post_id, ${iso("b.created_at")} as sort_at, null::uuid as reposter_id from bookmarks b join posts p on p.id = b.post_id
        where b.user_id = ${viewer}::uuid and ${visibleTo(viewer)} and ${authorNotBlocked(viewer)} and ${before(cursor, sql`b.created_at`, sql`p.id`)}
        order by b.created_at desc, p.id desc limit ${limit}`);
      return raw.map(toListRow);
    },

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ explore

    /**
     * One round of the Explore refresh (2c design, section 7): a new ranking as of `asOf`, written by one statement that
     * takes every number of the formula as a parameter, in a transaction that gives up after 30 seconds of work or 5 of
     * waiting on a lock. The round writes nothing while the newest ranking of its formula's version is younger than the
     * formula's minimum gap, so at most one ranking lands per interval however many instances run the job or restart. The
     * newest `kept` rankings stay, so a reader paging through the one before the current one can finish; older ones go
     * with their items. A formula of a version other than 2 throws before the transaction (exploreRules).
     *
     * The statement's CTEs: `c` the candidates, `e` the engagement that counts and `ap` the approving accounts per post
     * reaching the threshold, all three the shared rules of `exploreRules`, which the author's status judges with too; `s`
     * the score, approvers over (hours since the post's window started, never negative, + offset) ^ gravity, the window
     * starting at `starts_at` (3e: when moderation last gave the post back its time, else when it was posted); `r` each author's posts numbered
     * by score, a level of its own because a window cannot order by an alias of its own select; `k` the posts within the
     * per-author cap, numbered by score from 1 and cut at the list length, a tie going to the higher post id; `ins` the
     * items. Nothing about a post but its place is stored, and nothing about any post is answered or logged.
     */
    async refreshExplore(asOf: Date, formula: ExploreFormula = EXPLORE_V2): Promise<ExploreRefresh> {
      const started = performance.now();
      const rules = exploreRules(asOf, formula);
      return db.transaction(async (tx): Promise<ExploreRefresh> => {
        // Settings of this transaction only: every statement below runs on the connection the transaction holds.
        await tx.execute(sql`set local statement_timeout = '30s'`);
        await tx.execute(sql`set local lock_timeout = '5s'`);
```
